translations.translation: saxelit`a allahisa, mocqalisa, mcqalobelisa.
dideba allahs, g'mert`s samqarot`a;
mocqalesa, mcqalobelsa;
gankit`xvis dg'is ganmgebs.
mxolod shen get`aqvanebit` da mxolod shen gt`xovt` daxmarebas.
gvich`vene scori gza;
- gza imat`i, visac` cqaloba uqavi, da ara - sherisxult`a da gzaac`denilt`a;
elip` laam miim.
ai, cigni: echvi ar aris masshi da scori gzis mach`venebelia g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
- romelt`ac` scamt` uxilavisa, ag'asruleben namazs da gaig'eben imas, rac` vucqalobet` sazrdod;
aseve isini, romelt`ac` scamt` - rac` ch`amogevlina da rac` shenamde ch`amovlenila... da g'rmad scamt` ukanaskneli dg'isa.
ai, t`aviant`i g'mert`is mier mit`it`ebul cheshmarit gzaze mdgomni, - egeni arian gadarch`enilni.
uechvelad, - romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, mat`t`vis sulert`ia, gaap`rt`xileb t`u ar gaap`rt`xileb, - mainc` ar ircmuneben;
- bechedi daasva allahma gulebsa da sasmenelze, sap`arveli ak`vt` t`valebzec`... da mat`t`visaa didi sasjeli.
adamiant`a shoris arian iset`nic`, romlebic` amboben - vircmunet` allahi da dg'e ukanasknelio, magram isini ar arian morcmuneni;
- c`diloben, moatquon allahi da isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes, t`umc`a ver ac`nobiereben, rom veravis moatqueben, garda sakut`ari t`avisa;
sneulebaa mat` gulebshi da allahma uaresad daasneula... da mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli, vinaidan c`ruobdnen;
da roc`a ut`xres - k`veqnad uket`urebas nu ecevit`o, mat` miuges: uechvelad, ch`ven pirik`it`, - gamomscorebelni vart`o.
dae, ic`odet`, rom scored egeni ecevian uket`urebas, magram ar sheigneben.
da roc`a ut`xres - ircmunet` ise, rogorc` ircmuna xalxmao, mat` miuges:,,nut`u vircmunot` ise, rogorc` scamt` chkuasustebs?"... ic`odet`, rom scored egeni arian chkuasustebi, t`umc`a ar ic`ian.

da roc`a morcmuneebs shexvdebian, amboben, ch`venc` vircmunet`o, xolo rodesac` t`aviant` satanebt`an ganmartovdebian, eubnebian: ra t`k`ma unda, ch`ven t`k`vens gverdit` vart` da rag'a t`k`ma unda, mat`i damc`inavni vart`o.
- allahi dasc`inebs mat` da xetials gauxangrz'livebs t`aviant` zg'vargadasulobashi.
egeni arian, romelt`ac` gzaac`deniloba iqides cheshmariti gzis p`asad, magram ar moigo mat`ma vachrobam da arc` cheshmarit gzaze mdgarni qop`ilan.
mat`i sak`c`ieli hgavs imis magalit`s, vinc` c`ec`xli daant`o da, roc`a am c`ec`xlma irgvliv sinat`le mohp`ina, - allahma cartac`a mat` mxedveloba da bnelet`shi datova usinat`lod.
- qruni, munjni da brmani... egeni ar mobrundebian.

- an, magalit`s - cqvdiad g'ameshi t`avsxma cvimisa da chek`a-k`uxilis k`vesh moqolilt`as, mexis dros rom t`it`ebs qurebshi ic`oben - sikvdilis shishit` moc`ulni, t`umc`a urcmunoebs - allahi garemoic`avs;

- lamis cartac`os elvam mxedveloba; rogorc` ki gaielvebs, mashinve masshi amoz'ravdebian da, sibnele rom ch`amocveba, - umal iquch`eben. allahs rom eneba, auc`ileblad caart`mevda smenasac` da xedvasac`. uechvelad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
ei, adamianebo! t`k`vens g'mert`s et`aqvanet`, gagach`inat` romelmac` - t`k`ven da t`k`enze adre mqop`ni; - ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`;

- romelmac` t`k`vent`vis gap`ina dedamica sacolivit`, xolo zec`a saburvelad aago, shemdeg c`idan cqali gadmoadina da mosavali ag'moac`ena t`k`vens sazrdod. ase rom, ar gauch`inot` allahs t`anaziarni, shegnebulad.
t`uki raime dagaechvebt` imashi, rac` ch`vens mona-morch`ils ch`amovuvlinet`, mashin mouxmet` qvela t`k`vens mocmes, garda allahisa, da imisi scori t`undac` ert`i sura moitanet`, t`u xart` mart`alni.
da t`u ver shez'lot`, - da ra t`k`ma unda ver shez'lebt`, - mash, geshinodet` c`ec`xlis, - mzamzareulisa urcmunot`at`vis, romlis sacvavic` adamianebi da k`vebia.

da axare imat`, vinc` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, rom mat`t`visaa samot`xeebi, romelt`a k`veshac` - dian mdinareni. isini, qovelt`vis, roc`a ik`auri xilit` isazrdoeben, ase itqvian - es isaa, rac` ucin gvesazrdovao, t`umc`ag'a amisi msgavsi eboz'at` mxolod; ik` ik`nebian umcikvlo meug'leebic`, - maradzhams damkvidrebulni.

uechvelad, allahs ar erideba igavi moiqvanos kog'osi an kidev masze upiratesi arsebis shesaxeb. vinc` ircmunes, ic`ian, rom igi cheshmaritebaa mat`i g'mert`isgan, xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes, itqvian - ra unda (et`k`va) allahs am igavit`o? - am igavit` gzas aac`dens bevrs da cheshmarit gzas uch`venebs mravals amit`ve... da gzidan aravis gadaiqvans, t`u ara ug'irsebs.

- romelnic` arg'veven allahis ag't`k`mas misi ganmtkic`ebis shemdeg da cqveten im kavshirebs, romelt`a gamqarebac` brz'ana allahma, da k`veqnad t`esaven uket`urebas... egeni arian, namdvilad, - cagebulni.
rogor uarhqop`t` allahs, roc`a mkvdarni iqavit` da man moganichat` sic`oc`xle, shemdeg isev mogakvdinebt`, shemdeg ki dagac`oc`xlebt` da mas daubrundebit`.
- igia, qvelap`eri t`k`vent`vis vinc` gaach`ina, rac` ki dedamicaze arsebobs, shemdeg zec`isken mieshura da shvid c`ad ganalaga isini; - igia qovlismc`odne.

aki, shenma g'mert`ma angelozebs ut`xra: auc`ileblad unda gavach`ino xalip`a dedamicazeo. mat` miuges:,,nut`u ik` gaach`en iset`s, vinc` sisxls dag'vris da ik`ms uket`urebas, roc`a ch`veni g'ag'adisi shens didebashia da sul shens sicmindesa da unakloebas vag'iarebt`?". (allahma) ut`xra: uechvelad, me vic`i is, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`o.
da adams qvela (misi k`mnilebis) saxeli sheascavla, shemdeg isini (k`mnilebebi) angelozebs carudgina da ubrz'ana: aba, maucqet` amat`i saxelebi, t`uki mart`alni xart`o.
(angelozebma) t`k`ves: shena xar mxolod qovlad unaklo, xolo ch`ven ar vp`lobt` sxva c`odnas, garda imisa, rac` shen giscavlebia, cheshmaritad, - shena xar brz'eni - qovlismc`odneo.

(allahma) brz'ana:,,adam, aucqe mat` imat`i saxelebi!"... da roc`a aucqa (mat` imat`i saxelebi), - ut`xra: gana ar git`xarit`, rom me namdvilad vic`i uxilavt`a shesaxeb c`at`a da dedamicisa, aseve, vic`i, rasac` amxelt` an rasac` malavt`o?
aki, vubrz'anet` angelozebs, rom adamist`vis sejdeze t`avdaxriliqvnen, da umal sejdeze ch`aemxnen, garda iblisisa, romelmac` gadidgulda, uarze dadga da gaxda urcmunot`agani.
da vut`xarit`:,,adam! shen da sheni c`oli samot`xeshi dasaxldit` da uxvad miirt`vit`, sadac` ra genebot`, t`umc`a am xes nu miuaxlovdebit`, t`orem t`k`ven ik`nebit` usamart`lot`aganni".

mere ac`duna isini satanam da gamoaz'eva ik`idan, sadac` imqop`ebodnen. ch`ven mat` vut`xarit`:,,(k`veqnad) daeshvit` mtrebad ert`urt`isa! droebit`i samkvidro da sabadebeli t`k`vent`vis -dedamicazea".
da adamma sheiscavla sitqvebi t`avisi g'mert`isagan da g'mert`mac` - miuteva; cheshmaritad, - isaa mimtevebeli, mcqalobeli.

vubrz'anet`:,,daeshvit` ik`idan qvela ert`ianad! vinc` gahqveba ch`emgan nach`veneb cheshmarit gzas mashin, roc`a scori gzis mach`venebeli mogevlinebat`, - mat`t`vis arc` shishi ik`neba, arc`a mcuxareba";
- xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes da c`rud miich`nies ch`veni aiat`ebi, ai, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.

ei, israelis modgmav! ch`emi cqaloba gaixsenet`, romelic` t`k`vent`vis miboz'ebia, da ch`ems cinashe dadebul ag't`k`mas uert`gulet`, rom ag'gisrulot` t`k`venze danapirebic`; (t`k`ven) mxolod ch`emi shishi gk`ondet`.

da ircmunet` is (qurani), rac` ch`amovavline t`k`vent`an arsebulis (t`oras) damamocmeblad, nu ik`nebit` misi pirveli uarmqop`elni da nurc` gaqidit` ch`ems aiat`ebs mc`ire p`asis sanac`vlod. ase rom, mxolod ch`emi ridi gk`ondet`.
ar shemosot` sic`ruit` cheshmariteba da arc` damalot` igi, shegnebulad.
ag'asrulet` namazi, gaig'et` zek`at`i da moixaret` ruk`u'ze - ruk`u'ze mqop`ebt`an ert`ad.
nut`u xalxs siket`isken moucodebt`, sakut`ar t`avt` ki daivicqebt`, mit`umetes, roc`a cigns (t`oras) kit`xulobt`; nut`u gonebas ar mouxmobt`?
mot`minebit`a da namazit` ez'iet` g'vt`isshemceoba, - rt`ulia ut`uod, og'ond ara g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
- romelt`ac` guldajerebit` scamt`, rom t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe carsdgebian; rom mas daubrundebian.
ei, modgmav israelisa! ch`emi cqaloba gaixsenet`, romelic` t`k`vent`vis miboz'ebia, roc`a me t`k`ven samqarot`a cinashe gamogarch`iet`;
da ridi gk`ondet` im dg'isa, roc`a suli sxva suls verap`ershi emagivreba, arc` misi shuamdgomloba miig'eba, arc`a sadamxsnelo da verc` sxvisgan miig'ebs daxmarebas.

aki, gixsenit` p`araonis xalxisgan, - gsjidnen roc`a, usastikesi sasjelit`: t`avebs ac`lidnen t`k`vens vazhebs da c`oc`xlad tovebdnen t`k`vens k`alishvilebs; - t`k`veni g'mert`isgan gansac`deli iqo amashi, udidesi.
aki, t`k`vent`vis zg'va gavapet` da gadagarch`inet`, xolo p`araonis xalxi davaxrch`vet` da t`k`venc` - shesc`k`erodit` (momxdars).
aki, ormoc`i g'ame ag'vut`k`vit` musas, misi casvlis shemdeg ki xbo daidginet` t`aqvansac`emad (kerpad); - usamart`loni xart` amitom.
amis miuxedavad mere gapatiet`, rom ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit`.
aki, cigni da p`urqani vuboz'et` musas, ik`neb cheshmarit gzas dasdgomodit` t`k`ven.

aki, musam t`avis xalxs mimart`a: ei, xalxo! uechvelad, xbos (kerpad) dadgenit`, sakut`ar sulebs uqavit` usamart`loba, amitom: moinaniet` igi t`k`veni gamch`enis cinashe da daxoc`et` ert`manet`i, radgan es up`ro xeiriania t`k`vent`vis, t`k`venive gamch`enis cinasheo. shemdeg man esec` gapatiat`. cheshmaritad, - isaa mimtevebeli, mcqalobeli.
aki ut`xarit`: ei, musa! aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ar dagijerebt`, vidre ashkarad ar vixilavt` allahso. mashinve mexi dagemxot` da t`k`venc` - shesc`k`erodit` (momxdars).
mere ag'gadginet` sikvdilis shemdgom, - ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit`;

- da mogich`rdilet` g'rubeli mag'lidan da zec`iuri manana da mcqeric` ch`amogivlinet`. miirt`vit` imat`gan, rac` sup`t`aa (halali) da rac` t`k`vent`vis sarch`od gvicqalobebia... ch`ven ki ar mogvk`c`evian usamart`lod, - isini t`aviant` sulebs moek`c`nen usamart`lod.

aki, git`xarit`:,,shedit` am k`alak`shi da uxvad miirt`vit`, sadac` ra genebot`; shedit` (am k`alak`is) karibcheshi k`edmoxrilni da t`k`vit` -,,shendoba!""... - shegindobt` t`k`vens c`odvebs da (cqalobas) gavuzrdit` - sak`mit` ket`ilsa da rcmenit` ihsanis mk`onet`;

- magram mat`, vinc` usamart`lobdnen, (ch`ven mier davalebuli) sitqva shec`vales imit`, rac` ar hk`ondat` davalebuli, da vinc` usamart`lod moik`c`a, c`idan sasjeli ch`avuvlinet`, vinaidan urch`obdnen.

aki, it`xova musam darcquleba t`avisi xalxisa da mas vut`xarit` - dahkari kldes sheni joxit`o, da mashinve t`ormetma cqarom amoxet`k`a ik`idan. qvela gvarma gaigo amgvarad - t`aviant`i dasarcqurebeli adgili. chamet` da svit` allahis mier boz'ebuli sazrdodan da nu iborotebt` k`veqnad uket`urebi.

aki, t`k`vit`:,,ei, musa! veg'ar movit`ment` ert`i da igive saxeobis sakvebze qop`nas da shens g'mert`s sheevedre, ag'mogvic`enos is, rac` micaze amodis: bostneuli, kitri, niori, ospi da xaxvi". (musam) gipasuxat`:,,nut`u gsurt`, shec`valot` up`ro c`udit` is, rac` uket`esia? (mash) ch`adit` k`alak`shi da, uechvelad, qvelap`eria ik` t`k`vent`vis, rasac` it`xovt`". (ik` ki) t`avs daatqdat` damc`ireba, sig'aribe da risxva allahisa, ramet`u uarqop`dnen allahis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs da usamart`lod xoc`avdnen shuamavlebs. es qvelap`eri imist`vis miezg'ot`, rom urch`obdnen da zg'vargadasulobdnen.

cheshmaritad, mat`t`vis, vinc` ircmuna, da mat`t`visac`, vinc` iqo iudeveli, nazareveli da sabieli, vinc` ircmuna - allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli da aket`a siket`e, - scored mat`t`visaa jildo - g'mert`t`an t`aviant`isa... da arc` shishi ek`nebat`, arc`a damcuxrdebian (isini).

aki, avig'et` t`k`vengan ag't`k`ma da mt`a ag'vmart`et` t`k`vens zemot`. mt`eli simtkic`it`a da gulisxmierebit` aig'et` is, rac` (t`evrat`is saxit`) gadmogec`it` da gaxsovdet`, rac`aa masshi, - ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`.
mere, piri ibrunet` mainc` amis shemdeg da, rom ara allahis madli da cqaloba t`k`venda, - ut`uod ik`nebodit` ganadgurebult`agan.
vp`ic`av, kargad ucqit` imat`ze, rom shabat`i daarg'vies; rom mat` vut`xarit` - saz'agel maimunebad gadaik`ec`it`o.
shemdeg, samagalit`od vak`c`iet` igi mat`i t`anamedrovenisa da shemdgomi t`aobebist`vis, aseve, shegonebad - g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
aki, t`avis xalxs ut`xra musam - cheshmaritad, allahi gibrz'anebt`, rom daklat` z'roxao. mat` miuges:,,nut`u masxrad gvigdeb?''. ut`xra: g'mert`ma damip`aros, rom viqo uvic`t`aganio.

mat` t`k`ves: sheevedre ch`vent`vis shens g'mert`s, rom gagvarkvios, - rogoria igi. miugo:,,cheshmaritad, is(allahi) ambobs, rom uechvelad, igia z'roxa: arc` xnieri da arc` dekeuli, aramed amat` shoris - sashualo xnisa. mash, ag'asrulet` igi, rac` gebrz'anat`".
mat` t`k`ves: sheevedre ch`vent`vis shens g'mert`s, rom gagvarkvios, - ra p`erisaa igio. miugo:,,cheshmaritad, is ambobs, rom igia z'roxa -xasxasa qvit`eli p`erisa, romelsac` shehxarian mnaxvelni".

mat` t`k`ves: sheevedre ch`vent`vis shens g'mert`s, rom (uket`) gagvarkvios - rogoria igi, radganac` bevria ch`vent`vis igivenairi z'roxa da, allahi t`u inebebs, uechvelad, ch`ven vik`nebit` cheshmarit gzaze mdgomnio;

- miugo: cheshmaritad, is ambobs, rom igia z'roxa: ara damc`robili - micis xvnasa da nat`esis rcqvashi; qovlad uvnebeli, romelsac` raime t`valsach`ino lak`a ar gaach`niao. mat` t`k`ves:,,ai, axla moxvedi cheshmaritebit`''. bolos dakles igi, t`umc`a, c`otac` da veg'ar shez'lebdnen(povnas).
aki, ert`i kac`i mokalit` da mere ert`manet`s gadaabralet`, arada, rasac` malavdit`, - allahia gamomaashkaravebi.
da vut`xarit`:,,dakluli z'roxis zogiert`i nacili mic`valebuls sheaxet`"... ase ac`oc`xlebs allahi mic`valebulebs, ase gich`venebt` t`avis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs, ik`neb gons moegot`.

mere mainc`, - gulni gagixdat` sali kldesavit` an kidev up`ro sheug'ceveli, vinaidan: kldet`agania is, saidanac` mdinareebi moch`xrialeben; mat`ganic`aa, ranic` skdebian da gadmosch`k`ep`en shignidan cqlebi; kidev mat`gani, ranic` allahis shishisgan gorvit` k`veeshvebian... - xolo allahi ugulisquro araa imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
nut`u imedovnebt`, rom t`k`vensas ircmuneben (iudevelni)? uechvelad, mat`gan ert`-ert`ni allahis sitqvebs ismendnen da, roc`a gaiazrebdnen xolme, - mas shemdgom shegnebulad asxvap`erebdnen.

da roc`a murcmuneebs shemoxvdebian, amboben, rom ch`venc` vircmunet`o, xolo rodesac` ert`manet`t`an ganmartovdebian, eubnebian: nut`u uambobt` imas, rac` allahs t`k`vent`vis uc`nobebia, mere t`k`veni g'mert`is cinashe rom mogiqvanon mtkic`ebulebad; nut`u gonebas ar mouxmobt`o?
gana ar ic`ian, rom allahma ic`is qvelap`eri, rasac` malaven da rasac` ac`xadeben?!
da mat`gan arian cera-kit`xvis uc`odinarni, romelt`ac` arap`eri gaegebat` cignis shesaxeb, garda shet`xzuli ambebisa da isini mxolod varaudoben.

vai imat`, romelnic` sakut`ari xelebit` ceren cigns da mere amboben, allahisganaao, rat`a mc`ire sap`asurad gaqidon igi. vai imat` imist`vis, rac` daceres mat`ma xelebma da vai imat` imist`vis, rac` ase moixveches.

da t`k`ves:,,ver shegvexeba c`ec`xli ch`ven, garda gat`vlili dg'eebisa". ut`xari:,,xom ar agig'iat` ag't`k`ma allahisgan? - allahi xom ar gadava t`avisi ag't`k`midan, aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi, - t`u, allahis shesaxeb imas amtkic`ebt`, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`?".
- pirik`it`! vinc` siaveni moixvecha da vinac` c`odvebma garemoic`va, ai, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.
xolo isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, ai, isini arian samot`xis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.

aki, ag't`k`ma avig'et` israelis modgmisgan, rom aravis et`aqvanot` garda allahisa, siket`e uket`et` mshoblebs, nat`esavebs, oblebs, g'atakebs, tkbilad esaubret` xalxs,namazi ag'asrulet` da zek`at`i gaec`it`. t`k`ven ki shemdeg piri ibrunet` mainc`, garda mc`irednisa; t`k`ven sul zurgshek`c`eulni xart`.
aki, ag't`k`ma avig'et` t`k`vengan, rom ar dag'varot` ert`manet`is sisxli da ar gaqarot` ert`manet`i sakut`ari saxlebidan. es qvelap`eri shemdeg ag'iaret` da t`k`venve mocmobt` amaze.

amis shemdeg, t`k`ven ert`manet`s xoc`avt` mainc` da az'evebt` sakut`ari saxlebidan zogiert`s da zurgs umagrebt` mat` cinaag'mdeg ert`manet`s, mtrobit`a da borotebit`. da t`u tqveebad mogividnen, gamosasqids it`xovt` mat`gan, arada mat`i gaz'eveba akrz'aluli gk`ondat` t`k`ven. nut`u cignis nacili gcamt` da nacils uarqop`t`? da ra ik`neba sazg'auri, romeli t`k`venganic` amas sch`adis, t`u ara damc`ireba am k`veqniur c`xovrebashi, da gankit`xvis dg'esac` umkac`res sasjels miec`emian, radgan allahi araa ugulisquro imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
egeni arian, vinc` amk`veqniuri c`xovreba iqides im k`veqnis p`asad. amitom ar sheumsubuk`debat` magat` sasjeli da arc` daxmareba gaecevat`.

da, ra t`k`ma unda, - musas mivec`it` cigni da shemdeg mivadevnet` shuamavlebi. c`xadi mtkic`ebulebani vuboz'et` meriemis z'e 'isasac` da cminda sulit` ganvamtkic`et` igi. gana qovelt`vis, roc`a mogdiodat` shuamavalni iset`i gzavnilebit`, rac` iqo mouconari t`k`veni gemovnebist`vis, - t`k`ven ar medidurobdit` da mat`gan nacils c`rud ar rac`xavdit` da nacils ar xoc`avdit`?
da t`k`ves: ch`vens gulebs adevs sap`arvelio. - pirik`it`, allhama t`aviant`i urcmunoebis gamo dascqevla da, ai, - umc`iresia, rasac` isini rcmunoben.

da roc`a mat`t`an arsebulis (t`evrat`is) damamocmebeli cigni (qurani) miuvidat` allahisgan, - uarhqves igi, arada manamde daxmarebas elodnen urcmunot`a cinaag'mdeg. roc`a miuvidat` is, rasac` ukve (t`evrat`idan) ic`nobdnen, - ag'ar ircmunes da, allahis cqevla urcmunoebs, - amitom!

raoden c`udia is, ris gamoc` t`aviant`i sulebi gaqides: shurdat`, rom allahi t`avis madls ch`amoavlens im msaxurebze, inebebs viszec`, - da ar ircmunes is, rac` ch`amoavlina, ris gamoc` risxvaze risxva daimsaxures... da urcmunot`at`visaa sasjeli damamc`irebeli.

- da rodesac` ut`xres, ircmunet` is, rac` allahma ch`amoavlinao, miuges: gvcams is, rac` ch`venzea ch`amovlenilio da, mis garda sxva danarch`ens - uarqop`en. arada is (qurani) mat`t`an arsebulis damamocmebeli cheshmaritebaa. ut`xari: mash, rad xoc`avdit` allahis mac`neebs, t`uki iqavit` (t`evrat`is) morcmuneni?
cheshmaritad, musa movida t`k`vent`an c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit`, mere ki xbo daidginet` kerpad mas shemdeg da gaxdit` usamart`loni.

aki, avig'et` ag't`k`ma t`k`vengan da ag'vmart`et` mt`a (sinasi) t`k`vens zemot`; (gibrz'anet` rom:) - mt`eli simtkic`it`a da gulisxmierebit` aig'et`, rac` (t`evrat`is saxit`) gadmogec`it` da sheisminet`. mat` t`k`ves - gvesma da veurch`et`o, radgan t`aviant`i urcmunoebis gamo xbos t`aqvanisc`emit` hk`ondat` gulebi gazhg'ent`ilni. ut`xari:,,ra c`udia is, rasac` t`k`veni rcmena gibrz'anebt`, t`uki t`k`ven xart` morcmuneni".
ut`xari:,,t`uki allaht`an, sxva xalxis gareshe, - (mxolod) t`k`vent`visaa gankut`vnili imk`veqniuri samkvidrebeli, mashin sikvdili isurvet`, t`u xart` namdvilad gulcrp`elni".
- magram amas arasodes isurveben imis gamo, rac` ukve ch`audeniat` mat` xelebs... allahi ic`nobs usamart`loebs.

vp`ic`av, ut`uod hpovo egeni, - sic`oc`xlis mimart` qvelaze daxarbebulni, im xalxze charbadac` ki, romlebic` g'mert`s ut`anaziareben. qovel mat`gans surs, at`asi celi ic`oc`xlos, t`umc`a xangrz'livi sic`oc`xlec` ver ganaridebs mat` sasjelisgan. qvelap`ers xedavs allahi, rasac` isini aket`eben.

ut`xari imas, vinc`a mteria jibrilisa, - rom cheshmaritad, allahis nebit` man (jibrilma) ch`amoavlina igi shens gulze: damamocmeblad imisa, rac` iqo adre; cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad da xarebad morcmunenisa.
- vinc`a mteria allahisa, misi angelozebisa, (misi) shuamavlebisa, jibrilisa da mik`ailisa, - uechvelad, allahic` mteria urcmunonisa.
cheshmaritad, ch`ven ch`amogivlinet` nat`eli aiat`ebi/sascaulebi da mat` aravin uarqop`s, garda ug'irsebisa.
rodesac` ag't`k`mas dadebdnen, nacili mat`i mudam arg'vevda; up`ro metic`, - umravlesobas ara scams.

da roc`a miuvidat` mat` allahisgan shuamavali, - imis damamocmebeli, rac` iqo mat`t`an (t`evrat`i), - mat`ma nacilma, visac` (es) cigni eboz'a, - zurgs ukan moisrola allahis cigni, vit`omc` ar ic`odnen (misi shinaarsi).

- da gahqvnen imas, rasac` uqvebodnen satanebi suleimanis samep`os shesaxeb. - suleimani ki ar qop`ila urcmuno (jadosani), - satanebi iqvnen urcmunoni. isini xalxs ascavlidnen jadosnobasa da imas, rac` or angelozs - harut`sa da marut`s ch`amoevlinat` babilonshi. es orni ar ascavlidnen ise aravis, t`u ar etqodnen, rom cheshmaritad, ch`ven vart` sac`durad da (jadosnobis shescavlit`) nu ik`c`evit` urcmunoebado. xalxi mat`gan imas scavlobda, rac` gaashorebda kac`s t`avisi c`olisgan. - veravis avnebdnen amit` isini, rom ara - neba allahisa. isini scavlobdnen imas, rac` mavne iqo mat`t`vis da ar qop`ila sargeblis momtani. vp`ic`av, mat` ic`odnen, rom amas vinc` sheiz'enda, aranairi xvedri ar ergeboda mas imk`veqnad. neta sc`odnodat`, t`u ra c`udia is, ris sanac`vlodac` gaqides sulebi, t`aviant`i;
neta sc`odnodat`, rom rcmena da ridi t`u ek`nebodat`, - allahis cinashe damsaxurebuli madli ut`uod uket`esia.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`, ag'ar carmot`k`vat` sitqva,,ra'inaa" (dagvmcqemse), aramed t`k`vit` -,,unzurnaa" (shemogvxede da ch`veni mdgomareoba gait`valiscine) da sheisminet`, xolo urcmunot`at`vis - mcare sasjelia.

ar isurveben isini, vinc` ar ircmuna cignboz'ebult`agan da arc` carmart`ni, rom t`k`venze siket`e ch`amoevlinos t`k`veni g'mert`isgan. allahi ki mxolod mas miakut`vnebs t`avis cqalobas, visac` moisurvebs. - allahia mp`lobeli udidesi cqalobisa.
romel aiat`sac` vauk`mebt`/vc`vlit` an vavicqebinebt`, ch`ven mogvak`vs xolme imis scori an masze uket`esi. gana ar ic`odi, rom allahi namdvilad qovlisshemz'lea?!
gana ar ic`i, rom mart`lac` allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da dedamicis xelmcip`eba? - ase rom, aravinaa t`k`veni k`omagi da damxmare, garda allahisa.
an ik`neb gsurt`, rom (uadgilo da p`uchi) kit`xvebi dausvat` t`k`vens shuamavals ise, - ucin rom musas ekit`xebodnen? - ut`uod, scor gzas asc`ildes igi, vinc` rcmena gac`valos urcmunoebashi.

bevria msurveli cignboz'ebult`agan, rom t`k`veni rcmenis shemdgom (isev) urcmunoebad ukugak`c`ion, t`aviant` sulebshi damkvidrebuli shuris gamo - cheshmariteba rom gauc`xaddat`. mash, miutevet` da ganeridet`, vidre ar mova brz'aneba allahisa. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
sheasrulet` namazi, gaec`it` zek`at`i da, t`k`veni sulebist`vis ra siket`esac` cinascar gaimzadebt`, - imasve hpovebt` allahis cinashe. cheshmaritad, allahi xedavs, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
da t`k`ves: veravin sheva samot`xeshi, garda imisa, vinc`aa iudeveli an nazarevelio. es mxolod oc`nebaa mat`i. ut`xari:,, t`uki namdvilad gulcrp`elni xart`, mash, moitanet` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebani''.

pirik`it`: - mist`vis, vinc` allahs daumorch`ila mt`eli t`avisi pirovnuloba da vinc` t`avad ars ket`ilmok`medi, - scored mist`visaa jildo t`avisi g'mert`is cinashe da arc` shishi ek`neba, arc`a mcuxareba.

aranair cheshmaritebas ar adganan nazarevelnio, - t`k`ves iudevelebma; aranair cheshmaritebas ar adganan iudevelnio, - t`k`ves nazarevelebmac`. arada isini (g'vt`iur) cigns kit`xuloben (sadac` msgavsi arap`eri uceriat`) da, mat`i sitqvis msgavsad imat`ma t`k`ves, - romelt`ac` arap`eri ic`ian (g'vt`iuri cignebis shesaxeb c`odna ar miug'iat`)... da gankit`xvis dg'es allahi gansjis mat` shoris imas, rashic` ut`anxmoebdnen.

vinaa imaze up`ro usamart`lo, romelic` abrkolebs samloc`veloebshi, rom ik` allahis saxeli ixseniebodes da miiltvis mat` dasak`c`evadac`. egeni sxvanairni ver unda shediodnen masshi, t`u ara shishit` shepqrobilni da, mat`t`visaa: amk`veqnad damc`ireba da imk`veqnad - sasjeli udidesi.
allahisaa ag'omsavlet`ic`a da dasavlet`ic` da, sait`kenac` mimobrundebit`, - ik` hpovebt` (kmaqop`il) saxes allahisa, cheshmaritad, - allahia qovlismc`odne, uuxvescqalobiani.
da t`k`ves: allahma shvili iqoliao. is qovlad unakloa! - pirik`it`, - misia qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da dedamicaze; mas udreks k`eds qovelive;
- gamch`enelia c`at`a da dedamicisa da ris k`mnasac` gadacqvets, mas mxolod etqvis -,,iqav" da mashinve ik`neba.

da t`k`ves mat`, romelt`ac` arap`eri ic`odnen: ch`ven dagvlaparakeboda allahi an ert`i aiat`i mainc` mogvsvlodao. mat`ze adre mqop`nic` ase ambobdnen, amgvari sitqvebit`, da mat`i gulebic` - ert`manet`s daemsgavsnen... - mart`lac` nat`elvqavit` ch`ven aiat`ebi - g'rmadmorcmune xalxisat`vis.
uechvelad, ch`ven cargagzavnet` shen cheshmaritebit`, - xarebada da gap`rt`xilebad da, ar mogekit`xeba shen - c`ec`xlis binadart`a shesaxeb.

arc` iudevelni da arc` nazarevelni ar ik`nebian shenit` kmaqop`ilni, - vidre imat` rjuls ar gahqvebi. ut`xari:,,cheshmaritad, allahis mier mit`it`ebuli gzaa - gza cheshmariti". vp`ic`av, t`uki dahqvebi imat` gemovnebas mas shemdeg, rac` c`odna mogivida, - ar geqoleba shen allahisgan arc`a k`omagi, arc`a damxmare.
imat`, - vist`visac` cigni gviboz'ebia da g'irseuli kit`xvit` kit`xuloben mas, - scored imat` scamt` misi, xolo romelnic` uarqop`en, - egeni arian cagebulni.
ei, modgmav israelisa! ch`emi cqaloba gaixsenet`, romelic` t`k`vent`vis miboz'ebia, roc`a me t`k`ven samqarot`a cinashe gamogarch`iet`.
da ridi gk`ondet` im dg'isa, roc`a suli sxva suls verap`ershi emagivreba, arc` misi shuamdgomloba miig'eba, arc`a sadamxsnelo da verc` sxvisgan miig'ebs daxmarebas.

aki, zogi sitqvit`/brz'anebit` gamosc`ada ibrahimi t`avisma g'mert`ma da manac` sheasrula isini. g'mert`ma ut`xra: cheshmaritad, me shen dagadgen xalxis cinamz'g'vrado. ibrahimma ut`xra (st`xova) - ch`emi sht`amomavlebidanac`o (daadgineo). g'mert`ma miugo:,,ch`emi ag't`k`ma ar exeba usamart`lot`".

aki, es saxli (k`aaba) xalxis t`avsheqrisa da usap`rt`xoebis adgilad davadginet`, mash, ibrahimis nadgomidan daidginet` samloc`velo. da ch`ven davavalet` ibrahimsa da isma'ils, rom ch`emi saxli ganecmindat`(kerpebisgan) imat`t`vis, vinc` tavap`s aket`ebs, g'vt`ismasuxebas miec`a an ruk`ug'it`a da sejdet`ia dakavebuli.

aki, t`k`va ibrahimma: g'mert`o, ak`c`ie es (mek`k`a) usap`rt`xo k`alak`ad da misi mkvidrni asazrdove (sxvadasxva) xileulit`, isini, vinc` allahsa da ukanasknel dg'es ircmunebeno. g'mert`ma miugo: mc`iredit` imat`ac` vasargebleb, romelt`ac` (rcmena) uarqves, mere ki c`ec`xlis sasjelshi shesvlas vaiz'uleb... da ra c`udi samqop`elia mat`i saboloo misak`c`ieli.
aki, ibrahimi da isma'ili rom saxlis (k`aabas) saz'irkvlebs amag'lebdnen (t`an ambobdnen): g'mert`o ch`veno, miig'e es ch`vengan, - cheshmaritad, shena xar qovlismsmeni, qovlismc`odneo.

g'mert`o ch`veno! dae, gvamqop`e (ch`ven orni) shenda morch`ilnad/muslimebad da shendami morch`ili/muslimi amqop`e t`emi - ch`veni sht`amomavlebisac`, gvich`vene ch`veni movaleobebi da mogviteve ch`ven, cheshmaritad, shena xar mimtevebeli da mcqalobeli.

g'mert`o ch`veno! cargzavne mat`t`an shuamavali mat`ive cridan, vinc` caukit`xavs shens aiat`ebs, ascavlis cignsa da sibrz'nes da gancmindavs mat`. cheshmaritad, shena xar z'levamosili, brz'ent`a brz'eni.
da vin ganudga ibrahimis rjuls, t`u ara is, vinc` ugunurad moek`c`a suls t`avisives? vp`ic`av, ch`ven is amk`veqnad amovarch`iet` da usat`uod, is imk`veqnadac` sat`not`agania.
aki, mas ut`xra t`avisma g'mert`ma: iqavi morch`ilio/muslimio. man miugo: morch`ili/muslimi var samqarot`a g'mert`isao.

amit`ve daariga t`avisi shvilebi ibrahimma da ia'qubmac`:,,ei, ch`emo z'eno! cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`vis allahma (islamis) rjuli amoarch`ia, dae, nu mokvdebit` ise, rom t`k`ven ar iqot` muslimebi/morch`ilebi".

nut`u mocmeni iqavit`, roc`a sikvdili ecvia ia'qubs? - rodesac` ut`xra t`avis shvilebs - vis et`aqvanebit` ch`ems shemdego? (mat`) miuges: ch`ven (mxolod) shens g'mert`s vet`aqvanebit`, - g'mert`s sheni mama-papisa, ibrahimis, isma'ilis da ishaqisa; - g'mert`s ert`adert`isa, da ch`ven misi morch`ilni/muslimni vart`o.
eg aris t`emi - ac gardasuli. mat`ia is, rac` moixveches da t`k`venia is, rac` moixvechet`. ar mogekit`xebat` t`k`ven is, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen.
da t`k`ves:,,iqavit` iudevelni an nazarevelni, rom daadget` gzas cheshmaritebisa". ut`xari: - pirik`it`, - (unda iqo) hanip`i, ibrahimis rjulis mimdevari! is ar qop`ila carmart`t`aganio.

ut`xarit`: vircmunet` allahi da is, rac`, ch`venze ch`amoevlina, aseve, rac` ibrahims, isma'ils, ishaqs, ia'qubs da (mis) sht`amomavlobas ch`amoevlina, rac` musasa da 'isas miec`at`, aseve, rac` mac`neebs miec`at` - t`aviant`i g'mert`isagan; mat`gan arc`ert`s ar ganvasxvavebt` da ch`ven misi morch`ilni/muslimebi vart`o.

t`u ise ircmunes, rogorc` t`k`vena gcamt` misi, mashin namdvilad cheshmarit gzas dasdgomian, xolo t`u piri ibrunes, uechvelad, did c`ilobashi ik`nebian. imat` cinashe - shent`vis allahi sakmarisia, ramet`u isaa qovlismsmeneli, qovlismc`odne.
allahis sag'ebavi... - aba, vinaa sag'ebavis mp`lobeli - mjobni allahisaze? da ch`ven vart` - misi mot`aqvaneni.

ut`xari: nut`u allahis (da misi rjulis) shesaxeb gvekamat`ebit`, is xom ch`veni da t`k`veni g'mert`ia? ch`venia ch`veni namok`medari da t`k`veni - t`k`veni namok`medari, xolo ch`ven - misi ert`gulni vart`o.

ik`neb ambobt`, rom ibrahimi, isma'ili, ishaqi, ia'qubi da (misi) sht`amomavlebi - iudevelni an nazarevelni iqvnen? ut`xari:,,t`k`ven uket` ic`it` t`u allahma"? vinaa imaze usamart`lo, vinc`a mocmoba damala, romelic` allahisgan iqo mast`an? xolo allahi araa ugulisquro imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
eg aris t`emi - ac gardasuli. mat`ia is, rac` moixveches da t`k`venia is, rac` moixvechet`. ar mogekit`xebat` t`k`ven is, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen.

xalxt`agan chkuasustni itqvian: ram sheabruna isini t`aviant`i qiblisgan, romliskenac` iqvnen mimart`ulni? miuge:,,allahisaa ag'mosavlet`ic`a da dasavlet`ic`; visac` moisurvebs, mas daakvalianebs gzisken - cheshmariti".

da amgvarad, zomier t`emad gak`c`iet`, rat`a mocmeni iqot` xalxis shesaxeb da shuamavalic` - t`k`vens shesaxeb iqos mocme. sxva arap`rist`vis dagvidgenia is qibla, romliskenac` iqavit` mimart`ulni, - t`u ara imist`vis, rom nat`elgveqo: vin damqolia shuamavlisa da vin - ukan mibrunda, t`avisive k`uslebis mimrt`ulebit` (urcmunoebashi). didi sirt`ulea igi ut`uod, t`umc`a ara imat`t`vis, vinac` allahma cheshmariti gzit` daakvaliana. allahi ar dagikargavt` t`k`vens rcmenas, cheshmaritad, allahi adamianebis mimart` usazg'vrod mcqalobeli da shembralebelia.

ra t`k`ma unda, ch`ven vxedavt` sheni saxis zec`isken mimobrunebas da, rag'a t`k`ma unda, - migabrunebt` qiblisken, romlit`ac` kmaqop`ili ik`nebi. mash, aci saxe mesjidi haramisken miak`c`ie; sadac` ar unda imqop`ebodet`, - (loc`vis dros) t`k`veni saxeebi misi mimart`ulebit` miapqarit`! da isini, romelt`ac` cigni eboz'at`, zustad ucqian, rom esuzustesi cheshmaritebaa mat`i g'mert`isgan, xolo allahi ugulisquro araa imis mimart`, rasac` isini aket`eben.

da vp`ic`av, qvela mtkic`ebuleba romc` ach`veno, mainc` ar mihqvebian shens qiblas cignboz'ebulni; arc` shena xar mat`i qiblis mimqoli; arc` ert`manet`is qiblas mihqvebian isini; vp`ic`av, t`uki ahqvebi imat` gemovnebas imis shemdeg, rac` ukve c`odnit` ag'ichurve, mashin, ut`ud, shen ik`nebi usamart`lot`agani.
isini, romelt`ac` cigni vuboz'et`, ise ic`noben mas, rogorc` sakut`ar shvilebs ic`noben. uechvelad, mat`gan zogiert`i shegnebulad malavs cheshmaritebas.
cheshmariteba sheni g'mert`isganaa da ar iqo imat`gani, vinc` orchop`obs.

qvelas t`avisi mxare (qibla) ak`vs, romliskenac` saxes miak`c`evs. mash, siket`isqop`ashi sheejibret` ert`manet`s. qvelas ert`ad shegkrebt` allahi, sadac` ar unda imqop`ebodet`; - cheshmaritad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea.

sadac` ar unda gaxvide (gzashi mqop`ma), saxe mimart`e mesjidi haramisken (loc`visas), - uechvelad, cheshmaritebaa igi sheni g'mert`isgan da allahic` - ugulisquro araa imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

sadac` ar unda gaxvide (gzashi mqop`ma), saxe mimart`e mesjidi haramis mxares (loc`visas) da sadac` ar unda iqot`, - misken miak`c`iet` t`k`veni saxeebi, rat`a (sakamat`o) sababi ag'ar hk`ondes xalxs t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg, garda imat`i, vinc` mat` shoris usamart`loa, da ar sheushindet` mat`, (mxolod) ch`emi geshinodet`, rat`a srulvqo ch`emi cqaloba t`k`vendami... da ik`neb cheshmarit gzas dasdgomodit` t`k`ven.

- rogorc` carmovgzavnet` t`k`vent`an shuamavlad ert`-ert`i t`k`venganive, romelic` gikit`xavt` ch`vens aiat`ebs, gcmendt` (qovelgvari uket`urebisgan) da gascavlit` cignsa da sibrz'nes, - gascavlit` imas, rac` ar ic`odit`.
mash, gamixsenet` da gagixsenebt`; memadlieret` da ar meumadurot`!
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! mot`minebit`a da namazit` ez'iet` g'vt`isshemceoba; - namdvilad, allahi momt`menebt`an ert`adaa.
da nu moixseniebt` mkvdrebad imat`, vinc` allahis gzaze daig'upnen. pirik`it`, isini c`oc`xlebi arian, t`umc`a t`k`ven ver gaac`nobierebt`.
vp`ic`av, ch`ven rag'ac`it` auc`ileblad gamogc`dit`: shishit`, shimshilit`, k`onebis, sult`a da naqop`t`a naklulobit`; - momt`ment` ki axare.
- romlebic` t`avs damtqdari ubedurebis zhams amboben: cheshmaritad, ch`ven allahs vekut`vnit` da ut`uod, ch`ven isev mas mivbardebit`o.
ai, egeni arian, viszec`aa mat`i g'mert`is loc`vani da cqaloba, da scored egeni arian cheshmarit gzaze mdgarni.

cheshmaritad, sap`a da merva allahis (morch`ilebis) nishant`agannia. vinc` (k`aabas cminda) saxls ecveva hajobisa an 'umrast`vis, imist`vis c`odva ar ik`neba am oriveze (ces-ch`veulebisamebr) garsshemovla, xolo vinc` t`avisi survilit` izams siket`es, cheshmaritad, allahi madlieria, qovlismc`odnea.

uechvelad, mat`, vinc` ch`ven mier ch`amovlenil c`xad mtkic`ebulebebsa da cheshmarit gzas malaven mas shemdeg, rac` xalxs cignshi ganvumartet` igi, - scored mat` scqevlis allahi da scqevlian macqevarni.
- imat` garda, vinc` moinanies (shec`domebi), gamoascores da gamoaashkaraves (rasac` malavdnen). ai, imat` mivuteveb, radganac` me var mimtevebeli da mcqalobeli.
uechvelad, imat`ze, vinc` ar ircmunes da urcmunoebadve daixoc`nen, - ai, scored imat`zea cqevla allahisa, angelozebisa da adamianebisa, qvelasi.
- mudmivad masshi ik`nebian. mat` arc` sasjeli sheumsubuk`debat` da arc` shesvenebas daac`dian.
da g'mert`i t`k`veni - ert`i g'mert`ia. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - mocqalisa, mcqalobelisa.

uechvelad, - c`at`a da dedamicis gach`enashi, dg'et`a da g'amet`a mimok`c`evashi, xalxis saket`ildg'eod zg'vad mimomc`urav gemebshi da imashic`, allahma rom c`idan cqlad ch`amoasxura da imis sikvdilis shemdeg misit` rom mica gamoac`oc`xla da qovelgvari suldgmuli masze mimop`ina, da c`asa da dedamicas shoris mimomk`rol k`arebsa da morch`ilad mimomsvlel g'rublebshi - nadmvilad sascaulebia gonieri xalxist`vis.

adamiant`a shoris arian iset`nic`, vinc` daidgines sxva t`anaziarnic`, garda allahisa, da ise uqvart` isini, rogorc` uqvart` allahi; xolo vinc` ircmunes, mat` uqvart` allahi - zeag'savsebit`. neta imat`, vinc` usamart`lod ik`c`evian, (ak`ve) - daenaxat` mt`eli z'alaup`leba, rogorc` sasjelis mig'ebisas dainaxeven. uechvelad, allahi mz'imesasjelosania.
roc`a isini, visac` hmorch`ilebdnen, ganudgebian imat`, vinac` hmorch`ilebdnen; sasjels ixilaven da mat`i kavshirebic` daimsxvreva, -

mashin, vinc` hmorch`ilebdnen, isini amoiz'axeben: neta gvk`onoda ukan dabrunebis shesaz'lebloba da mat`gan t`avi shors dagvechira, rogorc` t`vit`on gangvidgneno. allahi imat` amgvarad uch`venebs t`aviant` namok`medars - mat`ive sananeblad, magram ver gamoag'ceven isini c`ec`xlidan.
ei, adamianebo! chamet` is, rac` sup`t`a da halalia dedamicaze da ar gahqvet` satanis nakvalevs, uechvelad, ashkara mteria is t`k`veni.
- is gibrz'anebt` mxolod avzneobasa da uket`urebas, da allahis shesaxeb imis t`k`mas, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`.

da roc`a mat` ut`xres: mihqevit` imas, rac` allahma ch`amoavlinao, miuges: aranairad! - ch`ven mivqvebit` imas, razedac` vpovet` ch`veni mamebio... - gana mainc`, mat` mamebs rom arap`eri gaegebodet` da arc` cheshmarit gzaze idgnen?
urcmunot`a mdgomareoba hgavs imis magalit`s, vinc` imas uqviris, visac` arap`eri esmis, garda moxmobisa da z'axilis gauazrebeli xmebisa. qruni, munjni da brmani - egeni ver azrovneben.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! miirt`vit` is, rac` sup`t`aa (halali) da sazrdod gvicqalobebia t`k`vent`vis, da madliereba gamoxatet` allahis mimart`, t`u xart` t`k`ven misi t`aqvanismc`emelni.

is gikrz'alavt` mxolod leshs, sisxlsa da g'oris xorc`s, da imasac`, rac` sxvist`vis daikla, garda allahisa; xolo vinc` iz'ulebuli sheik`mnas da ar iurch`os da ar gadaametos, - mas c`odvad ar ek`mnas (akrz'alulis chama). cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobelia.

uechvelad, isini, vinc` malaven imas, rac` allahma ch`amoavlina cignit` da umc`ires sap`asurs g'ebuloben amit`, - ai, isini sxva verap`rit` amoiz'g'oben muc`lebs, garda c`ec`xlisa. amitom gankit`xvis dg'es ar daelaparakeba, ar gancmends mat` allahi... da mcare sasjeli - mat`t`vis!
egeni arian, vinc` gzaac`deniloba iqides cheshmariti gzis p`asad da sasjeli - shecqalebis p`asad... da ra momt`menebi qop`ilan c`ec`xlis mimart`!
- es imist`vis (daimsaxures), rom allahma cigni cheshmaritebit` ch`amoavlina, xolo isini, vinc` (am) cignis t`aobaze ut`anxmoeben, mart`lac` ushori-shores c`ilobashi imqop`ebian.

siket`e is ki araa, rom ag'mosavlet`it` an dasavlet`it` miak`c`iot` t`k`veni saxeebi, aramed isaa siket`e: vinc` ircmuna allahi, dg'e ukanaskneli, angelozebi, cigni, mac`neebi, da miuxedavad imisa, rom z'lier uqvars k`oneba, - mainc` urigebs - nat`esavebs, oblebs, g'atakebs, mgzavrebsa da mat`xovrebs, da gaig'eben tqveebis gamosasqidadac`; ag'asruleben namazs, gasc`emen zek`at`s da ert`guloben ag't`k`mas - rodesac` deben pirobas, da momt`menni arian - gasachirisa, avadmqop`obisa da omis sirt`uleebisa. ai, egeni arian ert`gulni da g'vt`ismoshishni.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! valdebulebad dacerilia t`k`venze - qisasi (saigiveo) moklult`at`vis: t`avisup`ali t`avisup`lis cil, mona monis cil, k`ali k`alis cil. xolo visac` imisi z'misgan (moklulis chirisup`lisgan) epatios, - misi valia ket`ilad morch`ileba da sauket`eso saxit` anazg'aureba. es cqaloba da shemsubuk`ebaa t`k`veni g'mert`isgan, xolo amis shemdeg vinc` zg'vars gadava da usamart`lod moik`c`eva, - mcare sasjeli mist`vis.
ei, gonierno! t`k`vent`vis sic`oc`xlea saigiveos cesit` dasjadobashi (qisasi), - ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`.

t`k`venda savaldebulod dacerilia, rom t`u romelime t`k`vengani, sikvdilmoceuli (momakvdavi), tovebs sakmao k`onebas, - gonivrulad uanderz'os (dautovos) igi mshoblebsa da nat`esavebs; - valia es, g'vt`ismoshisht`a.
da vinc` mas shec`vlis imis shemdeg, rac` ukve moismina, uechvelad, - mat` ekisrebat` amis c`odva, vinc` mas shec`vlian. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.

xolo vinc` shishobs moanderz'is mxridan (unebur) shec`domaze an usamart`lobaze da mat` shoris arsebul gaurkvevlobas gamoascorebs, - mas (es) c`odvad ar daekisros. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`k`venda savaldebulod dacerilia marxva, - rogorc` dacerila t`k`venze adre mqop`t`at`vis, ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`.

(es marxva) gansazg'vruli dg'eebia, da t`u romelime t`k`vengani avad an mgzavrad mqop`ia, man imdenive dg'e sxva dg'eebshi imarxos; xolo mat`, visac` g'one shescevt` masze (magram ar marxuloben), gamosasqidad ekisrebat` upovart`a dapureba; xolo vinc` damatebit` (dakisrebulze charb) ik`ms siket`es, es mist`visaa uket`esi... da rom ic`odet`: t`u imarxavt`, es t`k`vent`vis ik`neba umjobesi.

ramadanis mt`varea is, romelshic` qurani ch`amoevlina - adamiant`at`vis cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad da scori gzis (mrudesgan) ganmasxvavebel c`xad mtkic`ebulebad. vinc` moescros am mt`vares t`k`vengan, - marxvit` gaataros igi, xolo vinc` avad an mgzavrad mqop`ia, man imdenive dg'e sxva dg'eebshi imarxos. ar unda allahs t`k`vent`vis siz'nele, - mas sheg'avat`i surs t`k`vent`vis, rat`a (iolad) ag'asrulebdet` gat`vlili odenobit` (gansazg'vrul dg'eebshi) da allahs ganadidebdet` imist`vis, rit`ac` cheshmarit gzaze dagaqenat`, ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit`.

da t`u ch`emi msaxurni ch`ems shesaxeb gkit`xaven, (ut`xari, rom) - cheshmaritad, me axlos var, shevismen mavedreblis vedrebas, roc`a shemt`xovs. mash, misminon me da scamdet` ch`emi, ik`neb scor gzas daadgnen.

marxvis g'ameebshi neba dagert`ot` t`k`vens k`alebt`an siaxlovisa. isini samoselnia t`k`veni da t`k`venc` samoselni xart` mat`i. allahma ic`oda, rom sakut`ar sulebs ug'alatebdit` (t`u nebas ar dagrt`avdit`, mainc` iurt`iert`ebdit`) t`k`ven, amitom miig'o t`k`veni sinanuli da mogitevat`. aci shegiz'liat` et`anac`xovrot` mat` da ez'iot` igi, rac` allahma dagicerat`. chamet` da svit`, vidre gant`iadis t`et`ri z'ap`i shavi z'ap`isagan ganirch`eodes t`k`vent`vis da shemdeg sag'amomde marxva daic`avit`, da nu et`anac`xovrebit` mat`, roc`a t`k`ven i't`ik`ap`s asrulebt` mech`et`ebshi... - eseni allahis sazg'vrebia da nu miuaxlovdebit` mat`. ase ganumartavs allahi xalxs t`avis aiat`ebs, rom ik`neb ridi hk`ondet` mat`.

ar sheuchamot` ert`manet`s k`oneba usamart`lod da ar mimart`ot` misi (k`rt`amis) gamoqenebit` mosamart`leebs - imist`vis, rom miit`visot` xalxis k`onebis nacili borotebit`, - ise, rom ic`odet` (rom es haramia).

gekit`xebian shen naxevarmt`varet`a shesaxeb. ut`xari, rom igia drois sazomi xalxist`vis da hajobist`vis. sat`noeba is ki araa, ukana mxridan shexvidet` saxlebshi, aramed sat`nod is ik`c`eva, vinc` mokrz'alebulia. amitom saxlebshi shesasvleli karidan shedit` da allahis ridi gk`ondet`, rat`a bedniereba hpovot`.
allahis gzaze eomet` imat`, vinc` t`k`ven geomebat`, magram zg'vars ar gadaxvidet`, cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars zg'vargadasulni.

sadac` caacqdebit`, ik`ve daxoc`et` da gaqaret` ik`idan, saidanac` t`vit`on gamogqares, - p`it`na uaresia, vidre daxoc`va, da ar eomot` mat` mesjidi haramt`an, vidre t`vit`on ar geomon ik`, xolo t`u isini dagicqeben xoc`vas, mashin t`k`venc` - daxoc`et`. aset`ia urcmunot`a sasjeli.
- xolo t`u shecqveten (p`it`nas), cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
da manam eomet` mat`, vidre ar ag'moip`xvreba p`it`na da mt`lianad allahs ar miez'g'vneba sarcmunoeba, xolo t`u shecqveten (p`it`nas), mashin mtrobac` ag'ar gagrz'eldes, garda usamart`lot`a mimart`.

nakrz'ali mt`vare nakrz'ali mt`varis samagieroa, nakrz'alt`a darg'veva ki qisass sachiroebs. vinc` t`k`ven shemogiteven, t`k`venc` igivenairad sheutiet`, rogorc` t`vit`on shemogities. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom cheshmaritad, allahi g'vt`ismoshishebt`anaa.
xarjet` allahis gzaze da damg'upvel sap`rt`xeshi ar ch`aigdot` t`avi t`k`venive xelit` da siket`e aket`et`, cheshmaritad, allahs uqvars ket`ilmorcmuneni.

mash, ag'asrulet` hajoba da 'umra allahist`vis, xolo t`u rame dagabrkolebt`(mgzavrobisas), mashin shesaciri saklavi gagzavnet`, romelic` geadvilebat`, da ar gaiparsot` t`avi manamde, vidre ag'srulebis adgils ar miag'cevs shesaciri, xolo visac` t`avis ch`ivili ak`vs an avadaa (da gadaiparsavs), man marxvit`, mocqalebit` an shecirvit` gamoisqidos, da t`u t`avs igrz'nobt` usap`rt`xod da romelime t`k`vengani hajobamde 'umras sheasrulebs, man shesaciri daklas, romelic` eadvileba, xolo vinc` (shesaciris saxsrebi) ver hpovos, man sruli at`i dg'e imarxos: sami hajobis dg'eebshi da shvidi - roc`a dabrundeba (shin). es mat`t`visaa, visi ojaxic` ar c`xovrobs mesjidi haramt`an. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom uechvelad, allahi mkac`rsasjeliania.

hajoba garkveul mt`vareebshia. vinc` mat`shi hajoba itvirt`os (ihramis shemosvit`), man ar miuaxlovdes k`als, ar iurch`os da ar ich`xubos hajobisas. ra siket`esac` ik`mt`, - ic`is allahma. mash, sagzali gaimzadet`, cheshmaritad, g'vt`ismoshishobaa sagzali sauket`eso. ei, gonierno, ch`emi ridi gk`ondet`.

c`odvad ar dagedot`, t`k`veni g'mert`is cqaloba t`u ez'iet` (hajobisas vachrobit`), xolo roc`a 'arap`at`idan gaemart`ebit`, mash'ari haramt`an (nakrz'al nishnult`an) allahi axsenet`. mash, axsenet` igi, rogorc` uch`venebia t`k`vent`vis, ramet`u manamde t`k`ven iqavit` gzaac`denilni;
shemdeg gaemart`et` ik`it`ken, sait`ac` xalxi miemart`eba da patieba shest`xovet` allahs. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.

roc`a morch`ebit` t`k`vens ces-ch`veulebebs, mashin axsenet` allahi ise, rogorc` t`k`vens mamebs axsenebdit`, an up`ro amag'lebulad. adamiant`a shoris bevria iset`i, vinc` ambobs: g'mert`o ch`veno, mogvmadle (siket`e) amk`veqnado, da mas arap`eri ergeba imk`veqnad.
da mat` shoris bevria iset`ic`, vinc` ambobs:,,g'mert`o ch`veno, mogvmadle siket`e amk`veqnad da siket`e - imk`veqnadac`, da dagvip`are satanjvelisgan c`ec`xlisa".
scored mat`t`visaa xvedri imisa, rac` moig'vaces, da allahi mscrap`langarishmgebia.

da axsenet` allahi gat`vlil dg'eebshi. vinc` ich`k`aros da or dg'eshi daasrulos (minashi ag'savleni g'vt`ismsaxurebani), mas c`odvad ar daedos, da vinc` gadados (mesame dg'ist`vis), arc` mas daedos c`odvad. es mist`vis, visac` ridi ak`vs allahisa. ic`odet`, rom mis cinashe ik`nebit` shekrebilni, usat`uod.
adamiant`a shoris bevria iset`ic`, visi sitqvebic` gxiblavs amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis shesaxeb da (vinc`) allahs imocmebs imaze, rac` mis gulshia, arada igi qvelaze ulmobelia mtrobashi.
- da gac`list`anave uket`urebas escrap`vis k`veqnad da c`dilobs, gaanadguros nat`esic`a da sht`amomavalic`. allahs ar uqvars uket`ureba.
da roc`a etqvian -,,geshinodes allahisa", - c`odva sheipqrobs ampartavnebit`urt`. mist`vis jojoxet`i sakmarisia! - da ra c`udi sarec`elia igi.
da adamiant`a shoris bevria iset`ic`, vinc` t`avis sulsac` ki gaig'ebs -allahis kmaqop`ilebis molodinit`. allahi t`avis msaxurt`a mimart` usazg'vrod mcqalobeli da shembralebelia.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! shedit` islamis srul morch`ilebashi da nu gahqvebit` eshmakis nakvalevs. uechvelad, igi ashkara mteria t`k`veni.
t`u (morch`ilebis gzidan) mainc` gadauk`c`evt` imis shemdeg, rac` ukve c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi mogividat`, mashin ic`odet`, rom cheshmaritad, allahi uz'levelia, brz'enia.
nut`u marto imas moelian, rom allahi gamoec`xadebat` g'rubelt`a sach`rdilobelshi, da angelozebic`, - rat`a ganech`inos mat`i sak`meni? - sak`me qoveli allahs ubrundeba!
hkit`xe israelis modgmas, t`u ramdeni c`xadi aiat`i/sascauli gviboz'ebia mat`t`vis, da vinc` c`vlis allahis cqalobas, mas shemdeg, rac` miuvida igi, - cheshmaritad, allahi mkac`rsasjeliania.

vinc` ar ircmunes, - amk`veqniuri c`xovreba shemkobilia (mimzidvelia) mat`t`vis da vinc` ircmunes, masxrad igdeben mat`gan zogiert`s, da gankit`xvis dg'es amag'ldebian mat`ze isini, vinc` g'vt`ismoshishia, da visac` inebebs, allahi ucqalobebs sazrdos - ganuzomels.

kac`obrioba iqo ert`iani t`emi, shemdeg allahma mac`neebi cargzavna - maxaroblebad da gamap`rt`xileblebad, da cigni ch`amoavlina mat`t`an cheshmaritebit`, rat`a adamianebs shoris ganesaja is, rashic` ut`anxmoebdnen, da sxva aravin ut`anxmoebda mat`shi arsebuli shuris gamo, t`u ara isini, visac` eboz'at` igi mas shemdeg, rac` miuvidat` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi. allahma morcmuneebs t`avisi nebit` scori mimart`uleba uch`vena im cheshmaritebisken, razec` isini ut`anxmoebdnen... da cheshmarit gzaze, visac` inebebs, - allahi imas daakvalianebs.

nut`u ggoniat`, rom samot`xeshi shexvalt` ise, rom ar mogescrebat` imis msgavsi, rac` t`k`venze adre mqop`t` moescrot`? - mat` t`avs daatqdat` ubedureba da ziani, da (ise) sheirqnen, rom shuamavali da mast`an ert`ad morcmuneebi ambobdnen:,,rodis ik`neba allahis daxmareba?"... da ic`odet`, rom allahis shecevna axlosaa.

gekit`xebian shen, t`u ra gaig'on mocqalebad, - miuge: ra mocqalebac` gaig'ot` k`onebis saxit`, - is iqos mshobelt`a, axlobelt`a, obolt`a, g'atakt`a da mgzavrt`at`vis; ra mocqalebac` gaig'ot` siket`is saxit`, - cheshmaritad, ic`is is allahma.

t`k`venda savaldebulod dacerilia omi, arada is mouconaria t`k`vent`vis, magram shesaz'loa, ar mogcondet` rag'ac` da is sasargeblo iqos t`k`vent`vis, da shesaz'loa, giqvardet` rag'ac` da is saziano iqos t`k`vent`vis. allahma ic`is, t`k`ven ki ar ic`it`.

gekit`xebian shen nakrz'al mt`vareshi omis shesaxeb, - miuge: masshi omi didi c`odvaa; (magram) allahis gzidan (xalxis) c`duneba/dabrkoleba; mis mimart` da mesjidi haramis mimart` urcmunoeba da ik`idan mis mkvidrt`a gaz'eveba - up`ro didi c`odvebia allahis cinashe, - p`it`na up`ro didi c`odvaa, vidre kvla. (urcmunoebi) manam ar shecqveten oms t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg, vidre t`k`veni rjulidan ar gadagiqvaneben, t`uki shez'les, da t`k`vengan vinc` t`avis rjuls gadauxvios da mokvdes urcmunod, - scored mat`i nag'vaci gadaik`c`es ushedegod - amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`. ai, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.
uechvelad, mat`, vinc` ircmunes, hijra gaaket`es da allahis gzaze ibrz'oles, - ai, mat` ak`vt` imedi allahis cqalobisa. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.

gekit`xebian shen g'vinisa da azartuli t`amashebis shesaxeb, - miuge: oriveshi aris didi c`odva da (mc`ire) sargebelic` xalxist`vis, magram c`odva up`ro didia mat`shi, vidre sargebeli; da gekit`xebian, t`u ra gaig'on mocqalebad, - upasuxe: rac` gabadiat` qoveldg'iur sachiroebebze meti. allahi ase c`xadqop`s t`k`vent`vis aiat`ebs, rom ik`neb dap`ik`rebuliqavit`.

- (allahi t`k`vent`vis c`xadqop`s aiat`ebs, rat`a gep`ik`rat`) amk`veqanasa da imk`veqnaze. da gekit`xebian shen, obolt`a shesaxeb, - upasuxe: mat`t`vis zrunva siket`ea da t`u gauert`iandebit`, - z'mebi arian t`k`veni. allahi arch`evs uket`urs ket`ilisagan da mas rom ndomoda, gagirt`ulebdat` (mat`t`an urt`iert`obas). cheshmaritad, allahi uz'levelia; brz'enia.

ar sheirt`ot` carmart`i k`alebi, vidre ar ircmuneben, - morcmune mxevali umjobesia, vidre carmart`i k`ali, t`undac` t`k`vent`vis mosaconi; da arc` carmart` kac`ebs miat`xovot`, vidre ar ircmuneben, - morcmune mona umjobesia, vidre carmart`i kac`i, t`undac` t`k`vent`vis mosaconi. isini c`ec`xlisken moucodeben, xolo allahi samot`xisa da patiebisken moucodebs t`avisi nebit`, da c`xadqop`s xalxist`vis t`avis aiat`ebs, rat`a ik`neb sheignon da ar daivicqon.

gekit`xebian shen dedat`a cesis shesaxeb, - miuge: satkivaria igi, amitom moshordit` k`alebs dedat`a cesis dros da manamde ar miuaxlovdet` mat`, vidre ar gasup`t`avdebian, xolo rodesac` ganicmindebian, mashin mat`t`an midit` ik`it`ken, sait`kenac` allahma gibrz'anat`. cheshmaritad, allahs uqvars monanulni da uqvars gancmendilnic`.

t`k`veni k`alebi sat`esia t`k`vent`vis, amitom ise eaxelit` t`k`vens sat`est`, rogorc` genebot` da t`k`veni sulebist`vis cinascar gaimzadet` (ket`ili sak`meebi). ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom mis cinashe uechvelad carsdgebit`; morcmunet` ki axare.

nu moimizezebt` allahs - siket`is ket`ebis, g'vt`ismoshishobisa da xalxshi arsebuli ut`anxmoebebis gamoscorebis dabrkolebad - t`k`veni p`ic`is gamo, romelic` allahis saxelit` daip`ic`et`. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.
ar gakisrebt` allahi pasuxismgeblobas p`uchsitqvovan (gauc`nobierebel) p`ic`ze, t`umc`a pasuxismgeblobas gakisrebt` imaze, rac` moixvecha t`k`venma gulebma. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, lmobieri.
vinc` daip`ic`on, rom t`aviant` c`olebs ag'ar et`anac`xovrebian, - mat`t`vis lodini - ot`xi t`ve, xolo t`u daubrundnen, cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
da t`u gaqra gadacqviton, cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.

k`margac`ilebulma k`alebma t`avi sheikavon (k`orcinebisgan) sami c`iklis vadit`. mat`t`vis, - t`uki scamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli, - nebadart`uli ar aris, aranairad, - imis damalva, rac` allahma gaach`ina t`aviant` sashvilosnoebshi. am droshi mat`t`an dabrunebas t`aviant`i k`mrebi up`ro imsaxureben, t`uki gamoscorebas moindomeben. mat` (c`olebs) ak`vt` garkveuli up`lebebi, imis t`anabari, rogori pasuxismgeblobebic` akisriat` (k`mrebis cinashe), t`umc`a mamakac`ebi mat`ze mag'al sap`exurs p`loben. allahi uz'levelia; brz'enia.

gaqra (ukandabrunebis up`lebamosilebit`) orjeraa (nebadart`uli). amis shemdeg (k`marma): unda sheinaxos samart`lianad anda gaushvas siket`it`. imisgan (sach`uk`rebisgan), rac` mat`t`vis (c`olebist`vis) migic`iat`, arap`ris ukan ag'eba halali ar aris t`k`vent`vis, garda im shemt`xvevisa, t`uki orive shishobs, rom ver daic`aven allahis mier dadgenil sazg'vrebs, da t`u shishoben, rom ver daic`aven allahis mier dadgenil sazg'vrebs, mashin c`odvad ar daedebat` imis gamo, rit`ac` k`alma t`avi daixsna. ai, esaa allahis mier dadgenili sazg'vrebi da nu gadalaxavt` mas. vinc` allahis mier dadgenili sazg'vrebi gadalaxes, scored isini arian usamart`loni.

xolo imis shemdeg, - t`u k`als gaeqreba (mesamedac`), - mist`vis halali ag'ar ik`neba is (ukan daibrunos), vidre sxva k`mari ar sheirt`avdes, da t`u (es kac`ic`) gaeqreba mas, mashin mat` c`odvad ag'ar daedot` ert`manet`t`an dabruneba - t`uki p`ik`roben, rom (amis shemdeg) allahis mier dadgenil sazg'vrebs daic`aven. ai, esaa allahis mier dadgenili sazg'vrebi, rasac` c`xadqop`s xalxist`vis, romlebmac` ic`ian.

rodesac` k`alebs gaeqrebit` (pirvelad an meored) da t`aviant` vadas daasruleben, - an sheinaxet` isini samart`lianad an samart`lianad gaushvit`. ar sheinaxot` isini sazianod - zg'vars rom gadaxvidet` da up`lebebi sheulaxot`. vinc` es ch`aidinos, man mart`lac` usamart`lod moek`c`es sakut`ar t`avs. masxrad ar aigdot` allahis aiat`ebi da gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba, romelic` t`k`venze moig'o da cignisa da sibrz'nis saxit` rac` ch`amoavlina t`k`vent`vis da shegonebebs gikit`xavt` misit`. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom allahi, usat`uod, - qovlismc`odnea.

rodesac` k`alebs gaeqrebit` da t`aviant` vadas daasruleben isini, mashin (k`alis meurveebma) ar shezg'udot`, rom kvlav sheirt`on t`aviant`ma (qop`ilma) k`mrebma, - t`u isev shet`anxmdebian cesisamebr da urt`iert`kmaqop`ilebas gamoxataven. shegonebaa es mat`t`vis, t`k`vengan romelt`ac` scamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli. t`k`vent`vis es cmindaa da uket`esi, da allahma ic`is, t`k`ven ki ar ic`it`.

dedebi t`aviant` shvilebs srul or celicads acoveben z'uz'us, - mat`t`vis, visac` (romel gashorebul k`marsac`) surs, rom z'uz'ut`i srulad gamoikvebos. mama valdebulia, shemosos da gamokvebos isini (k`alebi) shez'lebisdagvarad. arc`ert` suls ar ekisreba imaze meti, rac` mas sheuz'lia. arc` deda dazaraldes t`avisi shvilis gamo da arc` mama... amis msgavsi akisria (bavshvis mimart`) memkvidresac` (mamis gardac`valebis shemt`xvevashi)... da t`u imsjeleben da urt`irt`shet`anxmebit` bavshvis z'uz'udan mocqvetas isurveben oriveni, es mat` c`odvad ar daedebat`. da t`u isurvebt`, rom t`k`veni shvilebi sxvisi z'uz'ut`i gamokvebot`, arc` amit` dagedebat` c`odvad, t`uki gadauxdit` imas, rac` misac`emi gak`vt` cesisamebr. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom usat`uod, - allahi xedavs imas, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

da vinc` gardaic`vlebian t`k`vengan da ukan datoveben c`olebs, mat` (k`vrivebma) ot`xi t`ve da at`i dg'e t`avi unda sheikavon, xolo rodesac` t`aviant` vadas daasruleben, - t`k`ven c`odvad ar dagedot` imis gamo, rasac` isini t`vit`on izmen (ag'nishnuli akrz'alvebidan) cesierebis sazg'vrebshi... da allahma ic`is is, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

c`odvad ar dagedot` imis gamo, rom xelis t`xovnaze mianishnot` (gansazg'vruli - 4 t`ve da 10 dg'e - vadis gasvlamde) k`alebs an t`k`vens gulebshi gaip`ik`rot` (is). allahma ic`oda, rom t`k`ven mainc` gaixsenebdit` mat`... da arap`eri dahpirdet` p`arulad, garda imisa, rac` ut`xrat` cesierebis sazg'vrebshi, da ar moicadinot` sheug'lebis kavshiri, vidre ar dasruldeba ukve dacerili vada, da ic`odet`, rom allahma qvelap`eri ic`is, rac`aa t`k`vens sulebshi. mash, up`rt`xildit` mas da ic`odet`, rom allahi mart`lac` usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, lmobieri.

c`odvad ar dagedot`, t`u gaeqarot` k`alebs, romlebsac` jer ar shexebixart` an ar dagidgeniat` mat`t`vis mehri, magram raime sargebeli miec`it` mat`. gonivruli sargebeli rom gaig'on: shez'lebulma - t`avisi shesaz'leblobit` da g'aribmac` - t`avisi shesaz'leblobit`, - valia es ket`ilmorcmunet`a.

t`u k`alebs manamde gaeqaret`, vidre mat` sheexebodet`, magram mat`t`vis mehri ukve dadgenili gak`vt`, mashin naxevari mat`ia imisa, rac` dagidgeniat`, garda im shemt`xvevisa, t`u (k`alebi) dat`moben an dat`mobs is, vis xelshic`aa sheug'lebis naskvi. dat`moba da patieba up`ro axloa g'vt`ismoshishobast`an, da t`k`vens shoris arsebuli siket`e ar daivicqot`. cheshmaritad, allahi xedavs, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
daic`avit` namazebi da (gansakut`rbit`) shua namazi, da morch`ilad dadek`it` allahis cinashe.

da t`u shishis k`vesh imqop`ebit` (mtris, mtac`ebeli c`xovelis an msgavsisa), mashin iloc`et` p`exit` mavalma an amxedrebulma, xolo roc`a t`avs usap`rt`xod igrz'nobt`, mashin ise axsenet` allahi, rogoc` mas t`k`vent`vis uscavlebia, rac` t`k`ven adre ar ic`odit`.

da vinc` gardaic`vlebian da ukan c`olebs datoveben, - mat`gan anderz'ia t`aviant`i c`olebist`vis - ert`i clis ganmavlobashi iqvnen uzrunvelqop`ilni saxlidan gausvlelad, xolo t`uki t`vit`on gavlen, t`k`ven c`odva ar gedebat` imis gamo, rasac` isini t`vit`on izmen cesierebis sazg'vrebshi. allahi uz'levelia; brz'enia.
gashorebul k`alebs ergebat` gonivruli sargebeli da es valia g'vt`ismoshisht`a.
ase c`xadqop`s allahi t`k`vent`vis t`avis aiat`ebs, - ik`neb gons mogebuliqavit`.

nut`u ar ginaxavs isini, vinc` iqvnen at`asobit` da (shavi chirit` an omit` mosalodneli) sikvdilis shishit` t`aviant`i samsholo miatoves? mashin allahma ut`xra mat`:,,daixoc`et`!", shemdeg isev gaac`oc`xla isini. cheshmaritad, allahi mcqalobelia adamiant`a mimart`, t`umc`a adamiant`a umravlesoba umaduria.
mash, iomet` allahis gzaze da ic`odet`, rom cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.
vinaa igi, vinc` allahs asesxos sesxi - sauket`eso? shemdeg gadauxdis charbit` - ut`valavmag. kvec`avs da ganavrc`obs allahi da t`k`ven mas daubrundebit`.

nut`u ar ginaxavs mocinaveni israelis modgmidan, romlebmac` musas (gardac`valebis) shemdeg t`aviant` mac`nes ut`xres: dagvidgine mep`e, rat`a allahis gzaze viomot`o. miugo: omi rom savaldebulod dagicesdet`, siurch`es xom ar gamoich`ent` - omze uaris t`k`mit`? mat` t`k`ves:,,ra unda dagvemart`os, rom allahis gzaze ar viomot` mashin, roc`a mogvglijes ch`vens shvilebsa da samshoblos?"... da roc`a omi savaldebulod daucesdat`, mashin piri ibrunes, garda mc`irednisa, t`umc`a allahi ic`nobs usamart`loebs.

da ut`xra mat` t`aviant`ma mac`nem: cheshmaritad, t`k`ven mep`ed allahma talut`i dagidginat`o. mat` miuges:,,ch`ven rogor gvimep`ebs is, ch`ven xom masze metad vimsaxurebt` mep`obas, t`an arc` k`onebrivi siuxve mihmadlebia mas". (mac`nem) ut`xra: cheshmaritad, gamoarch`ia is t`k`venze allahma da z'lierebac` shehmata c`odnasa da sxeulshio... allahi mep`obas mas mianichebs, visac` inebebs; - allahia siuxvis momnichebeli, qovlismc`odne.

da ut`xra mat` t`aviant`ma mac`nem: cheshmaritad, misi mep`obis nishania kidobnis t`k`vent`an dabruneba, masshia t`k`veni g'mert`isgan momavali simshvide; da musasa da harunis ojaxis danatovrisgan shemorch`enilni, romelsac` angelozebi moitanen. cheshmaritad, esaa t`k`vent`vis sascauli, t`u xart` t`k`ven morcmuneni.

rodesac` talut`i jarit`urt` gamovida (k`alak`idan), t`k`va: cheshmaritad, allahi gamogc`dit` t`k`ven mdinarit`: vinc` dalevs ik`idan, is araa ch`emt`agan, xolo vinc` ert`i peshvis garda ar igemebs, scored isaa ch`emt`agano. magram mainc` dalies ik`idan, garda mat`gan mc`irednisa; da roc`a (mdinare) gadalaxa man da mast`an ert`ad mqop`ma morcmuneebmac`, - mat` t`k`ves:,,dg'es ch`ven jalut`sa da mis jarze (sherkinebis) g'one ar shegvcevs"; xolo visac` scamdat`, rom ut`uod shexvdebodnen allahs, mat` t`k`ves: allahis nebit`, ramden mc`ireric`xovan jars uz'levia mravalric`xovani jarist`viso... da allahi momt`menebt`an ert`adaa.
da roc`a jalut`sa da mis jars pirispir gauscordnen, t`k`ves: g'mert`o ch`veno! mot`minebit` ag'gvavse, p`exebi gagvimdgrade da urjulo xalxis cinaag'mdeg shegvecieo.

da allahis nebit` sz'lies mat`. mokla davudma jalut`i da allahma mas mep`oba da sibrz'ne uboz'a, aseve, ascavla is, rac` mas surda. allahs rom ar sheekavebina xalxi - zogiert`it` zogiert`i, - ut`uod uket`ureba aiklebda k`veqnierebas, magram didad mcqalobelia allahi samqarot`a mimart`.
es aris allahis aiat`ebi, rasac` shen gikit`xavt` cheshmaritebit`. cheshmaritad, shena xar shuamavalt`agani.

ai, shuamavlebi! upiratesvqavit` mat`gan zogiert`i - zogiert`is mimart`. mat` shoris arian iset`ni, visac` allahi esaubra da mat` nacils pativic` aumag'la, da meriemis z'e 'isasac` vuboz'et` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi da cminda sulit` (jibril angelozit`) ganvamtkic`et` igi. allahs rom eneba, ar daxoc`avdnen ert`manet`s mat` shemdgom mqop`ni, imis mere, rac` ukve miig'es c`xadi mtkic`ebulebani, t`umc`a ut`anxmoebashi ag'moch`ndnen, da mat` shoris arian iset`ni, vinc` ircmunes, da mat` shoris arian - vinc` uarqves. allahs rom eneba, ar daxoc`avdnen ert`manet`s isini, magram allahi ik`ms imas, rasac` inebebs.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! vidre dadgebodes dg'e, romelshic` arc` vachroba gachris, arc` megobroba da arc` shuamdgomloba, manam gaig'et` g'vt`ivsat`nod is, rac` t`k`vent`vis sarch`od gvicqalobebia. rac` sheexebat` urcmunoebs, - isini arian usamart`loni.

allahi... - ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - marad c`oc`xlisa da msup`evisa; mas arc` ch`ast`vlems, arc` ch`aez'ineba; mis kut`vnilebashia, rac`aa c`at`a shina da k`veqanasa zeda; mis cinashe vin ishuamdgomlebs misive nebis gareshe?! man ic`is, rac` iqo mat` ucin da rac` ik`neba mat` shemdgom; mis c`odnashi verap`ers shescvdebian, garda imisa, rasac` t`vit`on inebebs; misi k`ursi c`at`a da k`veqanas garemoic`avs da mas ar umz'ims dac`va mat`i; isaa uzenaesi da ubadlod didebuli.

sarcmunoebashi iz'uleba ar arsebobs, ukve gamoerch`ia cheshmariteba c`domilebisgan. xolo vinc` uarqos tag'ut`i da ircmunos allahi, is mart`lac` ch`aechidos mtkic`e rgols, romelsac` gacqveta ar uceria. allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.

allahi megobaria mat`i, bnelet`idan sinat`leshi gahqavs isini, - vinc` ircmunes, xolo vinc` ar ircmunes, mat`i megobari tag'ut`ia da sinat`elidan bnelet`isken mihqavs isini. ai, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni; isini ik`nebian masshi maradzhams.

nut`u ar ginaxavs igi, vinc` ibrahims t`avis g'mert`ze ekamat`eboda, raki allahma mas mep`oba ucqaloba? - roc`a ibrahimma ut`xra: ch`emi g'mert`i is aris, vinc` ac`oc`xlebs da akvdinebso, man miugo:,,mec` vac`oc`xleb da vakvdineb". ibrahimma ut`xra: cheshmaritad, allahs mze ag'mosavlet`idan amohqavs, shen ki dasavlet`idan amoiqvaneo. mashin gacbilda igi - urcmuno (ena ch`auvarda mas)... da ut`uod, ar daakvalianebs allahi usamart`lo xalxs cheshmarit gzaze.

an imis msgavsi (ar gsmenia), vinc` nasop`lars ch`auara, romelic` iqo dak`c`euli da ukac`rieli, da t`k`va: rogor gaac`oc`xlebs amas allahi sikvdilis shemdgom? mere ki allahma asi clit` moakvdina igi, shemdeg gaac`oc`xla da hkit`xa: ramden xans dahqavi? - miugo: ert`i dg'e an up`ro naklebio. ut`xra: ara, shen asi celi dahqavi. aba, shexede shens sachmelsa da sasmels, arc` gap`uchebula, da shexede shens saxedarsac`, (mogakvdinet` da gagac`oc`xlet`) rat`a sascaulad gk`mnat` xalxist`vis, da shexede z'vlebs, t`u rogor camovaqenebt` da xorc`s shevasxamt`... da roc`a mist`vis c`xadi sheik`mna, - t`k`va: uechvelad, vic`i, rom allahi qovlisshemz'leao.

aki, t`k`va ibrahimma: g'mert`o, mich`vene, t`u rogor ac`oc`xleb mkvdrebso. - ut`xra:,,nut`u ar gircmunia?" t`k`va: rogor ara, magram gulis dasamshvideblado. - ut`xra:,,mash, aig'e ot`xi p`rinveli, isini shent`an miich`vie, shemdeg daanacevre da mat`i nakucebi qovel goraze mimop`ante, shemdeg mouxme mat` da isini scrap`adve movlen shent`an. ic`ode, rom cheshmaritad, allahi uz'levelia, brz'enia."

mat`i sak`me, vinc` t`aviant` k`onebas allahis gzaze xarjaven, im marc`vlis magalit`s hgavs, romelmac` shvidi t`avt`avi gamoisxa - t`it`o t`avt`avshi asi marc`vlit`... - gaumravalkec`ebs allahi imas, visac` moisurvebs; - allahia uxvmcqalobi, qovlismc`odne.

mat`t`vis, vinc` allahis gzaze xarjaven t`aviant` k`onebas da cqenasa da qvedrebas ar miaceven imas, rac` gaig'es, - mat`t`visaa jildo t`aviant` g'mert`t`an, da arc` shishi elit`, arc`a damcuxrdebian (isini).
ket`ili sitqva da patieba umjobesia, vidre mocqaleba, romelsac` t`an sdevs cqena. allahi lmobieria, qovladmdidari.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar gaabat`ilot` t`k`veni mocqalebani cqenit`a da daqvedrebit`, imis msgavsad, vinc` xalxis dasanaxad xarjavs t`avis k`onebas da ar scams allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli. misi sak`me hgavs im sipi kldis magalit`s, romelzec` mica iqo c`otaodeni. shemdeg gadarec`xa kokispirulma cvimam da molipuli k`va datova mxolod. egeni arap`ers p`loben imisgan, rac` mat` mouxvechavt`. allahi urcmuno xalxs ar daakvalianebs cheshmarit gzaze.

mat`i sak`me, vinc` t`aviant` k`onebas allahis kmaqop`ilebis mosapoveblad da t`aviant`i sulebis gamqarebist`vis xarjaven, - hgavs magalit`s mag'lobze gashenebuli bag'isa, romelsac` uxvad acvims da ormagad met naqop`s iz'leva, xolo uxvad t`u ar acvims, mashin et`k`oreba. allahi xedavs, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

nut`u isurvebda romelime t`k`vengani, rom p`inikisa da vazis bag'i hk`onoda qovelgvari naqop`it`, romlis k`veshac` nakadulebi miedinebian, t`umc`a sibere mosceoda, sht`amomavlobac` umceo hqoloda, c`ec`xlovani k`arborbala dastqdomoda uec`rad da gadaecva (qovelive)? allahi ase c`xadqop`s t`k`vent`vis aiat`ebs, rom ik`neb dap`ik`rebuliqavit`.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! sauket`esot`agan gaig'et` mocqalebad - rac` moixvechet` da rac` micidan ag'movac`enet` t`k`vent`vis; ar daapirot` gac`ema mat`gan uvargisisa, risi amg'ebic` t`vit`on ara xart`, t`u t`vals ar daxuchavt` masze. ic`odet`, rom allahi k`ebulia, qovladmdidari.
eshmaki sig'aribit` gashinebt` da avzneobisken mogicodebt`, xolo allahi patiebasa da cqalobas gpirdebat` t`avisi ciag'idan. allahia uxvmcqalobi, qovlismc`odne.
- sibrz'nes anichebs mas, visac` inebebs, xolo visac` sibrz'ne eboz'a, uechvelad, mas bevri siket`e miec`a, t`umc`a amaze sxva aravin dap`ik`rdeba, garda goniert`a.
ra mocqalebac` gagig'iat` an ra ag't`k`mac` dagidviat`, cheshmaritad, -allahma ic`is qvelap`eri, xolo usamart`lot`a damxmare - aravinaa.

mocqalebas t`u ashkarad gaig'ebt`, es - kargi, xolo t`u mas p`arulad gasc`emt` g'aribebze, es - sauket`eso ik`neba t`k`vent`vis, da dap`aravs t`k`vens uket`urebebs. allahi mc`odnea im qvelap`risa, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

ar gakisria shen mat`i cheshmarit gzaze daqeneba, aramed allahi daaqenebs cheshmarit gzaze mas, visac` inebebs. ra siket`ec` gaig'ot` mocqalebad, is mxolod t`k`veni sulebist`visvea. sxva rogor gaig'ebt` t`k`ven mocqalebas, t`u ara allahis kmaqop`ili saxis molodinit`. ra siket`ec` gaig'ot` mocqalebad, unaklod aginazg'aurdebat`, da ar shegexebat` usamart`loba.

(mocqaleba) g'aribebist`visaa, romelnic` mxolod allahis gzit` shemop`arglulan da (sarch`os maz'ieblebad) dedamicis zurgze ver gauvliat`. mat`i (g'aribt`a) mokrz'alebulobis gamo uvic`ebs hgoniat`, rom isini mdidrebi arian. shen mat` t`aviant`i saxeebit` gamoic`nob - isini ar st`xoven xalxs t`avxedurad... da ra siket`esac` gaig'ebt` mocqalebad, cheshmaritad, - ic`is is allahma.
- romelnic` mocqalebas gasc`emen t`aviant`i k`onebidan - dg'isit` da g'amit`; p`arulad da ashkarad, - scored mat` g'mert`t`anaa jildo t`aviant`i, da mat` arc` shishi elit`, arc`a damcuxreba.

xolo isini, vinc` chams vaxshs, (gankit`xvis dg'es) sxvanairad ar camodgebian, t`u ara msgavsad - eshmakis dartqmis shedegad chkuasheshlilebisa. es mxolod imitom, rom mat` t`k`ves - uechvelad, vachroba vaxshis msgavsiao, arada allahma vachroba sc`no nebadart`ulad, vaxshi ki akrz'ala... da mas, vinc` shegoneba miig'o t`avisi g'mert`isgan da xeli aig'o (mevaxsheobaze), - sherch`eba is, rac` iqo carsulshi da misi sak`me allahzea, xolo vinc` ukan daubrundes (mevaxsheobas), scored isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni; isini ik`nebian ik` maradzhams.
akninebs vaxshs allahi da amravlebs mocqalebas. ar uqvars allahs arc`ert`i urcmuno da c`odvili.
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ircmunes, hk`mnes ket`ili, ag'asrules namazi da gaig'es zek`at`i, - mat` g'mert`t`anaa jildo t`aviant`i, da mat` arc` shishi elit`, arc`a damcuxreba.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` icmunet`! ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da miatovet` vaxshi, rac` dagrch`at` (asag'ebi), t`u xart` t`k`ven morcmuneni.

- da t`u mainc` ar moishalot`, mashin ic`odet` allahisa da misi shuamavlis mxridan gamoc`xadebuli omis shesaxeb; xolo t`u moinaniebt`, t`k`veni k`onebis z'iri - t`k`veni kut`vnilebaa. arc` sxvas moek`c`et` usamart`lod da arc` t`k`ven iqot` msxverpli usamart`lobisa.
t`uki siduxchireshia (mevale), mashin manamde adrovet`, vidre gadaxdis unari ek`nebodes, da t`u samocqalod dautovebt` (vals an mis nacils), es up`ro xeiriania t`k`vent`vis, rom ic`odet`.
geshinodet` im dg'isa, roc`a allaht`an ik`nebit` dabrunebulni. shemdeg qovel suls miegeba igi, rac` mas mouxvechavs, da ar sheexebat` mat` usamart`loba.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`u vals daidebt` garkveuli droit`, mashinve ch`aiceret` igi. auc`ilebelia, t`k`ven shoris arsebuli garigeba ch`amcerma gaap`ormos samart`lianad. ar gadauxvios ch`amcerma imgvarad ch`aceras, rogorc` allahma ascavla mas. - ch`aceros, xolo ukarnaxos man, vinc` vali daido. eshinodes t`avisi g'mert`isa, allahisa, da arap`eri miaklos mas (scorad ch`aceras). xolo t`u chkuasustia an uz'luri, an kidev karnaxi ar sheuz'lia mas, vinc` vali daido, mashin misma meurvem ukarnaxos samart`lianad. ori kac`ic` daimocmet` t`k`vengan (garigebisas), xolo t`u ori kac`i ar ik`neba, mashin ert`i kac`i da ori k`ali, - im mocmet`agan, romelt`a mimart`ac` xart` kmaqop`ilni. t`u shec`deba ert`i-ert`i mat`gani (im ori k`alidan), - meorem sheaxsenos. ar shedrknen mocmeebi, rodesac` miicveven da arc` ch`acera daizaron valisa t`avisi vadit` - mc`ire ik`neba t`u didi. qvelaze samart`liania es allahis cinashe, qvelaze z'lieri - mocmobist`vis da up`ro xelsaqreli, rat`a echvi ar gagich`ndet`. xolo t`u xelze ivachrebt` ert`manet`shi, mashin c`odva ar gek`nebat`, t`u ar ch`aicert` mas. vachrobisas mocmeni daimocmet` imgvarad, rom arc` mcerals evnos da arc` mocmes, xolo t`u amgvarad ar ik`mt`, uechvelad, eg ik`neba ug'irsi sak`c`ieli t`k`vengan. allahis ridi gk`ondet`; - allahi gascavlit` t`k`ven; - allahia qovlismc`odne.

xolo t`u mgzavrobashi imqop`ebit` da ver poulobt` ch`amcers, mashin (valis sanac`vlod) mig'ebuli sacindaric` sakmarisia. t`u t`k`ven ert`manet`s endet`, mashin man, visac` endnen, ukan daabrunos amanat`i da ridi hk`ondes misi g'mert`is, allahisa. da ar damalot` mocmoba. vinc` mas damalavs, uechvelad, misi guli c`odvilia. ic`is allahma qvelap`eri, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

allahs ekut`vnis qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanasa zeda. t`und gaac`xadot`, rac`aa t`k`vens sulebshi, t`und damalot` igi, - allahi pasuxs gagebinebt` masze: apatiebs mas, visac` inebebs da dasjis mas, visac` inebebs. allahi qovlisshemz'lea.

shuamavalma ircmuna is, rac` mas t`avisi g'meg't`isgan ch`aevlina, - aseve morcmuneebmac` (ircmunes). ircmuna qvelam allahi, misi angelozebi, misi cignebi da mis mier carmogzavnili shuamavlebi. ar ganvasxvavebt` mis mier carmogzavnil shuamavalt`agan arc`ert`s. mat` t`k`ves:,,shevisminet` da davemorch`ilet`, g'meg't`o ch`veno, shegvicqale, shent`anaa saboloo misak`c`ieli".

arc`ert` suls ar akisrebs allahi imaze mets, rac` mas sheuz'lia. mis sargod ik`neba, rac` moipova (siket`it`) an mis sacinaag'mdegod ik`neba, rac` moixvecha (uket`urebit`). g'mert`o ch`veno! ar gvagebino pasuxi, t`uki dagvavicqda an shevc`odet`. g'mert`o ch`veno! nu dagvdeb (ise) mz'ime tvirt`s, rogorc` dasde ch`venze adre mqop`t`. g'mert`o ch`veno! nu gvatvirt`av imas, risi zidvac` ar z'algviz's. mogviteve, shegvinde da shegvicqale ch`ven. shena xar ch`veni shemce da urcmuno xalxze gvamarjve.
elip` laam miim.
allahi... - ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - marad c`oc`xlisa da msup`evisa.
nacil-nacil ch`amoavlina shenze cigni (qurani) cheshmaritebit`, damamocmeblad imisa, rac`aa mis ucinares; da ch`amoavlina t`evrat`ic` da injilic`.

- adre, - cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad adamianebist`vis; da ch`amoavlina p`urqanic`. cheshmaritad, vinc` uarqves allahis aiat`ebi, mat`t`visaa mz'ime satanjveli. da allahi uz'levelia, sazg'aurmgebi.
cheshmaritad, arap`eria dap`aruli allahist`vis - arc` dedamicaze da arc` zec`ashi.
igia, vinc` ise gsaxavt` sashvilosnoebshi, rogorc` nebavs. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - uz'levelis, brz'enisa.

igia, vinc` ch`amoavlina shenze cigni, masshia muhk`emi aiat`ebi, rogorc` cignis dedaboz'i, da danarch`eni - mut`eshabihi. isini ki, visac` gulebshi uzit` simrude, - p`it`nas gamocvevist`visa da mat`i ganmartebis survilit` mxolod im nacils mihqvebian, rac` mut`eshabihia, romlis axsnac` aravin ic`is, garda allahisa. g'rmadmc`odneni amboben: ch`ven gvcams is (qurani), qvela ch`veni g'mert`isganaao (muhk`emic` da mut`eshabihic`). sxva vin gaiazrebs amas, t`u ara gonierni.
g'mert`o ch`veno! ar gagvimrudo gulebi, mas shemdeg, rac` cheshmarit gzaze dagvaqene, da cqaloba moig'e ch`venze sheni ciag'idan, cheshmaritad, shena xar uxvmcqalobi.
g'mert`o ch`veno! uechvelad, shen xar shemkrebi xalxisa im dg'ist`vis, romelshic` echvi ar arsebobs. cheshmaritad, ar daarg'vevs ag't`k`mas allahi.
cheshmaritad, mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes, t`aviant`i k`oneba da shvilebi verap`ers argeben allahis cinashe, da c`ec`xlis sacvavni ik`nebian isini.
msgavsad p`araonis modgmisa da imat`i, vinc` iqvnen mat`ze adre. mat` uarqves ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, mere allahma sasjelit` sheipqro isini, t`aviant`i c`odvebis gamo. allahi mkac`rsasjeliania.
ut`xari mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes:,,auc`ileblad damarc`xdebit` da jojoxet`shi sheirekebit`!"... da ra c`udi sarec`elia igi.

mart`lac` saoc`reba iqo t`k`vent`vis im or jgup`shi, romlebic` ert`manet`s daupirispirdnen. mat`gan ert`i jgup`i allahis gzaze ibrz'oda, meore ki iqo urcmuno. isini t`aviant`i t`valit` xedavdenen, rom orjer metni iqvnen, magram allahi mas gaaz'lierebs shemceobit`, visac` inebebs. cheshmaritad, t`valsach`ino magalit`ia es mat`t`vis, visac` ganchvreta sheuz'lia.

mokazmula da mimzidvelad k`c`eula adamianebist`vis k`alebis, shvilebis, ut`valavi ok`ro-verc`xlis, lamazi c`xenebis, shinauri pirutqvisa da saxnav-sat`esis mimart` siqvaruli. es qvelap`eri amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis droebit`i sargebelia, sauket`eso misak`c`ieli ki allaht`anaa.

ut`xari: gindat` gac`nobot` amaze uket`esis shesaxeb? vinc` (g'vt`is) moshishia, mat`t`vis samot`xeebi t`aviant` g'mert`t`anaa, romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams - gancmendili meug'leebit`a da allahis kmaqop`ilebit`. allahi msaxurt`a mxedvelia.
- mat`, romelnic` amboben:,,g'mert`o ch`veno! vircmunet` ch`ven, gvapatie ch`veni c`odvebi da dagvip`are c`ec`xlis satanjvelisgan".
momt`ment`, mart`alt`, morch`ilebs, mocqalebist`vis mxarjvelebs da gant`iadisas patiebis mavedreblebs.

daamocma allahma, rom ar arsebobs mis garda sxva g'vt`aeba, aseve amocmeben angelozebi da c`odnis mp`lobelni, romlebic` mtkic`ed ic`aven samart`lianobas. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - z'levamosilis, brz'enisa.

cheshmaritad, allahis cinashe (mig'ebuli) sarcmunoeba aris islami. visac` cigni eboz'at`, mat` moshurneobit` mxolod mas shemdeg gamoavlines ut`anxmoeba, rac` c`odna miec`at`. da vinc` uarqop`s allahis aiat`ebs, cheshmaritad, allahi mscrap`langarishmgebia.

da t`u shemogedaon, mashin upasuxe: pirovnuloba ch`emi - allahs davumorch`ile, da imat`ac` (daumorch`iles), vinc` ch`emi mimdevariao. da ut`xari mat`, visac` cigni eboz'at`, aseve, ucignurebs (carmart`ebs):,,t`k`venc` daemorch`ilet`?" - da t`u daemorch`ilnen, mashin c`xadia, cheshmarit gzaze damdgaran, xolo t`u piri ibrunes, cheshmaritad, sheni movaleoba mxolod micvdenaa. allahi msaxurt`a mxedvelia.
cheshmaritad, vinc` uarqop`en allahis aiat`ebs, usamart`lod xoc`aven mac`neebs da xoc`aven im adamianebsac`, vinc` samart`lianobisken moucodebs, - miaxare mat` mcare satanjveli.
zustad egeni arian, romelt`a namok`medaric` uk`mad gadaik`c`a - amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`, da aravin hqavt` damxmare.
gana ver xedav imat`, visac` xvedri ergot` cignisa? aki, moixmes isini allahis cignt`an, rat`a mas ganesaja mat` shoris? shemdeg piri ibruna ert`ma nacilma, da isini arian zurgshemk`c`evni.
ase imitom ik`c`evian, rom t`k`ves: ver shegvexeba c`ec`xli ch`ven, garda ramdenime gat`vlili dg'isao. amrigad, mat`ive shet`xzulma c`iliscamebam sheac`dina isini t`aviant` rcmenashi.

da ra ik`neba mashin, roc`a shevkrebt` mat` im dg'es, romelshic` echvi ar aris, qvela suls srulad miezg'veba imis shesabamisad, rac` mas mouxvechavs, - da mat` ar sheexebat` usamart`loba (siket`eebis dakargvit` an daumsaxurebeli sasjelis matebit`)?

t`k`vi: g'mert`o ch`emo, mp`lobelo samp`lobelot`a! mas az'lev xelmcip`ebas, visac` inebeb da mas art`mev xelmcip`ebas, visac` inebeb; mas acinaureb, visac` inebeb da mas ak`veit`eb, visac` inebeb; shens xelt`aa siket`e qovelmxrivi, cheshmaritad, shena xar qovlisshemz'le.
g'ame shegqavs dg'eshi da dg'e shegqavs g'ameshi; da c`oc`xali gamogqavs mkvdrisgan da mkvdari gamogqavs c`oc`xlisgan; da ut`valav sazrdos ucqalobeb mas, visac` inebeb.

ar daimegobron morcmuneebma urcmunoebi, nac`vlad morcmuneebisa, xolo mas, vinc` amas izams, - ag'aranairi kavshiri ek`neba allaht`an, garda im shemt`xvevisa, roc`a p`rt`xilobt` mat`mier xip`at`ze. da allahi gaxsenebt` sip`rt`xiles misdami, da allaht`anaa saboloo misak`c`ieli.
ut`xari: gind damalet` da gind gamoamzhg'avnet`, allahma mainc` ic`is imis shesaxeb, rac` gak`vt` gulebshi; da isic` ic`is, rac`aa c`at`a shina da dedamicaze. allahi qovlisshemz'lea.

qovel suls, im dg'es, - cin daxvdeba t`avisi namok`medari, rac` t`u kargi uket`ebia da c`udi ch`audenia, da inatrebs, rom imasa da mas shoris iqos usasrulo sishore. allahi gaxsenebt` sip`rt`xiles misdami; allahi t`avis msaxurt`a mimart` usazg'vrod mcqalobeli da shembralebelia.
ut`xari:,,t`u giqvart` t`k`ven allahi, mashin me gamomqevit`, rat`a uqvardet` allahsac` da mogitevot` c`odvebi. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli".
ut`xari:,,daemorch`ilet` allahsa da shuamavals", da t`u piri ibrunes, cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars urcmunoebi.
cheshmaritad, allahma amoarch`ia (imdroindel) samqarot`a cinashe adami da nuhi, aseve, ibrahimisa da imranis modgma.
- rogorc` sht`amomavloba ert`manet`isa. allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.

aki, imranis k`alma t`k`va: g'mert`o! cheshmaritad, shent`vis shemomiciravs is, rac` ch`ems muc`elshia, vinc`, sxva qvelap`risagan gat`avisup`lebuli, - mxolod sheni msaxurebit` dakavdeba. mash, miig'e igi ch`emgan. cheshmaritad, shena xar qovlismsmeni, qovlismc`odne.

da roc`a dabada, t`k`va: g'mert`o! cheshmaritad, me davbade mdedrio. allahma kargad ic`is, rac` dabada. vazhi ar aris mdedris msgavsi da me mas davark`vi mariami. cheshmaritad, shemogap`areb shen, - masa da mis sht`amomavlobas, - gandevnili eshmakisagan.

iqabula t`avisma g'mert`ma ket`ili qabulobit`, ag'zarda igi mshvenieri mc`enaresavit` da daakisra masze mzrunveloba zek`erias. qovelt`vis, roc`a zek`eria mihrabshi shedioda mast`an, - sarch`os poulobda mis cin. sheekit`xa:,,o, meriem, shen es saidan gak`vs?" upasuxa:,,es allahisganaa". cheshmaritad, allahi uric`xv sarch`os ucqalobebs imas, visac` inebebs.
mashin t`avis g'mert`s sheevedra zek`eria:,,g'mert`o, micqalobe sheni ciag'idan spetaki sht`amomavloba. cheshmaritad, shen xar shemsmeni vedrebisa".

shemdeg, roc`a mihrabshi loc`ulobda, angelozebma sheatqobines: cheshmaritad, allahi gmaxaroblobs iahias, rogorc` allahis mier movlenili sitqvis damamocmebels, cinamz'g'ols, t`avshekavebuls da mac`nes sat`not`agano.
- t`k`va:,,g'mert`o, vazhi rogor meqoleba, me xom sibere mecia da ch`emi c`oli unaqop`oa?" miugo:,,asea, allahi ik`ms imas, rasac` inebebs".

(zek`eriam) t`k`va:,,g'mert`o, nishani momec`i". ut`xra: sheni nishani is aris, rom sam dg'es ar unda esaubro xalxs, garda minishnebebisa. xshirad axsene sheni g'mert`i da mis unakloebaze ig'ag'ade dg'is bolosa da dasacqisshi.
aki, angelozebma ut`xres: ei, meriem! uechvelad, agirch`ia shen allahma, gangcminda da samqarot`a k`alebs shoris gamogarch`ia.
ei, meriem! mocicebit` hmorch`ilebde shens g'mert`s, daemxe sejdeze da moixare ruk`u'ze - ruk`u'ze mqop`ebt`an ert`ad.

(o, muhammed!) esaa (shent`vis) uxilav ambavt`agan, romelsac` vahit` gac`nobebt`. ar qop`ilxar shen momscre, roc`a isini kalmebs isvrodnen imis cilisqrist`vis, t`u romeli ikisrebda meriemis mzrunvelobas; da arc` mashin iqavi mat`t`an ert`ad, rodesac` ut`anxmoebdnen.

aki angelozebma ut`xres: ei, meriem! cheshmaritad, allahi gmaxaroblobs t`avis sitqvas, romlis saxelia mesihi 'isa z'e meriemisa. ik`neba is g'irseuli amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`, da ert`-ert`i - daaxloebult`agan (g'mert`t`an).
- igi xalxs daelaparakeba akvanshic` da zrdasrul asakshic`, da ik`neba ert`-ert`i sat`not`agan.

(gakvirvebulma) t`k`va:,,g'mert`o, rogor meqoleba vazhi, roc`a kac`i ar shemxebia?" ut`xra: asea, - imas gaach`ens, rasac` inebebs; allahi, ris k`mnasac` gadacqvets, - mxolod etqvis mas:,,iqav!" - da umalve sheik`mneba.
ascavlis mas - cignsa da sibrz'nes; t`evrat`sa da injils.
