- da shuamavlad carigzavneba israelis modgmast`an (da etqvis mat`): cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`an me t`k`venive g'mert`is sascaulit` movedi; cheshmaritad, talaxidan shevk`mni ch`itis gamosaxulebas, ch`avberav masshi suls da ch`itad ik`c`eva nebit` allahisa; da allahis nebit` ganvkurnav brmad dabadebulebs, ket`rovnebs, gavac`oc`xleb mkvdrebs, gaucqebt`, t`u ras miirt`mevt` da ras inaxavt` saxlebshi. cheshmaritad, eseni t`k`vent`vis sascaulebia, t`u xart` t`k`ven morcmuneni.

aseve (movedi) imis damamocmeblad, rac` iqo t`evrat`shi ch`emamde, da mat`gan nacilis halalad damceseblad, - rac` gk`ondat` akrz'aluli. sascaulebit` movedi t`k`venive g'mert`isgan, mash, ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da me damemorch`ilet`.
cheshmaritad, allahia ch`emi g'mert`ic` da t`k`veni g'mert`ic`, amitom mas et`aqvanet`, esaa scori gza.

roc`a sheamch`nia mat`shi 'isam urcmunoeba, hkit`xa:,,vin ik`nebian ch`emi damxmareni allahisken mimaval gzaze?" - mocap`eebma miuges: ch`ven vart` allahis damxmareni, vircmunet` allahi da daamocme shenc`, rom ch`ven vart` muslimebi/morch`ilebio.
g'mert`o ch`veno! vircmunet` is, rac` ch`amoavline da mivqevit` shuamavals, mash, ch`agvcere (cheshmaritebis) dammocmebelt`a rigebshi!
veraguli maxe gaamzades, da allahmac` gaamzada maxe (veragt`a sacinaag'mdegod), da allahia sauket`eso mat`gan, vinc` maxe gaamzades (- veragt`ave sacinaag'mdegod rom sheatrialebs maxes).

aki, allahma ut`xra: ei, 'isa! me var sheni momkvdinebelic`, ch`ems cinashe amamag'lebelic`a da urcmunot`agan mxsnelic`. xolo mat`, vinc` sheni mimqolia, umag'lesvqop` urcmunoebze - dg'emde gankit`xvisa, bolos ki ch`emt`an dabrundebit` da ganvsji t`k`ven shoris imas, razec` ut`anxmoebdit`.
xolo mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes, umkac`resad davsji amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`, da aravin hqavt` damxmare.
xolo isini, vinc` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, unaklod miig'eben t`aviant` sazg'aurs. allahs ar uqvars usamart`loni.
amgvaria brz'nuli shegoneba da aiat`ebi, rasac` shen gikit`xavt`.
cheshmaritad, allahist`vis 'isas mdgomareoba msgavsia adamis mdgomareobisa: micisgan shek`mna igi, shemdeg ut`xra -,,iqav!" - da igic` ik`mna.
cheshmariteba sheni g'mert`isganaa, mash, nu ik`nebi daechvebult`agan.

xolo mas, vinc` imis ('isas) shesaxeb shegedavos, mas shemdeg, rac` c`odna geboz'a, ut`xari:,,modit`, movuxmot` ch`vens vazhebsa da t`k`vens vazhebs, ch`vens k`alebsa da t`k`vens k`alebs, da ch`venc`a da t`k`venc` mxurvale vedreba ag'vavlinot`, rat`a allahis cqevla vaciot` matquarebs".
eseni cheshmaritad, mart`lac` namdvili ambebia. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda allahisa da, uechvelad, allahia z'levamosili, brz'eni.
xolo piri t`u ibrunes, cheshmaritad, allahi ic`nobs uket`urebs.

ut`xari:,,ei, cignboz'ebulno! modit` shevt`anxmdet` sitqvaze, romelic` saert`oa ch`vensa da t`k`vens shoris, - rom aravis vet`aqvanot`, garda allahisa; arap`eri vut`anaziarot` da ar gavag'mert`ot` - vinmem vinme, - nac`vlad allahisa". xolo t`u piri ibrunes, mashin ut`xarit`: daamocmet`, rom ch`ven vart` muslimebi/morch`ilebio.
ei, cignboz'ebulno! ratom kamat`obt` ibrahimis shesaxeb? t`evrat`ic` da injilic` xom mxolod mis shemdeg ch`amoevlinnen, nut`u gonebas ar mouxmobt`?
ai, isini xart` t`k`ven, vinc` imis shesaxeb kamat`obdit`, rac` ukve ic`odit`, da ratomg'a kamat`obt` imis shesaxeb, ris c`odnasac` ar p`lobt`? allahma ic`is, t`k`ven ki ar ic`it`.
ibrahimi arc` iudeveli qop`ila da arc` nazareveli, aramed is iqo hanip`i muslimi/morch`ili, da ar qop`ila g'mert`ze t`anamziarebelt`agan.
cheshmaritad, ibrahimt`an qvelaze axlos mqop`ni is adamianebi arian, - vinc` mimdevaria misi; da am mac`nisa (muhammedisa); da isinic`, vinc` ircmunes. allahi megobaria morcmuneebisa.
cignboz'ebult`a ert` jgup`s t`k`veni c`duneba ganuzraxavs, magram ver ac`nobiereben, rom sxvas veravis ac`duneben, garda sakut`ari sulebisa.
ei, cignobz'ebulno! ratom uarqop`t` allahis aiat`ebs mashin, roc`a t`k`ven xart` mocmeni?
ei, cignboz'ebulno! ratom mosavt` cheshmaritebas sic`ruit` da malavt` mashin, roc`a t`k`ven ic`it`?
da t`k`va nacilma cignboz'ebult`agan: dg'is dasacqisshi ircmunet` is, rac` morcmuneebs ch`amoevlinat`, xolo dg'is bolos uarqavit` igi, ik`neb ukumoik`c`neno.

da aravis ercmunot` mat` garda, vinc` t`k`veni rjulis mimdevaria. (o, muhammed) ut`xari: uechvelad, cheshmariti gza allahis mier mit`it`ebuli gzaa. radgan sxvasac` (muhammeds) miec`a imis msgavsi, rac` (ert` dros) t`k`venc` mogec`at`, an radgan gedavebian da t`k`veni g'mert`is cinashe gamxelen, - ase imitom ik`c`evit`? ut`xari: cheshmaritad, madli allahis xelt`aa da ucqalobebs mas, visac` inebebs. allahi uxvmcqalobia, qovlismc`odne.
t`avis cqalobas is mxolod mat` miakut`vnebs, visac` moisurvebs. allahi udidesi cqalobis mk`onea.

cignboz'ebult`a shoris aris iset`i, visac` ut`valavi simdidre rom miando, - uklebliv dagibrunebs; da mat`ganaa iset`ic`, visac` ert`i dinaric` rom miando, ar dagibrunebs mas, t`u t`avze ar daadek`i. ase imitom ik`c`evian, rom mat` t`k`ves: c`odvad ar dagvedeba, t`uki ucignurebs cavart`mevt`o. da shegnebulad tquian allahis shesaxeb.
diax, vinc` uert`gula t`avis ag't`k`mas da iqo g'vt`ismoshishi, cheshmaritad, - uqvars allahs g'vt`ismoshishni.

cheshmaritad, vinc` mc`ire sap`asurze qidian allahis cinashe dadebul ag't`k`masa da p`ic`s, - isini veranair xvedrs ecevian imk`veqnad; gankit`xvis dg'es ar daelaparakeba mat` allahi, arc` shexedavs da arc` gancmends, da mcare sasjeli - mat`t`vis!

cheshmaritad, mat`shia (cignboz'ebult`a shorisaa) jgup`i, - t`aviant`i enit` rom c`vlian (g'vt`iur) cigns, rat`a cignierad gegonot` (mat`i sitqvebi), magram ar aris igi (g'vt`iuri) cigniseuli; da amboben, rom igi allahismieriao, t`umc`a ar aris allahismieri, da shegnebulad tquian allahis shesaxeb.

kac`ma, visac` allahma cigni, sibrz'ne da shuamavloba uboz'a, - gamoric`xulia, ut`xras xalxs, rom allahis nac`vlad ch`emi msaxurni iqavit`o; aramed (itqvis): rasac` cignze daqrdnobit` ascavlit` da mec`adineobt`, misi pirnat`lad shemsrulebeli scavlulni iqavit`o.
arc` imas gibrz'anebt`, rom mac`neni da angelozni daidginot` g'mert`ebad. gana urcmunoebas gibrz'anebt` mas shemdgom, rac` ukve muslimebi/morch`ilebi xart`?

aki, mac`neebisgan aig'o ag't`k`ma allahma, rom t`k`vent`vis boz'ebuli (qoveli) cignisa da sibrz'nis shemdeg t`k`vent`an movidoda (axali) shuamavali, - dammocmebeli imisa, rac`aa t`k`vent`an, - romelzec` ut`uod unda dagejerat` da daxmarebodit`. (shemdeg) ut`xra: et`anxmebit` da g'ebulobt` am ag't`k`mas ch`emgan - t`k`venze pirobad camoqenebuls? t`k`ves: vet`anxmebit`o. t`k`va: mash daamocmet` da mec` vik`nebi t`k`vent`an ert`ad dammocmebelio.
- xolo vinc` piri ibruna shemdgom amisa, - scored isini arian ug'irsebi.
nut`u allahis rjulis garda sxva rjulsac` ez'eben, roc`a nebit` t`u uneburad mas hmorch`ilebs, rac` aris c`at`a shina da dedamicaze, da mast`an ik`nebian mibrunebulni?

ut`xarit`: vircmunet` allahi da is, rac` ch`venze ch`amoevlina, da isic`, rac` ibrahims, isma'ils, ishaqs, ia'qubs da (mis) sht`amomavlebs ch`amoevlinat`, rac` miec`a musas da 'isas, da rac` miec`at` mac`neebs, t`aviant`i g'mert`isgan. mat`gan arc`ert`s ar ganvasxvavebt`, da ch`ven morch`ilni/muslimni vart` misi.
xolo vinc` islamis garda sxva rjuli ez'ios, - ar miig'eba igi misgan da gankit`xvis dg'es is ik`neba cagebult`agan.

rogor uch`venebs allahi scor gzas - xalxs, romlebmac` rcmena uarqves mas shemdeg, rac` ircmunes, daamocmes shuamavlis cheshmariteba da miig'es c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi. allahi usamart`lo xalxs ar daakvalianebs cheshmarit gzaze.
scored mat`i sasjelia is, rom mat`zea cqevla allahisa, angelozebisa da adamianebisa, qvelasi.
- mudmivad masshi ik`nebian. mat` arc` sasjeli sheumsubuk`debat` da arc` shesvenebas daac`dian.
- garda mat`i, vinc` moinanies da gamoascores shemdgomshi. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
cheshmaritad, ar miig'eba mat`i monanieba, vinc` jer ircmunes, shemdeg uarqves rcmena da shemdeg umates urcmunoebasac`. scored isini arian gzaac`denilni.

cheshmaritad, mat`, vinc` uarqves rcmena da daixoc`nen urcmunod, - dedamicis avsebamde ok`ros gag'ebac` rom sheez'lot` gamosasqidad, - ar miig'eba igi arc`ert`i mat`ganisagan. scored mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli da aravinaa mat`i damxmare.
siket`es manamde ver ecevit`, sanam ar gaig'ebt` imisgan, rac` z'alian giqvart`, xolo ra mocqalebac` gaig'ot`, cheshmaritad, ic`is allahma imis shesaxeb.

israelis z'et`at`vis t`evrat`is ch`amovlinebamde qovelgvari sachmeli iqo halali, garda imisa, rac` t`avad aikrz'ala israelma (i'aqubma). ut`xra:,,mash, moitanet` t`evrat`i da caikit`xet`, t`uki namdvilad gulcrp`elni xart`".
xolo amis shemdeg sic`ruis shet`xzvit` vinc` c`ili dascama allahs, scored isini arian usamart`loni.
ut`xari: simart`le t`k`va allahma, mash, mihqevit` rjuls hanip`i ibrahimisa, - ar qop`ila is carmart`t`agani.
cheshmaritad, pirveli (samloc`velo) saxli, romelic` xalxist`vis ik`na agebuli, - bek`k`ashi (mek`k`ashi) arsebuli barak`iani da samqarot`at`vis cheshmariti gzis mach`venebeli samloc`veloa (mek`k`a).

masshia c`xadi sascaulebi, nadgomi ibrahimisa, da vinc` masshi sheva, is ik`neba usap`rt`xod. adamianebs, visac` ik` misasvleli gzis dap`arva sheuz'liat`, allahisgan daekisrat` am saxlshi hajobis shesruleba, xolo vinc` uarqop`s, cheshmaritad, allahi imdenad mdidaria, rom is arap`ers sachiroebs samqarot`agan.
ut`xari: ei, cignboz'ebulno! ratom uarqop`t` allahis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs? - allahi mocmea imisa, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

ut`xari: ei, cignboz'ebulno! ratom gindat`, rom scori gza allahisa mruded carmoach`inot` da aac`dinot` misgan isini, vinc` ircmunes, amave dros, t`k`ven mocmeni xart` amisa; da allahi ugulisquro araa imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`u cignboz'ebult`agan romelime jgup`s daemorch`ilebit`, isev urcmunoebad gak`c`even, mas shemdeg, rac` ircmunet`.
rogor ar unda ircmunot`, rodesac` gekit`xebat` allahis aiat`ebi da t`k`vens shorisaa misi shuamavali? vinc` allahs (mis sarcmunoebas) ch`aechideba, mas ech`veneba scori gza, usat`uod.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, rogorc` mas sheep`ereba, da nu ag'esrulebit` sxvanairad, garda - muslimebad/morch`ilebad.

qvelam ert`ad ch`aechidet` t`oks allahisa (quransa da sunnet`s) da nu daiqop`it`. gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba t`k`venze, roc`a mtrebi iqavit`, mere man gulebi mogilbot` ert`manet`is mimart` da misive cqalobit` ik`ec`it` z'mebad, manamde ki c`ec`xlis up`skrulis piras iqavit` da (allahma) ik`idan gixsnat`. t`k`vent`vis allahi ase c`xadqop`s t`avis aiat`ebs, rom ik`neb cheshmarit gzas dadgomodet` t`k`ven.
da iqos ert`i jgup`i t`k`venshi (qovelt`vis), romlebic` siket`isken moucodeben da dagmoben borotebas; - scored egeni arian gadarch`enilni.
da nu ik`nebit` msgavsi mat`i, romlebic` danacevrdnen da ut`anxmoebdnen, mas shemdeg, rac` miuvidat` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi; scored mat`t`visaa sasjeli udidesi.

im dg'es, rodesac` gabrcqindebian saxeebi da gashavdebian saxeebi, - visi saxeebic` gashavdeba, mat` etqvian: nut`u mas shemdeg uarqavit`, rac` ukve ircmunet`? mashin igemet` imis sasjeli, rasac` uarqop`dit`.
xolo romelt`ac` saxeebi gaubrcqindebat`, allahis cqalobashi (samot`xeshi) ik`nebian isini da ik` darch`ebian maradzhams.
es aris allahis aiat`ebi, romelt`ac` gikit`xavt` shen cheshmaritebit` da ar nebavs allahs usamart`loba samqarot`at`vis.
allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da qoveli sak`me isev allahs daubrundeba.

sauket`eso t`emad xart` t`k`ven movlenili kac`obriobist`vis: moucodebt` siket`isken, gmobt` borotebas da gcamt` allahi. t`uki cignboz'ebulnic` ircmuneben, es scored mat`t`vis ik`neba kargi. arian mat`shi morcmuneebic`, t`umc`a mat`i umravlesoba ug'irsia.
- veras gavneben isini, garda shecuxebisa, xolo t`uki geomebian, mashin (damarc`xebulni) zurgs mogak`c`even (da gaik`c`evian), shemdeg ki ag'ar gaecevat` mat` daxmareba;

- sadac` ar unda iqvnen, t`avs damc`ireba daatqdebat`, garda - t`u allahis t`oks (sarcmunoebas) an xalxis t`oks (mp`arvelobas) sheekedlebian. allahis risxva daimsaxures da sig'aribe daatqdat` t`avs. es imitom, rom uarqop`dnen allahis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs da xoc`avdnen mac`neebs usamart`lod. es imist`vis, rasac` urch`obdnen da zg'vargadasulobdnen.
qvela ert`i araa cignboz'ebult`aganac`. mat` shoris aris mtkic`e jgup`i, vinc` g'amis saat`ebshi allahis aiat`ebs kit`xulobs da sejdes ag'asrulebs.
mat` scamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli; siket`isken moucodeben, borotebas gmoben da xeirian sak`meebshi ert`manet`s ejibrebian. scored egeni arian sat`not`aganni.
da ar daekargebat` - siket`is saxit` rasac` moimok`medeben. allahma qvelap`eri ic`is g'vt`ismoshisht`a shesaxeb.
cheshmaritad, mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes, t`aviant`i k`oneba da shvilebi verap`ers argeben allahis cinashe; isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da ik` darch`ebian maradzhams.

magalit`i, rasac` isini amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi samocqalod xarjaven, - hgavs magalit`s qinulovani k`arishxlisa, romelmac` ekvet`a da gaanadgura - t`aviant`i sulebis mimart` usamart`lo xalxis nat`esebi. allahi ki ar moek`c`a mat` usamart`lod, aramed sakut`ar sulebs t`vit`on ek`c`evian usamart`lod.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! sxvas nu gaixdit` mesaidumled, garda t`k`venianisa, radganac` isini arap`ers daishureben t`k`vens sazianod, da natroben imas, rac` urt`ulesia t`k`vent`vis, da siz'ulvili gadmodis mat`i bageebidan, da is up`ro didia, rasac` mat`i gulebi malaven. sakmarisad nat`elvqet` t`k`vent`vis aiat`ebi, t`uki gons moegebit`.

ai, giqvart` t`k`ven isini, magram mat` ar uqvarxart`, miuxedavad imisa, rom t`k`ven srulad gcamt` (qvela g'vt`iuri) cigni; t`k`vent`an shexvedrisas amboben, vircmunet`o, magram rodesac` ganmartovdebian, t`it`is cverebs ikvneten t`k`ven mimart` siz'ulvilisgan. ut`xari:,,daixoc`et` t`k`venive siz'ulvilit`". cheshmaritad, unaklod ic`is allahma gulebshi arsebulis shesaxeb.

t`uki siket`es gadaeqrebit`, samcuxaroa mat`t`vis, xolo t`uki ubedureba dagatqdebat`, mashin - uxariat`. da t`u moit`ment` da g'vt`ismoshishobas gamoich`ent`, veras gavnebt` mat`i veragoba. cheshmaritad, allahi garemoic`avs qvelap`ers, rasac` isini aket`eben.
aki, gaxvedi dilaadrianad ojaxidan da sabrz'olo mcqobrshi amagrebdi morcmuneebs. allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.
aki, shishma sheipqro ori jgup`i t`k`vengan, arada allahi iqo mat`i shemce. morcmuneebi mxolod allahs miendon!
diaxac` shegeciat` allahi bedirshi, - roc`a uz'lurni iqavit`. mash, ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit` t`k`ven.
aki, morcmuneebs eubnebodi:,,nut`u t`k`veni g'mert`is mier (c`idan) ch`amovlenili sami at`asi angelozit` shecevna t`k`vent`vis ar aris sakmarisi?"
- ra t`k`ma unda (sakmarisia)! t`u moit`ment` da ridi gek`nebat`, uec`radac` rom dagesxnen t`avs, t`k`veni g'mert`i (shemced) danishnuli xut`i at`asi angelozit`ac` shegecevat`.
- sxva arap`rist`vis uk`mnia es allahs, garda samaxaroblod da dasamshvideblad t`k`veni gulebisa. aranairi shecevna ar arsebobs, garda brz'eni da z'levamosili allahismierobisa.
- (aseve imist`vis shegeciat`) rat`a moekvet`a mat`i nacili, vinc` ar ircmunes an daemarc`xebina da gacbilebulni ukuk`c`euliqvnen.
- (shuamavalo!) shen ar gekut`vnis am sak`mis gadacqvetileba: an miig'ebs monaniebas, an kidev, dasjis mat` allahi. ut`uod, - isini arian usamart`loni.
allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze. is apatiebs mas, visac` inebebs da dasjis mas, visac` inebebs. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar chamot` vaxshi, mravalmagad gaz'virebuli; ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, ik`neb gadarch`et`.
mash, geshinodet` c`ec`xlisa, romelic` urcmunoebist`visaa gamzadebuli.
mash, daemorch`ilet` allahsa da shuamavals, rom ik`neb shecqalebuliqavit`.
da iscrap`et` t`k`veni g'mert`is patiebisa da samot`xisaken, romlis ukideganobac` hgavs c`ebisa da dedamicisas da gamzadebulia g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
- mat`t`vis, vinc` g'vt`ivsat`nod xarjaven simdidresa t`u siduxchireshi, brazs sz'leven da mpatiebelni arian xalxis mimart`. allahs uqvars ket`ilmorcmuneni.

da mat`, vinc` avzneoba ch`aidines an t`aviant` sulebs usamart`lod moepqrnen da, (mashinve) allahi gaixsenes da patieba shest`xoves t`aviant`i c`odvebist`vis, - vin apatiebs c`odvebs, t`u ara allahi? - t`u kvlav ar daizhineben igives shegnebulad, rac` mat` ch`audeniat`.
patiebaa mat`i sazg'auri t`aviant`i g'mert`isgan da samot`xeebi, romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian, da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams... da ra mshvenieria mshromelt`a sazg'auri.
t`k`venamde mart`lac` mravali ces-ch`veuleba gardasula. mash, ch`amoiaret` dedamicaze da dainaxet`, t`u ra bedi eciat` c`rud shemrac`xvelebs.
es (qurani) aris c`xadeba adamiant`at`vis da cheshmariti gzis mimart`uleba da shegoneba - g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
xels nu ch`aik`nevt` (nu dauz'lurdebit`) da nurc` damcuxrdebit`, radganac` t`uki (namdvil) morcmuneobas gamoich`ent`, mashin gamarjvebulic` t`k`ven ik`nebit`.

(uhudis brz'olashi) t`u chrilobebi igemet` (amit` guli ar gaitexot`), - aset`i chrilobebi sxva xalxsac` (mek`el qureishelebs) ugemiat` (bediris brz'olashi).adamianebshi aset` (marc`xian) dg'eebs monac`vleobit` vadgent` xolme, rat`a allahma gamoamzhg'avnos isini, romlebmac` ircmunes, da mocmeebi/shahidebi aiqvanos t`k`ven shoris. allahs ar uqvars usamart`loni (t`undac` gz'lion).
aseve imist`visaa (aset`i marc`xiani dg'eebi), rom allahma gancmindos isini, vinc` ircmunes, da gaanadguros urcmunoebi.
nut`u p`ik`robdit`, - ise shexvidodit` samot`xeshi, rom ar gamoamzhg'avnebda allahi mat`, romlebmac` ibrz'oles, da ar gamoamzhg'avnebda momt`ment`?
t`k`ven mart`lac` natrobdit` sikvdils (shahidobas) manamde, vidre (uhudis brz'olashi) mis cinashe ag'moch`ndebodit`. uechvelad, xedavdit` mas da shesc`k`erodit`.

muhammedi sxva aravinaa, t`u ara shuamavali, uechvelad, masze cinac` ganvles shuamavlebma; da t`u mokvda an mokles, mashin ukan mibrundebit` - t`k`venive k`uslebis mimart`ulebit` (urcmunoebashi)? da vinc` ukan mibrundeba t`avisi k`uslebis mimart`ulebit` (urcmunoebashi), - verap`ers avnebs igi allahs. allahi - madlierebs daajildovebs.

sheuz'lebelia, romelime suli mokvdes allahis nebis gareshe - gansazg'vruli droist`vis dacerilisa. visac` amk`veqniuri sargebeli scaddes, ch`ven mas mivagebt` misgan, xolo visac` imk`veqniuri jildo scaddes, ch`ven masac` mivagebt` misgan da madlierebs davajildovebt`.
ramden mac`nest`an ert`ad ibrz'oda mravali g'vt`isnieri da ar shemdrkalan imis gamo, rac` t`avs daatqdat` allahis gzaze, arc` sisuste gamouvleniat` da arc` danebebulan. allahs uqvars momt`menni.

mat`i sitqva sxva arap`eri qop`ila, t`u ara es g'ag'adisi:,,g'mert`o ch`veno! gvapatie ch`veni c`odvebi da gadac`domebi ch`vens sak`meebshi; p`exebi gagvimdgrade da shegvecie urjulo xalxis cinaag'mdeg".
amgvarad, ucqaloba mat` allahma: sazg'auri - amk`veqniuri da sauket`eso jildo - imk`veqniuri. allahs uqvars ket`ilmorcmuneni.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`uki urcmunoebs daemorch`ilebit`, mashin isini ukan migabruneben - t`k`veni k`uslebis mimart`ulebit` (urcmunoebashi) da cagebulebad gadaik`c`evit`.
diaxac`, allahia t`k`veni mp`arveli da damxmaret`agan - igia sauket`eso.

shishs ch`avagdebt` urcmunot`a gulebshi, radganac` allahs imat` ut`anaziareben, romelt`a shesaxebac` aranairi mtkic`ebuleba ar ch`avlenila mat`t`an. c`ec`xlia mat`i t`avshesap`ari, da raoden c`udia usamart`lot`a samqop`eli.

cheshmaritad, allahma ert`gulad ag'gisrulat` t`avisi ag'k`ma, roc`a misi nebit` xoc`avdit` mat`, vidre daudevrad moik`c`eodit`: kamat`s daicqebdit` misi (shuamavlis) brz'anebis t`aobaze da siurch`es gamoavlendit`, mas shemdeg, roc`a gich`venat` is (gamarjveba), rac` z'alian gindodat`. t`k`venshi arian iset`ebi, visac` surs es k`veqana da t`k`venshi arian iset`ebic`, visac` surs is k`veqana. gamoc`dis miznit`, am qvelap`ris shemdeg (allahma) mat`gan ukugak`c`iat`, magram bolos mainc` shegicqalat`. allahi didi cqalobis mk`onea morcmunet`a mimart`.

aki (uhudis kalt`ebze) ag'ma garbodit` da aravisken ixedebodit`, xolo shuamavali uknidan gixmobdat`, da mcuxarebaze mcuxareba dagematat`, rom ar dag'onebuliqavit` imist`vis, rac` dakarget` an t`avs dagatqdat`. allahi mc`odnea qovelivesi, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

mcuxarebis shemdeg (allahma) t`k`venshi z'ilis momgvreli simshvide ch`amoavlina, romelmac` ert`i jgup`i moic`va t`k`vengan, xolo meore jgup`s mxolod t`aviant`i sulebi adardebdat`. isini allahis shesaxeb usamart`lod p`ik`robdnen - umec`rul p`ik`rebs auqvnen da ambobdnen:,,gana vp`lobt` ch`ven rames am sak`meshi?" ut`xari: cheshmaritad, es sak`me mt`lianad allahs ekut`vniso. (isini) t`aviant` sulebshi malaven imas, rasac` shen ar gimxelen. (gulshi) amboben: ch`veni nebit` rom qop`iliqo raime am sak`meshi, mashin ak` ar davig'upebodit`o. ut`xari:,,sakut`ar saxlebshic` rom qop`iliqavit`, vist`visac` sikvdili iqo dacerili, isini mainc` gavidodnen ik`, sadac` unda dag'upuliqvnen". t`k`vens mkerdebshi arsebulis gamosac`delad da t`k`vens gulebshi arsebulis gansacmendad hk`mna allahma es qovelive. allahi mc`odnea t`k`veni gulisxmisa.

cheshmaritad, ori jgup`is shexvedris dg'es, vinc` t`k`vengan gaik`c`nen, eshmakma ac`duna isini zogi sak`c`ielis gamo, rac` mat` ch`aedinat`. mart`lac` apatia mat` allahma. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, lmobieri

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! nu ik`nebit` msgavsni mat`i, romlebmac` ar ircmunes da samogzaurod an sabrz'olvelad casuli t`aviant`i z'mebis shesaxeb t`k`ves: ch`vent`an ert`ad rom darch`eniliqvnen, arc` mokvdebodnen da arc` daixoc`ebodneno. (ase amboben) rat`a allahma es sinanulad uk`c`ios t`aviant` gulebshi. allahia mac`oc`xlebelic` da makvdinebelic`, da qvelap`ers xedavs allahi, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
vp`ic`av, allahis gzaze t`u daig'upebit` an mokvdebit`, - allahis miteveba da cqaloba mart`lac` umjobesia, vidre is, rasac` ixvechen (am k`veqnad qop`nit`).
vp`ic`av, t`uki mokvdebit` an daig'upebit`, - allahis cinashe sheikribebit`, usat`uod.

lmobieri iqavi mat` mimart` - cqalobit` allahismieri. shen rom uxeshi da gulk`va qop`iliqavi, mashin irgvliv mqop`ni ut`uod gagec`lebodnen. mash, apatie, patieba it`xove mat`t`vis da mat`i azric` moismine (amk`veqniuri) sakit`xebis shesaxeb. roc`a rames gadacqvet, mxolod allahs miende. cheshmaritad, allahs uqvars misdami mindobilni.
allahi t`u dagexamrebat`, mashin veravin dagamarc`xebt`; xolo t`uki daxmarebas shegicqvett`, mashin vinaa iset`i, vinc` amis shemdeg dagexmarebat`? mash, mxolod allahs miendon morcmuneebi.

sheuz'lebelia, mac`ne rames malulad g'ebulobdes nadavlidan, xolo vinc` rames malulad aig'ebs nadavlidan, gankit`xvis dg'es t`an moitans imas, rac` aig'o; shemdeg qvela suls srulad miezg'veba imis shesabamisad, rac` mas mouxvechia da isini ar gadaeqrebian usamart`lobas (siket`eebis dakargvit` an daumsaxurebeli sasjelis matebit`).
gana, vinc` allahis kmaqop`ilebis mimqolia, is iset`ivea, vinc` allahis risxva daimsaxura da jojoxet`ia misi t`avshesap`ari? ra c`udi samqop`elia mat`i saboloo misak`c`ieli.
sxvadasxva xarisxs p`loben isini allahis cinashe. qvelap`ers xedavs allahi, rasac` isini aket`eben.

cheshmaritad, cqaloba moig'o allahma morcmuneebze, rodesac` t`aviant`i cridan cargzavna mat`t`an shuamavali, romelic` ukit`xavda mis (allahis) aiat`ebs, gancmendda (c`ru rcmenebisgan) da cignsa (qurans) da sibrz'nes (sunnet`s) ascavlida, miuxedavad imisa, rom isini manamde iqvnen c`xad gzaac`denilobashi.

nut`u (uhudshi) t`avs damtqdar ubedurebas kit`xulobt`, es saidan gvecviao? t`k`ven xom (bedirshi) mat` orjer meti ubedureba daatexet`. ut`xari: es (ubedureba) t`k`veni mxridanaa. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
rac` t`avs dagatqdat` ori jgup`is shexvedris dg'es, - allahis nebit` iqo qovelive, rat`a morcmuneebi gamoemzhg'avnebina.

- da rom gamoemzhg'avnebina isinic`, vinc` p`arisevlobdnen. ut`xres:,,camodit`, allahis gzaze ibrz'olet` an t`avi daic`avit`". mat` miuges: ch`ven rom vic`odet`, brz'ola gaimart`eba, auc`ileblad shemogiert`debodit`o. isini im dg'es, urcmunoebast`an up`ro axlos iqvnen, vidre rcmenast`an. pirit` imas ambobdnen, rac` gulebshi ar hk`ondat`. uket` ic`is allahma, rasac` isini malaven.
mat`, vinc` (saxlebshi) isxdnen da t`aviant` z'mebze ambobdnen - ch`vent`vis rom daejerebinat`, ar daixoc`ebodneno, - ut`xari:,,mash, sikvdili aic`ilet` t`avidan, t`uki mart`la xart` gulcrp`elni".
isini, vinc` allahis gzaze daig'upnen, ar ip`ik`ro, mkvdrebi ariano, - aranairad. pirik`it`, c`oc`xlebi arian da t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe sazrdooben.

- im sixarulit` ag'savseni, rac` allahma uboz'a t`avisi cqalobis nishnad. da axareben imat`, romlebic` mat` ukan imqop`ebian (c`oc`xlebi) da jer ar sheert`ebian, - rom mat` arc` shishi elit`, arc`a mcuxareba.
- axareben allahisgan boz'ebul madlsa da cqalobas; rom ar caaxdens allahi morcmunet`a sazg'aurs.

- allahisa da misi shuamavlis mocodebas mat` mashinac` dadebit`ad upasuxes, roc`a chriloba da tkivili ganic`ades. t`it`oeuli mat`ganist`vis, vinc` siket`es aket`ebs da visac` g'vt`is shishi ak`vs, - sazg'auria udidesi.
mat`, romelt`ac` xalxma ut`xres: uechvelad, xalxi t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg sheikriba da geshinodet` mat`io, - rcmena sheematat` da t`k`ves:,,ch`vent`vis allahi sakmarisia; ra kargi vek`ilia igi".
allahis cqalobisa da madlis meshveobit`, isini ukan ise dabrundnen, rom c`udi arap`eri mosvliat` da gahqvnen - allahis kmaqop`ilebas. allahi udidesi cqalobis mk`onea.
es mxolod eshmakia, rom t`avisi megobrebit` gashinebt`, da nu sheushindebit` mat`, ch`emi ki geshinodet`, t`uki xart` t`k`ven morcmuneni.
da nu dagamcuxreben isini, vinc` miiscrap`vian urcmunoebisken. cheshmaritad, verap`ers daakleben allahs isini. allahs nebavs, rom arap`eri ergot` mat` imk`veqnad; mat`t`vis mxolod tanjvaa udidesi.
cheshmaritad, verap`ers avneben allahs isini, romlebmac` rcmenis p`asad iqides urcmunoeba, da mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli.
aranairad ar ip`ik`ron urcmunoebma, rom t`uki davac`adet`, kargia es mat`t`vis. uechvelad, ch`ven mat` davac`adet`, rat`a umaton c`odvebs, da mat`t`visaa sasjeli damamc`irebeli.

ararsebulia, ise datovos allahma morcmuneebi, ra mdgomareobashic` t`k`ven imqop`ebit` da ar ganasxvavos usup`t`uri sup`t`isgan. da ararsebulia, allahma uxilavi gac`odinot`, magram allahi imas irch`evs shuamavlad, visac` inebebs. mash ircmunet` allahi da misi shuamavalni. t`uki (namdvilad) gcamt` da (misi) ridi gak`vt`, t`k`vent`visaa sazg'auri udidesi.

da nu egonebat` imat`, romelnic` z'uncoben imashi, rac` allahma t`avisi cqalobit` uboz'a, - rom es kargia mat`t`vis; pirik`it`, es mat`t`vis ubedurebaa. gankit`xvis dg'es kiserze shemoexvevat` is qovelive, rist`visac` z'uncobdnen. allahisaa c`at`a da dedamicis memkvidreoba da mc`odnea allahi im qvelap`risa, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

vp`ic`av, esma allahs mat`i sitqvebi, romlebmac` t`k`ves: uechvelad, g'aribia allahi, ch`ven ki mdidrebi vart`o. ch`ven ch`avicert`: imas, rac` t`k`ves; ambavs mat` mier usamart`lod daxoc`ili mac`neebisas, da vetqvit`:,,igemet` mcveli sasjeli".
es (sasjeli) imist`visaa, rac` t`k`vens xelebs ch`audenia. cheshmaritad, allahi araa usamart`lo msaxurt`a mimart`.

vinc` t`k`ves:cheshmaritad, allahma gvibrz'ana, rom ar gvercmuna (arc` ert`i) shuamavali, vidre ch`vent`an ar movidoda shesaciravit`, romelsac` (qabulobis nishnad c`idan ch`amosuli) c`ec`xli miirt`mevso, - ut`xari:,,t`k`vent`an ch`emze adre mart`lac` movidnen shuamavalni c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit`a da imit`, rac` t`k`vit`. mash, ratom daxoc`et` isini, t`uki namdvilad gulcrp`elni xart`?"
xolo t`u mainc` c`rud migich`nies, - shenze adrec` xom miich`nies c`rud shuamavlebi, romlebic` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit`, cerilebit`a da ganmanat`lebeli cignit` movidnen.

qoveli suli sikvdils igemebs. cheshmaritad, gankit`xvis dg'es srulad mogegebat` t`k`veni sazg'auri. da vinc` ik`neba (jojoxet`is) c`ec`xlisgan ganridebuli da samot`xeshi sheqvanili, is mart`lac` mogebulia. amk`veqniuri c`xovreba sxva arap`eria, t`u ara sargebeli - carmavali da mac`duri.

vp`ic`av, t`k`veni k`onebit`a da sulebit` gamoic`debit` auc`ileblad. visac` t`k`venze adre cigni eboz'at` da vinc` arian carmart`ebi, - ut`uod bevri sheurac`xqop`a mogesmebat` mat`gan, xolo t`u moit`ment` da (allahis) ridi gek`nebat`, cheshmaritad, es mt`eli mondomebit` shesasrulebeli sakit`xebidanaa.

aki, allahma ag't`k`ma daadebina imat`, visac` cigni eboz'at`, rom xalxs auc`ileblad unda ganuc`xadot` igi (cminda cigni) da ar damalot`o. t`umc`a imat` zurgs ukan moisroles igi da mc`ire p`asad gaqides. ra c`udia, rasac` qiduloben.

ar gegonos, rom sasjels gadaurch`ebian isini, vinc` xaroben t`aviant`i namok`medarit` (avi sak`meebit`) da undat`, imist`vis ak`ebdnen, rac` ar gauket`ebiat`. diax, ar ip`ik`ro mat`ze ase; - mcare sasjelia mat`t`vis.
allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da dedamicis ganmgebloba. allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
cheshmaritad, c`at`a da dedamicis gach`enashi da dg'e-g'amis monac`vleobashi - t`valsach`ino sascaulebia goniert`at`vis.

- romelnic` allahs moixsenieben - mdgomareni, mjdomareni t`u mxarze mcolareni, da c`at`a da dedamicis gach`enaze p`ik`roben. g'mert`o ch`veno! tquil-ubralod ar gagich`enia shen es qovelive! shen qovlad unaklo xar! dagvip`are c`ec`xlis satanjvelisgan!
g'mert`o ch`veno! cheshmaritad, visac` shen c`ec`xlshi sheiqvan, mart`lac` samarc`xvino mdgomareobashi ch`aagdeb mas. da aravinaa damxmare - usamart`lot`a.

g'mert`o ch`veno! cheshmaritad, mogvesma ch`ven xma mk`adageblisa, romelic` rcmenisken mogvicodebda, rom t`k`veni g'mert`i ircmunet`o, da ch`venc` vircmunet`. g'mert`o ch`veno! gvapatie ch`veni c`odvebi, dagvip`are ch`ven mier ch`adenili uket`urebani da ket`il xalxt`an ert`ad mogvakvdine!
g'mert`o ch`veno! mogvec`i is, rac` sheni shuamavlebis meshveobit` ag'gvit`k`vi da ar ch`agvagdo gankit`xvis dg'es samarc`xvino mdgomareobashi. cheshmaritad, ar daarg'vev shen ag't`k`mas.

t`aviant`ma g'mert`ma dadebit`ad upasuxat`: cheshmaritad, ar davkargav g'vacls me t`k`vensas, - arc`ert`i mshromelisas - kac`i ik`neba t`u k`ali, - t`k`ven (srulmk`mneli) nacilni xart` ert`manet`isa. xolo mat`, vinc` hijra gaaket`es (sarcmunoebis gamo), t`aviant`i samshoblodan ganidevnen, ch`ems gzaze gasachirshi ag'moch`dnen, ibrz'oles da daig'upnen, - auc`ileblad davup`arav t`aviant` uket`urobebs (carsulshi ch`adenils). auc`ileblad sheviqvan mat` samot`xeebshi, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian, - allahismieri jildos saxit`. cheshmaritad, allaht`anaa jildo - sauket`eso.
ar shegashinos urcmunoebis ert`i k`veqnidan meoreshi z'rcolam!
- (amk`veqniuri ket`ildg'eoba) mc`ire/carmavali sargebelia. jojoxet`ia mat`i t`avshesap`ari, da raoden c`udi sarec`elia igi.

xolo mat`t`vis, visac` ridi hk`ondat` t`aviant`i g'mert`is, - allahisgan, nishnad pativisc`emisa, - samot`xeebia momzadebuli, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian. ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. da rac` allahis cinashea, uket`esia is ket`ilshobilt`at`vis.

cheshmaritad, cignboz'ebult`a shoris arian iset`nic`, visac` scamt` allahi; rac` shen ch`amogevlina da rac` mat` ch`amoevlinat`; shishi ak`vt` allahisa da mc`ire sap`asurad ar qidian allahis aiat`ebs. scored isini arian, jildos rom p`loben t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe. cheshmaritad, allahi mscrap`langarishmgebia.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! moit`minet`, gamz'leoba gamoich`inet`, srul mzadqop`nashi iqavit` da allahis ridi gk`ondet`, - ik`neb gadarch`et`.

ei, adamianebo! ridi gk`ondet` t`k`veni g'mert`isa, romelmac` gagach`inat` ert`i sulisagan, shemdeg misgan misi meug'le gaach`ina da mat`gan uamravi kac`i da k`ali gaamravla. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, romlis saxelit`ac` survilebs uc`xadebt` ert`manet`s, da nat`esauri kavshiris gacqvetasac` up`rt`xildit`. ut`uod, allahi gmet`valqureobt`.

miec`it` oblebs t`aviant`i k`oneba (roc`a srulclovanni gaxdebian), ar gadac`valot` spetaki (halali) ucmindurshi (haramit`) da arc` k`oneba miirt`vat` mat`i - t`k`vens k`onebast`an ert`ad. ut`uod, didi c`odvaa eg.

da t`u shishobt`, rom ver daic`avt` samart`lianobas oblebt`an (k`vrivt`an k`orcinebis shemt`xvevashi), mashin im k`alebidan, vinc` halalia t`k`vent`vis, - sheirt`et` ori, sami an ot`xi; xolo t`u shishobt`, rom ver daic`avt` samart`lianobas (mat` shoris), mashin - ert`i (ikmaret`) an is, rasac` p`lobs t`k`veni marjvena. es qvelaze kargi xerxia, rom ar gadaixarot` (usamart`lobisken).
mash, ket`ili nebit` miec`it` k`alebs t`aviant`i mehri, xolo isini t`u t`aviant`i nebit` ik`idan rames dagit`moben, mashin shergebulad miirt`vit` igi.
nu miandobt` t`k`vens (meurveobashi mqop`) k`onebas chkuasustebs, risi gankargvac` allahs t`k`vent`vis moubarebia; daapuret` da shemoset` imit` da ket`ili sitqva ut`xarit` mat`.

gamosc`adet` oblebi sheug'lebis asakamde da roc`a darcmundebit` mat` zrdasrulobashi, - mashin daubrunet` t`aviant`i k`oneba. ar shechamot` igi nach`k`arevad - mp`langvelobit`a da mat`i zrdasrulobis shishit`. vinc` mdidaria, t`avi sheikavos, xolo vinc` g'aribia, man zomierad miirt`vas. roc`a t`aviant` k`onebas ukan daubrunebt`, mocme t`an iqoliet`... da allahi kmara angarishmgebad.

vazhishvilebs cili ergebat` mshoblebisa da nat`esavebis danatovaridan; da k`alishvilebs cili ergebat` mshoblebisa da nat`esavebis danatovridan, miuxedavad imisa, c`ota ik`neba t`u bevri; - garkveuli cili auc`ilebelia.
roc`a memkvidreobis gaqop`as escrebian nat`esavebi, oblebi da upovrebi, - mat`ac` uciladet` imisgan da ket`ili sitqva ut`xarit`.

(oblebt`an dakavshirebit`) shishi hk`ondet`* imat`, romelnic` dardoben, rom vait`u (gardavic`valot` da) ukan uz'luri sht`amomavloba dagvrch`eso. ridi hk`ondet` allahisa da mxolod ket`ili sitqva t`k`van.
cheshmaritad, isini, vinc` usamart`lod chamen obolt`a k`onebas, - mxolod c`ec`xls shechamen t`aviant` muc`lebshi da c`ec`xlshi shevlen isini, agizgizebulshi.

shvilebt`an dakavshirebit` allahi gicesebt`: vazhs - ori k`alishvilis cilis t`anabari ergeba; xolo t`u k`alishvilebi orze metni ik`nebian (da arc`ert`i vazhi), mashin mat` memkvidreobis ori mesamedi ergebat`; xolo t`u mxolod ert`i k`alishvilia, mashin mas naxevari ergeba; t`u shvili hqavs (gardac`vlils), mashin mis mshoblebs, t`it`oeuls, - memkvidreobis meek`vsedi; xolo t`u ar hqavs (shvili) da mxolod mshoblebi arian misi memkvidreebi, mashin dedas mesamedi ergeba (danarch`eni mamas darch`eba); da t`u dedmamishvilebic` hqavs (gardac`vlils), mashin deda meek`vseds miig'ebs. es qovelive mxolod anderz'is ag'srulebis an valis gastumrebis shemdeg unda shesruldes. t`k`ven ar ic`it`, vin up`ro sargebliania t`k`vent`vis - t`k`veni mamebi t`u t`k`veni shvilebi. es qvelap`eri allahis dadgenili valdebulebebia. cheshmaritad, allahi brz'enia, qovlismc`odne.

t`k`ven gergebat` t`k`veni c`olebis danatovris naxevari, t`u ar hqavt` mat` shvili; xolo t`u shvili hqavt`, mashin gergebat` mat`i danatovris meot`xedi - mas shemdeg, roc`a ag'sruldeba anderz'i an/da moixdeba valebi; aseve: mat` ergebat` t`k`veni danatovris meot`xedi, t`u shvili ar gqavt`; xolo t`u shvili gqavt`, mashin mat` ergebat` t`k`veni danatovris mervedi - mas shemdeg, roc`a ag'sruldeba anderz'i an/da moixdeba valebi; t`u kac`s an k`als ise ememkvidreebian, rogorc` k`elaale, da mas hqavs (dedit`) z'ma an da, mashin t`it`oeul mat`gans meek`vsedi ergeba; xolo t`u amaze (ert`ze) meti ik`nebian, mashin isini t`anaziarni ik`nebian mesamedshi - mas shemdeg, roc`a t`it`oeulis dauzaraleblad ag'sruldeba anderz'i an moixdeba valebi: - (es) allahis mier dacesebuli normebia; allahi qovlismc`odnea, lmobieri.

amgvaria sazg'vrebi allahisa, xolo vinc` hmorch`ilebs allahsa da mis shuamavals, (allahi) mas sheiqvans samot`xeebshi, romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian. ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. ai, esaa mig'ceva - udidesi.
xolo vinc` eurch`eba allahsa da mis shuamavals da sc`deba mis (allahis) sazg'vrebs, - c`ec`xlshi sheiqvans (allahi) mas, ik` ik`neba maradzhams da mist`visaa - sasjeli damamc`irebeli.

mat`, vinc` imrusheben t`k`veni k`alebidan, - mocmed dauqenet` ot`xi t`k`vengani; da t`u daamocmeben, mashin saxlebshi sheakavet`, vidre sikvdili ar miibarebs mat` an sxva gamosavals ar daadgens allahi.
romeli oric` amas ch`aidens t`k`vengan, orive mat`gani sasjelit` daamcuxret`; xolo t`u moinanies, mashin moeshvit`! cheshmaritad, allahi monanult`a usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
cheshmaritad, allahi iqabulebs imat` sinanuls, romelnic` umec`rebit` sch`adian uket`urobas, mere ki maleve nanoben; scoredac` iqabulebs allahi mat` sinanuls. allahi brz'enia, qovlis mc`odne.

ar miig'eba sinanuli imat`i, romlebic` uket`urebas sch`adian, vidre romelime mat`gans sikvdili ar mouscrebdes da shemdeg itqodes, rom cheshmaritad, axla movinanieo; da arc` imat`i, romlebic` urcmunoebad daixoc`nen. scored mat`t`vis gavamzadet` mcare sasjeli.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar aris t`k`vent`vis halali, rom iz'ulebit` moik`c`iot` k`alebi memkvidreobashi da k`orcinebis up`leba sheuzg'udot`, rat`a caart`vat` imis nacili, rac` mat`t`vis migic`iat` (mehris saxit`), garda im shemt`xvevisa, t`uki ashkara uzneoba ch`aidines. ket`ilad moepqarit` mat`, t`undac` ar mogcondet` isini. shesaz'loa, ar mogcondet` rag'ac`, magram allahs masshi didi siket`e hk`ondes ch`adebuli.

da t`u moicadinebt`, rom ert`i c`olis nac`vlad sheirt`od meore, da mat`gan pirvelist`vis t`undac` ut`valavi simdidre gk`ondet` mic`emuli, - ik`idan arap`eri gamoart`vat`! nut`u caart`mevt` mas c`iliscamebit`a da c`xadi borotebit`?
an rogorg'a caart`mevt` (rogor ikadrebt` cart`mevas), roc`a t`k`ven ukve ganumartovdit` ert`manet`s da mat`ac` mtkic`e piroba aig'es t`k`vengan?
ar sheirt`ot` is k`alebi, romlebic` t`k`vens mamebs hqavdat` shert`uli, garda imisa, rac` ukve carsuls ch`abarda. uechvelad, uzneoba (g'vt`is) cqromis mizezia da c`udi gzaa igi.

t`k`vent`vis haramia (rom sheirt`ot`): t`k`veni dedebi, k`alishvilebi, debi, mamidebi, deidebi, z'mis k`alishvilebi, dis k`alishvilebi, (is) z'iz'ebi, romlebmac` z'uz'u gacovat`, z'uz'umte debi, t`k`veni c`olebis dedebi, (is) geri k`alishvilebi, romlebic` t`k`vens saxlshi izrdebian, - im c`olebidan, romlebsac` ukve et`anac`xovret`, xolo t`u mat`t`an ar gic`xovriat` (da ise gaeqaret`), mashin (mat`i shert`va) ar aris c`odva t`k`vent`vis. aseve (t`k`vent`vis haramia), t`k`vens sht`amomaval vazht`a c`olebi da ori da rom ert`doulad sheirt`ot`, garda imisa, rac` ukve carsuls ch`abarda. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mcqalobeli.

(gekrz'alebat`) aseve gat`xovili k`alebi, garda imisa, rac` moipova t`k`venma marjvenam. es qvelap`eri allahis mier t`k`venze dakisrebuli valdebulebebia, xolo ak` ch`amot`vlilis mig'ma rac` darch`a, - t`u t`k`veni k`onebit` ez'iebt` patiosnurad (shert`vas) da ara siz'vis miznit`, mashin halalia. ra sargebelic` miig'ot` mat`gan (sheug'lebit`), shesabamisi gadasaxadic` miec`it` (mehri). gansazg'vruli gadasaxadis mic`emis shemdeg t`u morigdebit` urt`iert`kmaqop`ilebit`, - amashi c`odva ar dagedebat`. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odne brz'enia.

xolo romel t`k`vengansac` ar qop`nis saxsrebi t`avisup`ali morcmune k`alebis shesart`avad, - is morcmune gogo sheirt`os, rac` moipova misma marjvenam. allahma uket` ic`is t`k`veni rcmenis shesaxeb, t`k`ven xom ert`i-meorisgan xart`. mash, t`u ik`nebian patiosnad da aravis gaich`enen memrushed da saqvarlad, - sheirt`et` isini t`aviant`i meurveebis t`anxmobit` da gadauxadet` mehri cesisamebr, xolo sheug'lebis shemdeg t`u imrushes, - mat`i sasjeli t`avisup`ali k`alebis sasjelis naxevaria. es mat`t`visaa, visac` siz'vis eshinia; rom moit`minot`, up`ro xeiriania t`k`vent`vis. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mcqalobeli.
allahs unda, rom c`xadad gangimartot`, dagaqenot` t`k`venze adre mqop`t`a gzebze da iqabulos t`k`veni sinanuli. allahi qovlis mc`odne brz'enia.
allahs unda, rom t`k`veni sinanuli iqabulos, xolo vnebebs aqolilt` undat`, rom didi c`domilebit` gadaixarot` (cheshmaritebisgan).
allahs unda, rom shegimsubuk`ot`, - adamiani xom sust arsebadaa shek`mnili.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar shechamot` ert`manet`is k`oneba usamart`lod, urt`iert`kmaqop`ilebit` vachrobis gareshe, da arc` t`k`veni sulebi daxoc`ot`. cheshmaritad, allahi mocqalea t`k`ven mimart`.
xolo vinc` es ch`aidinos mtrobit`a da usamart`lobit`, - c`ec`xlshi sheviqvant` mas. es ki iolia allahist`vis.
t`u did c`odvebs moeridebit`, romlebic` gekrz'alebat`, - mashin davp`aravt` t`k`vens (mc`ire) uket`urobebs da siuxvit` gamorch`eul shesasvlelshi shegiqvant`.

da ar isurvot` is, rit`ac` allahma t`k`ven shoris zogiert`i zogiert`ze upirateshqo. kac`ebi miig'eben xvedrs ik`idan, rac` mouxvechavt`; da k`alebic` miig'eben xvedrs ik`idan, rac` mouxvechavt`. mash, allahs st`xovet` cqaloba, cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odnea.

ch`ven t`it`oeuls davudginet` memkvidreoba imashi, rac` mshoblebsa da nat`esavebs dautovebiat` mat`t`vis. xolo vist`anac` p`ic`i dagidviat`, mat`ac` miec`it` kut`vnili cili. cheshmaritad, allahi qvelap`ris mocmea.

mamakac`ebi k`alebis meurveebi arian imit`, rac` allahma mat`ze meti ucqalobat` da imit`, rasac` xarjaven t`aviant`i k`onebidan. patiosani k`alebi morch`ilni arian da t`valsmip`arebul mdgomareobashic` ki ic`aven imas, rac` allahis mxridanaa dac`uli, xolo romelt`a t`avxedobasac` shishobt`, mat` jer sheagonet`, shemdeg sacolidan ganuc`alkevdit`, bolos ki (t`u cina mc`delobebma shedegi ar gamoig'o) msubuk`ad daartqit`, da t`u dagmorch`ildebian, - nug'ar daicqebt` mizezebis z'iebas mat` sacinaag'mdegod. cheshmaritad allahi uzenaesi da udiadesia.

da t`u shishobt`, rom mat` shoris moxdeba ganxet`k`ileba, mashin cargzavnet` ert`i msajuli k`mris ojaxidan da meore msajuli c`olis ojaxidan. t`uki orive gamoscorebas isurveben, allahi mat` t`anxvedrashi moiqvans. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odnea; qovlismc`nobi.

mash, iqavit` allahis mot`aqvaneni da arap`eri ut`anaziarot`... da ket`ili iqavit` mshobelt`a, axlobelt`a, obolt`a, g'atakt`a, axlo mezobelt`a, shoreul mezobelt`a, gverdshi mdgom megobart`a, mgzavrt`a da imat` mimart`, visac` p`lobs t`k`veni marjvena. cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars igi, vinc` t`avmomcone da mediduria.
- romelnic` z'uncoben da xalxsac` siz'unces moucodeben; malaven imas, rac` mat`t`vis allahs uboz'ebia t`avisi cqalobidan. amitom damamc`irebeli sasjeli gavamzadet` urcmunoebist`vis;
- da isinic`, romelnic` k`onebas xalxis dasanaxad xarjaven da ar scamt` allahi, arc` dg'e ukanaskneli; aseve is, visac` megobrad eshmaki eqoleba. raoden c`udi megobaria igi.
ra simz'imed daacvebodat`, t`uki ircmunebdnen allahsa da ukanasknel dg'es, da gaig'ebdnen ik`idan, rac` allahma ucqaloba? allahma xom qvelap`eri ic`is mat` shesaxeb.
cheshmaritad, allahi ert` saxe usamart`lobasac` ar izams, xolo vinc` raime siket`es izams, - gaumravalkec`ebs mas da udides jildos miagebs t`avisi ciag'idan.
mashin ki ra moxdeba, roc`a mocmeebs moviqvant` qoveli t`emidan da shenc` mogiqvant` mocmed amat` cinaag'mdeg?!
- im dg'es, vinc` ar ircmunes da shuamavals eurch`nen, isini inatreben, rom micad k`c`euliqvnen... da mat` allahs ert`i sitqvac` ki ver daumalon.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar miuaxlovdet` namazs mashin, roc`a xart` mt`vrali, - manam, vidre ar gagegebat`, t`u ras ambobt`; da arc` ucmindurobisas, sanam ar ganibanebit`, garda mgzavrebisa; xolo t`u avad ik`nebit`, an mgzavrobashi, an sapirp`areshodan gamoxvalt`, an kidev k`alebs sheexebit` da cqals ver ipovit`, mashin sup`t`a micit` t`eimmumi gaaket`et` da saxesa da xelebze ch`amoisvit`. cheshmaritad, allahi mocqalea; usazg'vrod mpatiebeli.
gana ver xedav imat`, visac` cili xvda cignisa? gzaac`denilobas qiduloben da undat`, rom t`k`venc` asc`det` gzas.
allahma uket` ic`is t`k`veni mtrebi; kmara allahi mp`arvelad da kmara allahi damxmared.

iudevelt`agan zogiert`ni adgils uc`vlian sitqvebs da amboben: movisminet` da veurch`et`; mogvismine da aramc` gsmenodes; ra'ina - ase amaxinjeben mat`i enit`, rat`a sheurac`xqon sarcmunoeba. mat` rom et`k`vat`, movisminet` da davemorch`ilet`; mogvismine da mogvxedeo, rat`k`maunda es mat`t`visve up`ro xeiriani da samart`liani ik`neboda. magram dascqevla isini allahma t`aviant`i urcmunoebis gamo da ar ircmuneben, garda mc`iredisa.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` cigni geboz'at`! ircmunet` is (qurani), rac` t`k`vent`an arsebulis (t`oras) damamocmeblad ch`amovavlinet`, vidre (t`k`veni) saxeebi cagvishlia da uku shegvibrunebia, an vidre dagvicqevlia ise, rogorc` shabat`is xalxi davcqevlet`. allahis brz'aneba ag'srulebadia.
cheshmaritad, ar apatiebs allahi, roc`a mas ut`anaziareben, da amis garda qvelap`ers patiobs mat`, visac` moisurvebs. da vinc` allahs ut`anaziara, man mart`lac` didi c`odva dascama.
gana ar ginaxavs isini, romelt`ac` t`avi uc`odvelebad moak`vt`? - pirik`it`, allahi gancmends mas, visac` isurvebs, da p`et`ilisodena usamart`lobasac` ki ar gadaeqrebian.
shexede, rogor t`xzaven sic`rues allahis shesaxeb, da es sakmarisia ashkara c`odvis dadebist`vis.
gana ver xedav mat`, remelt`ac` cili xvdat` cignidan, - jibt`isa da tag'ut`isa scamt` da urcmunot`a shesaxeb amboben, rom eseni up`ro cheshmarit gzaze dganan, vidre isini, vinc` ircmuneso?!
egeni arian isini, vinc` allahma dacqevla da allahma vinc` dacqevlos, mist`vis veravin hpovo damxmared.
an ik`neb cili ekut`vnit` xelmcip`ebashi? - ase rom qop`iliqo, xalxist`vis naqirsac` ki ar gaimetebdnen.
an ik`neb shurt` xalxisa, imis gamo, rac` allahma t`avisi cqalobidan mihmadla? cheshmaritad, ibrahimis modgmas ch`ven cigni da sibrz'ne mivec`it` da uzarmazari xelmcip`ebac` vuboz'et`.
mat`gan arian, vinc` ircmunes igi da mat`gan arian isini, vinc` zurgi sheak`c`ies. jojoxet`i sakmarisia mat`t`vis (urcmunoebist`vis) agizgizebuli c`ec`xlit`.

cheshmaritad, vinc` ar ircmunes ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, - bolos mat` c`ec`xlshi sheviqvant`; qovel jerze, rogorc` ki kani daecvebat`, axali kanit` ch`avunac`vlebt`, rat`a kargad igemon mat`i sasjeli. cheshmaritad, allahi brz'enia, z'levamosili.

xolo romelt`ac` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, mat` sheviqvant` samot`xeebshi, romlt`a k`veshac` - dian mdinareni. ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. ik` arian mat`t`vis umcikvlo meug'leebi da ch`rdilshi sheviqvant` - maradiul sach`rdilobelshi.

cheshmaritad, allahi gibrz'anebt`, rom amanat`i patrons daubrunot` da roc`a adamianebs shoris msajulobt`, samart`lianad imsajulet`. mart`lac`, ra mshvenieria is, rit`ac` allahi shegagonebt`. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mxedvelia.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! daemorch`ilet` allahs, daemorch`ilet` shuamavals da t`k`ven shoris mqop` met`aurebs, xolo t`u romelime sakit`xshi ut`anxmoeba mogividet`, mashin allaht`an da mis shuamavalt`an miitanet` igi. t`uki gcamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli, es up`ro xeiriani da umshvenieresi shedegis momtani ik`neba.

gana ver xedav imat`, romlebic` amtkic`eben, rom scamt` is, rac` shen ch`amogevlina da rac` ch`amoevlinat` shenze adre? mat` undat`, rom tag'ut`is cinashe ganisajon, arada misi uarqop`a k`ondat` nabrz'anebi. eshmaks unda, rom scori gzidan shors gadaiqvanos, gzaabnevashi.
roc`a etqvian: modit` imast`an, rac` allahma ch`amoavlina, da shuamavalt`ano, mashin dainaxav, t`u rogor ibruneben pirs shengan da gagec`lebian - p`arisevelni.

da ra ik`neba mashin, roc`a gansac`deli ecevat` imis gamo, rac` ch`aidines mat`ma xelebma; shemdeg shent`an movlen da allahis dap`ic`ebas daicqeben, rom ch`ven amit` sxva arap`eri gvsurda, garda siket`isa da t`anxmobisao?
egeni arian, romelt`a shesaxebac` ic`is allahma, t`u ra aris mat` gulebshi. mash, moeride mat`, sheagone da sulshich`amcvdomi sitqva ut`xari.

ch`ven qvela shuamavali mxolod imist`vis carmovgzavnet`, rom allahis nebit` mas damorch`ilebodnen. roc`a isini (p`arisevelni) usamart`lod moek`c`nen t`aviant` sulebs, - mashinve rom shent`an mosuliqvnen da allahist`vis patieba et`xovat`, da shuamavalic` rom mat`i patiebist`vis vedrebas ag'avlenda, isini ut`uod hpovebdnen allahs - monanult`a usazg'vrod mpatiebels, mcqalobels.

- ara da ara! vp`ic`av shens g'mert`s, rom ise ver ircmuneben, sanam ar agirch`even msajulad imashi, rashic` ut`anxmoebaa mat` shoris, da sanam savsebit` ar damorch`ildebian shen mier mig'ebul ganach`ens ise, rom mc`iredi sachochmanoc` ver hpovon t`aviant` gulebshi.

t`undac` dagvekisra mat`t`vis, rom daxoc`et` ert`manet`i an miatovet` t`k`veni samshobloo, amas mc`iredis garda arc`ert`i mat`gani ar izamda. ra rch`evebsac` g'ebulobdnen isini, mart`lac` rom sheesrulebinat`, ra t`k`ma unda, up`ro meti xeiri da simtkic`e ik`neboda es mat`t`vis.
da mashin ch`veni ciag'idan auc`ileblad mivagebdit` mat` udides jildos (samot`xes).
da ut`uod, scori gzit` davakvalianebdit` mat`.

xolo vinc` morch`ilia allahisa da shuamavlisa, scored egeni ik`nebian imat`t`an ert`ad, viszec` cqaloba moig'o allahma: mac`neebt`an, ert`gulebt`an, shehidebt`an da sat`noebt`an. ra mshvenieri t`anmxlebni arian isini.
esaa madli allahisa da kmara allahi qovlismc`odned.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! (sabrz'olo mzadqop`na da) sip`rt`xile moikribet` da (mtris cinaag'mdeg) jgup`-jgup`ad gaemart`et` an ert`ianad gaeshuret`.

uechvelad, auc`ileblad ik`neba t`k`venshi vinme iset`i, vinc` p`exs ait`revs (brz'olisas). xolo t`u ubedureba shegemt`xvat`, mashin itqvis: cheshmaritad, allahma cqaloba moig'o ch`emze, rom mat`t`an ert`ad ar viqavi imis momscre.
da t`u cqaloba gxvdat` allahisgan, mashin ise itqvis, t`it`k`os t`k`vensa da mas shoris sulac` ar qop`iliqo siqvaruli:,,mat`t`an ert`ad rom vqop`iliqavi, mec` did carmatebas movipovebdi"-o.
mash, allahis gzaze iomon mat`, romlebic` amk`veqniur c`xovrebas imk`veqniuris p`asad qidian. xolo vinc` iomos allahis gzaze da mokvdes an gaimarjvos, - mas mivagebt` udides jildos.

da ra gemart`ebat`, rom allahis gzaze ar omobt` mashin, roc`a uz'luri kac`ebi, k`alebi da bavshvebi amboben:,,g'mert`o ch`veno! gvixseni am k`alak`idan, romlis mkvidrnic` mch`agvrelebi arian, sheni ciag'idan mogvivline mxsneli da sheni ciag'idanve dagvidgine damxmare."
isini, vinc` ircmunes, allahis gzaze omoben, xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes, tag'ut`is gzaze omoben. mash, eomet` eshmakis momxreebs. cheshmaritad, eshmakis xrikebi ususuria.

gana ver xedav imat`, romlebsac` ut`xres: xeli aig'et` (brz'olaze), namazi ag'asrulet` da zek`at`i gaec`it`o. xolo rodesac` savaldebulod dadginda mat`ze omi, mashin, mat` nacils ise sheeshindat` xalxis, rogorc` allahisa eshinodat`, an up`ro z'lierma shishma sheipqro, da t`k`ves:,,g'mert`o ch`veno! ratom dagvidgine omi savaldebulod? netav axlo momavlamde gadagevadebina igi ch`vent`vis''. ut`xari: amk`veqniuri sargebeli mc`irea, xolo imk`veqniuri umjobesia mist`vis, vinc` g'vt`ismoshishia, xolo t`k`ven p`et`ilisodena usamart`lobasac` ki ar gadaeqrebit`.

sadac` ar unda iqot`, sikvdili mainc` mogcvdebat`, - t`undac` mtkic`e da mag'al c`ixesimagreebshi... - da t`u siket`e xvdat`, amboben:,,es allahisganaa"; xolo t`u ubedureba sheemt`xvat`, mashin amboben:,,es sheni bralia (muhammed)''. ut`xari: qvelap`eri allahisganaa. ra chirs am xalxs, rom ar c`diloben sitqvis shesmenas.
-,,ra siket`ec` gxvda, allahisganaa, xolo ra ubedurebac` shegemt`xva, - shengan": ch`ven carggzavnet` shuamavlad xalxist`vis da kmara mocmed allahi.
vinc` hmorch`ilebs shuamavals, is ut`uod, morch`ilia allahisa, xolo vinc` pirs ibrunebs, - ra t`k`ma unda, ch`ven ar carmogvigzavnixar mat` met`valqured.

(p`arisevelni) morch`ilebas gic`xadeben, magram roc`a shengan midian, mat`i nacili sul sxvas gegmavs g'amit`, vidre shen ambob. allahi icers qvelap`ers, rasac` isini g'amit` gegmaven. mash, ganudek`i mat` da allahs miende... da kmara allahi vek`ilad.
nut`u qurans ar gaiazreben? igi sxvagnidan rom mosuliqo, garda allahisa, - auc`ileblad hpovebdnen uamrav sheusabamobas.

da roc`a raime c`noba ag'cevs mat`t`an usap`rt`xoebis an sap`rt`xis shesaxeb, - mashinve avrc`eleben mas. magram shuamavalt`an an t`aviant` mmart`velebt`an (scavlulebt`an) rom mietanat` igi, ut`uod dakvaliandebodnen isini, romlebsac` misi sat`anado shep`asebis unari gaach`niat`. allahis siket`e da cqaloba rom ar qop`iliqo t`k`venze, ut`uod eshmaks gahqvebodit`, garda mc`iredisa.

mash, ibrz'ole allahis gzaze; aravin aiz'ulo, garda sakut`ari t`avisa, da sheaguliane morcmuneebi (sabrz'olvelad)! ra t`k`ma unda, sheakavebs allahi mat` z'alas, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes. allahi qvelaze didi z'alisa da sasjelis mk`onea.
vinc` ket`ilad ishuamdgomlebs, mas xvedri ek`neba misgan; xolo vinc` borotad ishuamdgomlebs, masac` ek`neba cili. uzenaesi allahi qovlismxedvelia.
da roc`a gesalmebian, t`k`ven uket`esad miesalmet` an igivenairad. cheshmaritad, allahi ag'mric`xvelia qovelivesi.
allahi... - ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi, - auc`ileblad shegkrebt` igi gankit`xvis dg'es, rashic` echvi ar arsebobs... da vinaa allahze up`ro sitqva-mart`ali?

da ra gemart`ebat`, rom p`arisevlebt`an mimart`ebashi or jgup`ad iqop`it`? allahma ukuak`c`ia isini imist`vis, rac` mat` moixveches. gindat`, rom scor gzaze daaqenot` is, vinc` gzas aac`dina allahma? visac` aac`dens allahi, (shen) veranair gamosavals gamonaxav imat`t`vis!

- natroben, neta t`k`venc` urcmunod gadaik`c`et`, rogorc` t`vit`on ar ircmunes, da iqot` mat`i t`anascorni. amitom aravin aiqvanot` mat`gan megobrad, vidre hijras ar gaaket`eben allahis gzaze, xolo t`u piri ibrunes, mashin sheipqarit` da daxoc`et`, sadac` caacqdebit`. arc` megobari iqoliot` mat`gan da arc` damxmare.

- garda imat`i, romlebic` t`avs ap`areben xalxs, romlebt`anac` (samshvidobo) shet`anxmeba gak`vt`, an imat`i, romlebic` movidnen da guli ar miudit` omze t`k`vent`an an t`aviant` xalxt`an. allahs rom eneba, isini ut`uod gaz'lierdebodnen t`k`venze da geomebodnen kidec`. amitom, t`uki gagec`lebian, xels aig'eben omze t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg da mshvidobas shemogt`avazeben, - allahi ar gaz'levt` gzas mat` cinaag'mdeg (sabrz'olvelad).

aseve hpovebt` sxvebs, romlebsac` usap`rt`xoeba surt` - t`k`venganac` da t`aviant`i xalxisganac`. qovelt`vis, roc`a p`it`nasken moucodeben, mashinve c`vivdebian masshi. t`uki ar gagec`lebian, ar shemogt`avazeben mshvidobas da ar moishlian xelis ag'mart`vas, mashin daichiret` da ik`ve daxoc`et`, sadac` caacqdebit`. scored egeni arian, vis cinaag'mdegac` ashkara samxili mogvic`ia t`k`vent`vis.

daushvebelia, morcmunem moklas morcmune, garda shec`domisa. xolo vinc` shec`domit` moklas morcmune, misi valia, morcmune monis gat`avisup`leba da (moklulis) ojaxist`vis sisxlis gamosasqidis gadaxda, t`uki (moklulis ojaxma) mocqalebis saxit` ar apatia. xolo t`u (mokluli) im xalxidanaa, romelic` t`k`veni mteria, magram t`vit`on morcmunea, mashin (mxolod) morcmune monis gat`avisup`leba. xolo t`u im xalxidanaa, romelt`anac` zavi dagidviat`, mashin misi ojaxist`vis sisxlis gamosasqidis gadaxda da morcmune monis gat`avisup`leba. xolo visac` ar moepoveba (gamosasqidis sashualeba), man ori t`ve ucqvetliv imarxos, allahis cinashe sinanulis nishnad. allahi qovlis mc`odne brz'enia.
da vinc` ganzrax moklas morcmune, - misi sasjeli jojoxet`ia da ik` ik`neba maradzhams. allahi gaucqra mas, dascqevla da udidesi sasjeli gaamzada mist`vis.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a allahis gzaze (sabrz'olvelad) gaemart`ebit`, kargad ganasxvavet` (morcmune da urcmuno), da vinc` mogesalmebat`, amk`veqniuri sargeblis miznit` ar ut`xrat` mas - shen ar xar morcmuneo. allahis cinashea uric`xvi alap`i (nadavli). adre t`k`venc` ase iqavit` da shemdeg allahma madli moig'o t`k`venze. ase rom, kargad gaarkviet`. cheshmaritad, ic`is allahma, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

morcmunet`a shoris umizezod shin msxdomni ver ut`anascordebian mat`, vinc` allahis gzaze t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sulebit` ibrz'vian. t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sulit` mebrz'olni - upirateshqo allahma shin msxdomebze. allahma orives siket`e ag'ut`k`va, t`umc`a mebrz'olebi shin msxdomebt`an shedarebit` udidesi jildot`i upirateshqo.
misganaa sxvadasxva xarisxi, patieba da cqaloba. allahi usazg'vrod mimtevebeli da mcqalobelia.

cheshmaritad, roc`a miibares angelozebma isini, romlebic` usamart`loni iqvnen t`aviant`i sulebis mimart`, - hkit`xes: rit` iqavit` dakavebulni? mat` t`k`ves: uz'lurni viqavit` dedamicazeo. (angelozebmac`) ut`xres: gana allahis dedamica ar iqo ganieri, rom sxvagan gadasaxlebuliqavit`? ai, mat`i samqop`elia jojoxet`i, da ra c`udi misak`c`ielia igi.
- garda uz'luri kac`ebis, k`alebis da bavshvebisa, romlebsac` moxerxeba ar hqop`nit`, rom raime gzas daadgnen.
- ai, mat`t`visaa imedi, rom allahi apatiebs; allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mimtevebeli.

da vinc` hijras gaaket`ebs allahis gzaze, is hpovebs dedamicaze mraval t`avshesap`arsa da siuxves; da vinc` t`avisi saxlidan gava, rogorc` allahisa da misi shuamavlisken mimavali muhajiri, shemdeg ki (gzashi) sikvdili eceva, uechvelad, misi madli allahzea; allahi usazg'vrod mimtevebelia, mcqalobeli.
da roc`a k`veqnad samogzaurod gaeshurebit`, c`odva ar dagedebat`, namazi rom sheamoklot`, t`uki mat` t`avdasxmas shishobt`, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes. cheshmaritad, ashkarad gmtroben t`k`ven urcmunoebi.

roc`a mat` shoris ik`nebi da mat`t`vis loc`vis cinamz'g'vrobas daapireb, shent`an ert`ad ert`i jgup`i dadges imat`gan, - t`an iarag'ebi echirot`; roc`a sejdes ag'avlenen, shemdeg t`k`vens ukan gadavidnen, xolo meore jgup`i, romelsac` jer ar uloc`avs, movides da shent`an ert`ad iloc`os, t`an sip`rt`xile ik`onios da iarag'ic`; urcmunoebi natroben, rom quradg'eba moscqvitot` iarag'sa da sachiro nivt`ebs, rat`a moulodneli t`avdasxma mogicqon. c`odvad ar dagedebat`, cvimit` an avadmqop`obit` shecuxebulni t`u iarag's ch`amoixsnit`, magram sip`rt`xile mainc` gmart`ebt`. cheshmaritad, allahma damamc`irebeli sasjeli gaamzada urcmunoebist`vis.

xolo rodesac` (sap`t`xis k`vesh) loc`vas morch`ebit`, axsenet` allahi - dgomisas, jdomisas t`u mxarze camocolilni, da roc`a guls daimshvidebt` usap`rt`xoebit`, mashin (srulad) ag'avlinet` namazi. cheshmaritad, gansazg'vrul droebshi namazi savaldebuloa morcmunet`at`vis.

t`avs nu daisustebt` (momtro) xalxis devnashi: t`k`ven t`u gtkivat`, ut`uod, mat`ac` stkivat`; (magram) t`k`ven gak`vt` allahisgan imis molodini, risi molodinic` mat` ar gaach`niat`. allahi qovlismc`odne brz'enia.
uechvelad, ch`ven es cigni ch`amogivlinet` cheshmaritebit`urt`, rat`a adamiant`a shoris gansajo imit`, rac` allahma gich`vena, da nu ik`nebi mog'alatet`a k`omagi.
da shest`xove allahs patieba. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mcqalobeli.
da nurc` mat` dasac`avad gairjebi, sakut`ar sulebs rom g'alatoben. cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars, vinc` veragi da c`odvilia.

isini xalxs umalaven, t`umc`a allahs verap`ers daumalaven, radgan is mat`t`anaa (mashinac`), roc`a g'am-g'amobit` ch`um-ch`umad bchoben imaze, rac` mist`vis mouconaria. namdvilad, allahia qovlis garemomc`veli, rasac` isini sch`adian.
diax, c`dilobt`, t`k`ven daic`vat` isini amier sop`elshi, magram allahis cinashe vin daic`avs an vin ik`neba mat`i vek`ili gankit`xvis dg'es?
da vinc` uket`urebas ch`aidens an usamart`lod moek`c`eva sakut`ar suls, - t`u shemdeg allahs patiebas shest`xovs, is allahs hpovebs usazg'vrod mpatiebelsa da mcqalobels.
da c`odvas vinc` moixvechs, - igi mxolod t`avisi sulis sacinaag'mdegod moixvechs. allahi qovlis mc`odne brz'enia.
da vinc` shec`domas daushvebs an c`odvas ch`aidens, shemdeg ki udanashaulos gadaabralebs, uechvelad, igi c`iliscamebasa da c`xad c`odvas itvirt`avs.

allahis madli da cqaloba rom ara shendami, - mat` ert` jgup`s sheni c`duneba mart`lac` ecada, magram sxvas veravis sheac`denen, garda sakut`ari sulisa, da verc` verap`ers gavneben. allahma shen cigni da sibrz'ne ch`amogivlina da gascavla is, rac` ar ic`odi... da madli allahisa udidesia shendami.

uxeiroa mat` saidumlo bchobat`agan umetesoba, garda imisa, vinc` adamianebs mocqalebis gag'ebis, an siket`is ket`ebis, an kidev urt`iert`obebis gamoscorebisken moucodebs, da vinc` amas allahis kmaqop`ilebis mopovebis miznit` gaaket`ebs, ch`ven mas udides jildos mivagebt`.

da vinc` shuamavals sheec`ilos, mas shemdeg, rac` ukve gac`xadda mist`vis gza cheshmariti, da gauqves im gzas, romelic` ar aris morcmuneebisa, - mivak`c`evt` mas ik`it`, sait`kenac` gezi aig'o da shevuz'axebt` jojoxet`shi... da ra c`udi samqop`elia igi.
cheshmaritad, ar apatiebs allahi, roc`a mas ut`anaziareben, amis garda ki qvelap`ers patiobs mat`, visac` moisurvebs, da vinc` allahs ut`anaziara, man mart`lac` didi c`ilobit` gadasc`da scori gzidan.
mxolod k`alg'mert`ebs et`aqvanebian, nac`vlad misi (allahisa), da mxolod utip`ar eshmaks evedrebian.
dascqevla igi (eshmaki) allahma, man ki miugo: garkveul xvedrs auc`ileblad mivig'eb shens msaxurt`agan;

- vac`duneb mat` auc`ileblad, gavart`ob amk`veqniuri oc`nebebit`, vubrz'aneb, rom qurebi daachran sak`onels da saxe uc`valon allahis k`mnilebas... da vinc` eshmaki airch`ia mp`arvelad, nac`vlad allahisa, scored man caago c`xadi cagebit`.
- abrmavebs mat` oc`nebebit` da dapirebebit`, magram eshmaki (sinamdvileshi) sxva arap`ers hpirdeba, garda motquebisa.
scored imat`i samqop`elia jojoxet`i da gasak`c`evsac` ver naxaven ik`idan.

da mat`, vinc` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, samot`xeebshi sheviqvant`, romelt`a k`veshac` - dian mdinareni, da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. allahis ag't`k`ma cheshmaritebaa... da vin aris allahze up`ro sitqvamart`ali?!
arc` t`k`veni oc`nebit` da arc` cignboz'ebult`a oc`nebit`, aramed: vinc` uket`urebas gaaket`ebs, mas miezg'veba - igive, da verc` mp`arvels hpovebs da verc` damxmares, garda allahisa.
xolo qoveli kac`i t`u k`ali, vinc` siket`es gaaket`ebs da morcmunec` ik`neba, scored egeni shevlen samot`xeshi, da naqirisodena usamart`lobasac` ar gadaeqrebian.
mash, vinaa imaze uket`esi sarcmunoebis mk`one, vinc` allahs daumorch`ila mt`eli t`avisi pirovnuloba, ket`ilismk`mnelia da gahqva hanip`i ibrahimis rjuls? da ibrahimi allahma airch`ia megobrad.
allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da allahia qvelap`ris garemomc`veli.

ganmartebas gt`xoven k`alebis shesaxeb, - ut`xari: allahi gangimartavt` mat` shesaxeb da imazec`, rac` cignshi gekit`xebat` -oboli k`alebis shesaxeb, romlebsac` ar az'levt` imas, rac` dagekisrat` da ise c`dilobt` mat` shert`vas, da uz'luri bavshvebis shesaxebac`, - samart`liani rom unda iqot` oblebis mimart`. xolo ra siket`esac` gaaket`ebt`, cheshmaritad, - ic`is is allahma.

da t`u k`ali k`mrisgan t`avxedobas an zurgis shek`c`evas shishobs, mat` ar daedebat` c`odvad, t`uki morigdebian da dazavdebian; - zavi uket`esia. sulebs sixarbec` t`an sdevs xolme. t`u ket`ilad moek`c`evit` da rids gamoich`ent`, cheshmaritad, - ic`is allahma, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

t`undac` moicadinot`, mainc` ver shez'lebt` c`olebis mimart` samart`lianad mok`c`evas, amitom ar gadaixarot` mt`eli ltolvit` ert`isken da ar miatovot` meore, rogorc` ugulebelqop`ili. t`uki morigdebit` da rids gamoich`ent`, cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebeli da mcqalobelia.
da t`u gaiqrebian, - orive mat`gans simdidres ucqalobebs allahi t`avisi siuxvidan. allahi uuxvescqalobiani, brz'enia.

allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze... - da ch`ven vuanderz'et` mat`, romlebsac` t`k`venze adre miec`at` cigni, da t`k`venc`, rat`a ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, da t`u uarqop`t`, cheshmaritad, allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da allahi k`ebulia, qovladmdidari.
allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da kmara allahi vek`ilad.
ei, adamianebo! is t`u inebebs, - t`k`ven cagiqvant` da sxvebs moiqvans, - sheuz'lia es allahs.
visac` amk`veqniuri ket`ildg'eoba surs, - allaht`anaa ket`ildg'eoba - amk`veqniuric` da imk`veqniuric`; allahia qovlismsmeneli da qovlismxedveli.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! samart`lianobis ag'mdgeni mocmeebi iqavit` allahist`vis, t`und iqot` cinaag'mdeg sakut`ari t`avis, an mshoblebis, an nat`esavebis mimart`, mdidari ik`neba t`u g'aribi, - allahi up`ro axlosaa orivest`an; da ar ahqvet` gemovnebas, rom ar moik`c`et` usamart`lod; da t`u gaamrudebt` an zurgs auk`c`evt` (mocmobas), cheshmaritad, - ic`is is allahma, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! allahi ircmunet`, misi shuamavali da cigni, romelic` t`avis shuamavals ch`amouvlina, da cigni, romelic` adre ch`amoavlina; xolo vinc` ar ircmunebs allahs, mis angelozebs, cignebs, shuamavlebsa da ukanasknel dg'es, is mart`lac` gadasc`deba scori gzidan didi c`ilobit`.
uechvelad, imat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes, shemdeg uarqves, shemdeg isev ircmunes, shemdeg isev uarqves da shemdeg gadaacharbes urcmunoebashi, - ar apatiebs allahi da arc` gzas gaukvlevs.
axare p`arisevlebs, rom mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli!
morcmuneebis nac`vlad rom urcmunoebs imegobreben, - nut`u isini g'irsebas ez'eben mat`t`an? cheshmaritad, g'irseba - allahs ekut`vnis mt`lianad.

man am cignshi nat`lad ch`amogivlinat`, rom allahis aiat`ebis uarqop`a da mat`i masxrad agdeba t`u mogesmebat`, nu dasxdebit` mat`t`an ert`ad, vidre sxva saubrit` ar dakavdebian. cinaag'mdeg shemt`xvevashi t`k`venc` mat`nairi ik`nebit`. uechvelad, allahi ert`ad shemkrebia p`arisevlebisa da urcmunoebisa - jojoxet`shi.

- romelnic` t`k`vens molodinshi arian: allahisgan t`u gamarjveba gergebat`, getqvian:,,gana t`k`vent`an ert`ad ar viqavit`?", xolo t`uki urcmunoebs ergebat`, mashin etqvian:,,gana t`k`ven ar gexmarebodit` da ar gic`avdit` morcmuneebisgan?". allahi gansjis t`k`vens shoris gankit`xvis dg'es da allahi ar misc`ems gzas urcmunoebs - mormunet`a cinaag'mdeg.
uechvelad, p`arisevlebi allahs atqueben, magram isaa mat`i momtquebeli. roc`a namazze dgebian, - dgebian zantad, xalxis dasanaxad da ar axseneben/ixseneben allahs, garda mc`iredisa.
- merqevni arian - arc` amat`ken da arc` imat`ken. - visac` allahi aac`dens, veranair gamosavals ver hpoveb mist`vis!
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar daimegobrot` urcmunoebi morcmuneebis sanac`vlod. nut`u gindat`, c`xadi samxili misc`et` allahs t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg?
uechvelad, p`arisevlebi qvelaze dabla ik`nebian c`ec`xlshi da ver hpoveb mat`t`vis damxmares.

- garda imat`i, romlebmac` moinanies, gamoascores (t`aviant`i sak`c`ieli), allahs miejachvnen da t`aviant`i rcmena xalasad miuz'g'vnes allahs, ai, isini ik`nebian morcmuneebt`an ert`ad. shemdeg allahi udides jildos miagebs morcmuneebs.
ratom unda dagsajot` allahma, t`uki ik`nebit` madlierni da ircmunebt`?! allahi madlieria; qovlismc`odnea.
allahs ar uqvars c`udi sitqvis gazhg'ereba, garda imisa, vinc` ch`agrulia. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismsmenia, qovlismc`odne.
ashkarad gaaket`ebt` siket`es t`u p`arulad, an borotebas apatiebt`, cheshmaritad allahi mpatiebelia, qovlisshemz'le.
cheshmaritad, vinc` uarqop`en allahsa da mis shuamavals, ganc`alkeveba surt` allahisa da misi shuamavlisa da amboben, rom gvcams zogi da ar gvcams zogio da undat`, gza daidginon amat` shoris,
- ai, egeni arian namdvili urcmunoebi, da urcmunot`at`vis gavamzadet` sasjeli - damamc`irebeli.
xolo, romelt`ac` ircmunes allahi da misi shuamavlebi da ar ganac`alkeveben arc`ert`s, scored egeni miig'eben t`aviant` gasamrjelos. allahi usazg'vrod mimtevebeli da mcqalobelia.

cignboz'ebulni gt`xoven, rom c`idan cigni ch`amouvlino. uechvelad, musas up`ro didi mot`xovnac` cauqenes da ut`xres - ashkarad gvach`vene allahio. mexma sheipqro isini t`aviant`i usamart`lobist`vis. mere xbo gaich`ines sat`aqvaneblad - imis shemdeg, rac` ukve k`ondat` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi. miuxedavad am qvelap`risa, ch`ven mainc` vapatiet` da musas vuboz'et` c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba.

(sinas) mt`a ag'vmart`et` mat` zemot` mat`i ag't`k`misamebr da vubrz'anet`:,,shedit` k`alak`is (ierusalimis) karibcheshi sejdes ag'msrulebelni" da,,ar daarg'viot` shabat`i". mat`gan ki mivig'et` mtkic`e ag't`k`ma.

t`aviant`i ag't`k`mis darg'vevis, allahis aiat`ebis/sascaulebis mimart` urcmunoebis, mac`net`a usamart`lod daxoc`visa da,,ch`veni gulebi daxurulia" - o - am sitqvebis t`k`mis gamo bechedi daasva allahma mat` gulebs t`aviant`i urcmunoobis shesabamisad da ar ircmuneben egeni, garda mc`iredisa.
- scoredac` mat`i urcmunoebisa da mariamis mimart` udidesi c`iliscamebis gamoc`.

- aseve mat`i sitqvebis gamo:,,ch`ven mart`lac` movkalit` allahis shuamavali - mesia, z'e mariamisa''; is arc` mouklavt` da arc` jvarze gaukravt`, aramed ase moech`venat`. cheshmaritad, vinc` mis shesaxeb c`iloben, - echvis k`vesh imqop`ebian mast`an dakavshirebit` da aranairi c`odna ar gaach`niat`, garda varaudit` mok`medebisa; is ki aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ar mouklavt`,
- aramed allahma ag'amag'la igi t`avist`an. allahi z'levamosilia; brz'enia.
cheshmaritad, aravinaa cignboz'ebulebshi, vinc` ar ircmunos igi misi sikvdilis cin da gankit`xvis dg'es is ik`neba mocme mat` cinaag'mdeg.
avukrz'alet` iudevelebs halalad dacesebuli (zogiert`i) sup`t`a sakvebi mat`ive usamart`lobis gamo, radganac` mat` bevri ac`dunes/daabrkoles allahis gzaze.
da imis gamoc`, rom vaxshs g'ebulobdnen, arada ekrz'alebodat`, da imitomac`, rom xalxis k`onebas usamart`lod miirt`mevdnen... da gavamzadet` mcare sasjeli mat`shi urcmunoebist`vis.

magram mat`shi arian g'rmadmc`odne da morcmuneni, romelt`ac` scamt` igi, rac` shen ch`amogevlina da rac` ch`amoevlina shenze adre, aseve namazis shemsrulebelni, zek`at`is gamc`emni, allahisa da ukanaskneli dg'is mimart` morcmunenic`, da mivagebt` mat` udides sazg'aurs.

cheshmaritad, ch`ven mogivlinet` vahi, rogorc` mivuvlinet` nuhs da sxva mac`neebs mis shemdgom; mivuvlinet` aseve ibrahims, isma'ils, ishaqs, ia'qubs da mis sht`amomavlebs, 'isas, eiubs, iunuss, haruns, suleimans; davuds ki zeburi vuboz'et`.
aseve sxva shuamavlebs, romelt`a shesaxeb adre giambet` da im shuamavlebsac`, romelt`a shesaxebac` shent`vis ar gvic`nobebia; xolo musas allahi daelaparaka ushualo saubrit`.
(gamovgzavnet`) shuamavlebi, maxarobelni da map`rt`xilebelni, rat`a shuamavlebis shemdgom xalxs ar hk`onoda sap`uz'veli allahis cinashe (t`avis mart`lebis). allahi z'levamosilia; brz'enia.
t`umc`a allahi amocmebs imas, rom rac` shenze ch`amoavlina, - is ch`amoavlina t`avisi c`odnit`, da angelozebic` amocmeben... da kmara mocmed allahi.
cheshmaritad, vinc` ar ircmunes da (sxvac`) ac`dunes/daabrkoles allahis gzaze, - isini scori gzidan mart`lac` shors gadavidnen, gzaabnevashi.
uechvelad, mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes da usamart`lobas eceodnen, allahi arc` apatiebs da arc` gzas gaukvlevs.
- garda jojoxet`is gzisa, da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams, es ki iolia allahist`vis.

ei, adamianebo! uechvelad, shuamavali t`k`veni g'mert`isgan t`k`vent`an cheshmaritebit`urt` movida, mash, ircmunet`, - umjobesia es t`k`vent`vis. da t`u ar ircmunet`, cheshmaritad, allahisaa, rac`aa c`at`a shina da dedamicaze. allahi qovlismc`odnea; brz'enia.

ei, cignboz'ebulno! nu gadaxvalt` zg'vars t`k`venive rjulshi da arap`eri t`k`vat` allahis shesaxeb, garda cheshmaritebisa. cheshmaritad, mesia, 'isa z'e mariamisa, allahis shuamavalia da sitqva misi, romelic` mariams mihmadla, - sulia misgan. mash, ircmunet` allahi da misi shuamavali da ar t`k`vat` sameba, - moeshvit`, t`k`venda sasiket`od. cheshmaritad, allahi ert`i g'mert`ia, is qovlad unakloa imisgan, rom shvili hqoloda. misia qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da dedamicaze... kmara vek`ilad allahi.

allahis msaxurobas aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ar it`akilebs mesia, da arc` axlos mqop`i angelozebi (allaht`an daaxloebulni); xolo vinc` misdami msaxurebas it`akilebs da iampartavnebs, - qvelas ert`ad shekrebs t`avist`an.

xolo isini, vinc` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, unaklod miig'eben t`aviant` sazg'aurs da gauzrdis kidec` t`avisi cqalobit`; xolo vinc` ukadrisobdnen da ampartavnobdnen, dasjis mat` mcare sasjelit` da verc` megobars hpoveben da verc` damxmares, garda allahisa.
ei, adamianebo! t`k`veni g'mert`isgan mart`lac` mogividat` c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba da t`k`venze ch`amovavlinet` ashkara nat`eli.
xolo mat`, vinc` ircmunes allahi da miejachvnen mas, t`avis cqalobasa da madlshi sheiqvans da scor gzasac` gaukvlevs.

p`et`vas it`xoven shengan, ut`xari: allahi gaz'levt` p`et`vas k`elales shesaxeb. t`u kac`i ushvilod daig'upa da mxolod da qavs, mashin z'mis danatovris naxevari das ekut`vnis, xolo t`u k`ali gardaic`vleba ushvilod, mashin z'ma srulad ememkvidreba mas; t`u gardac`vlili kac`is debi ori ik`nebian, mashin mat` danatovaris ori mesamedi ergebat`; xolo t`u memkvidreebi ert`droulad mamrebic` da mdedrebic` arian, mashin mamrs ergeba ori mdedris cili. gixsnit` t`k`ven allahi, rat`a ar shec`det`; allahi qovlismc`odnea.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! dadebul pirobas uert`gulet`. t`k`vent`vis halalia shinauri pirutqvi, garda imisa, romelt`a (haramobis) shesaxebac` gec`nobebat`, aseve, ar miich`niot` halalad is nanadirevi, romelic` ihramit` shemosilebma moinadiret`. cheshmaritad, allahi daadgens imas, rasac` inebebs.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar shebg'alot` allahis (morch`ilebis) nishnulebi, arc` nakrz'ali mt`vare, arc` zvaraki, arc` mat`i saqelurebi da arc` nakrz'ali saxlisken mimavalt`a up`lebebi, romlebic` t`aviant`i g'mert`is madlisa da kmaqop`ilebisken miiscrap`vian. xolo rogorc` ki (ihramis saritualo mdgomareobidan) gat`avisup`ldebit`, (t`u isurvebt`) inadiret`. raki (adre) nakrz'al mech`et`s ar gakarebdnen, axla im xalxis mimart` javrma ar gibiz'got` zg'vargadasulobisken! siket`esa da g'vt`ismoshishobashi daexmaret` ert`manet`s da nu daexmarebit` uket`urebasa da mtrobashi! ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, uechvelad, allahi mkac`rsasjeliania.

t`k`vent`vis haramia: leshi, sisxli, g'oris xorc`i, is, rac` allahis garda sxvist`vis daikla, damxrch`vali, dartqmis, zemodan ch`amovardnis an rk`ebze camogebis shedegad mkvdari da mtac`ebeli c`xovelis mier daglejili, garda imisa, rac` t`k`ven dakalit`. aseve, haramia: is, rac` kerpebze shesacirad daikla, da isrebit` cilqra... - es qvelap`eri sibilcea. dg'eidan imedi moikvet`es t`k`veni rjulidan mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes, ase rom, nu geshiniat` mat`i, ch`emi geshinodet`. me dg'es srulvqavi t`k`veni rjuli, davasrule ch`emi cqaloba t`k`vendami da kmaqop`ili var t`k`vent`vis boz'ebuli islamis rjulit`. xolo vinc` shimshilma aiz'ula da ara c`odvisken ltolvam, cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mcqalobelia.

gekit`xebian shen - ra aris halali mat`t`vis. ut`xari: halalia t`k`vent`vis qvelap`eri, rac` sup`t`aa da rac` gacvrt`nil mtac`ebels ar daucheria t`k`vent`vis, - mtac`ebels, romelsac` cvrt`nit` allahis boz'ebuli c`odnit`. miirt`vit` igi (halali sakvebi) allahis saxelis xsenebit`. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, uechvelad allahi mscrap`langarishmgebia.

dg'eidan halalia t`k`vent`vis qvelap`eri, rac` ki sup`t`aa. - halalia mat`i sachmeli, romelt`ac` cigni eboz'at`, da t`k`veni sachmelic` halalia mat`t`vis; aseve patiosani k`alebi morcmunet`agan da patiosani k`alebi mat`gan, visac` t`k`venze adre eboz'at` cigni, t`uki miagebt` t`avian mehrs patiosnad da ara siz'visat`vis, arc`a saqvarlad aqvanist`vis. xolo vinc` rcmenas uarqop`s, uechvelad, gac`amtverdeba misi namok`medari da ukanasknel dg'es cagebult`a shoris ag'moch`ndeba.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! namazze dadgomisas daibanet`: saxeebi da xelebi idaqvebit`urt`, t`avze ch`amoisvit` (sveli xeli), aseve p`exebi kochebit`urt`; xolo t`u ik`nebit` junubi, mashin (ganbanvit`) ganicmindet`; da t`u avad an mgzavrad ik`nebit`, andac` p`exsalagidan gamoxvalt`, an kidev k`als sheexet` da cqali ver hpovet`, mashin sup`t`a micit` t`eiemumi gaaket`et` - saxeze da mklavebze moisvit` igi. allahs ar unda sirt`ule t`k`vent`vis, magram unda, rom gangcmindot` da misi cqaloba srulad giboz'ot`, rom ik`neb madlieri iqot`.

gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba t`k`venze da ag't`k`ma, romelic` t`k`vengan aig'o, roc`a t`k`vit`,,shevisminet` da davemorch`ilet`''. mash, ridi gk`ondet` allahisa! cheshmaritad, unaklod ic`is allahma t`k`vens gulebshi arsebulis shesaxeb.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! iqavit` mtkic`eni, allahist`vis samart`lianad dammocmebelni da xalxis romelime jgup`is mimart` siz'ulvilma ar gaiz'ulot`, rom ar ik`c`eodet` samart`lianad. iqavit` samart`liani, ramet`u igi qvelaze axlosaa g'vt`ismoshishobast`an. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa. cheshmaritad, allahi mc`odnea qovelivesi, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
allahma patieba da jildo ag'ut`k`va udidesi, romelt`ac` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili.
- xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes da c`rud miich`nies ch`veni aiat`ebi, ai, isini arian mkvidri jojoxet`isa.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba, roc`a xalxma t`k`venze xelis ag'mart`va ganizraxes da man agac`ilat` mat`i xelebi. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, da mxolod allahs miendon morcmuneebi.

cheshmaritad, israelis modgmis ag't`k`ma aig'o allahma, da t`ormeti carmomadgeneli (zedamxedveli) mivavlinet` mat`gan. da allahma ag'ut`k`va: cheshmaritad, me t`k`vent`an var, t`uki namazs ag'asrulebt`, zek`at`s gasc`emt`, ircmunebt` ch`ems shuamavlebs da mxarshi amoudgebit` mat`, asesxebt` allahs mshvenier sesxs. - ai, mashin namdvilad dagip`aravt` uket`urobebs da ut`uod shegiqvant` samot`xeebshi, romlis k`veshac` dian mdinareni. da vinc` amis shemdegac` ar ircmuna, uechvelad, man gadac`da scori gzidan.

davcqevlet` isini t`aviant`i ag't`k`mis darg'vevis gamo da gulebi gavuuxeshet`. adgils uc`vlian sitqvebs da daivicqes t`aviant`i xvedri ik`idan, rit`ac` iqvnen shegonebulni. qovelt`vis gaigeb g'alats mat`ze, garda mc`iredisa. shen mainc` apatie mat` da ganeride. cheshmaritad, allahs uqvars ket`ilmorcmuneni.

da ag't`k`ma avig'et` mat`ganac`, romelt`ac` t`k`ves, rom ch`ven vart` nazarevelnio, shemdeg ki daivicqes t`aviant`i xvedri ik`idan, rit`ac` iqvnen shegonebulni. amitomac` mtroba da siz'ulvili ch`amovagdet` mat` shoris gankit`xvis dg'emde, bolos ki allahi ac`nobebs mat` imis shesaxeb, rasac` sch`adiodnen.

ei, cignboz'ebulno! cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`an movida ch`veni shuamavali da z'alian bevrs gic`xadebt`, rasac` malavdit` cignidan, bevrs ki saert`od ar ambobs. cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`an movida shuk`i da c`xadi cigni allahisgan.
misi meshveobit` allahi usap`rt`xo gzebisken daakvalianebs mat`, vinc` gahqveba mis kmaqop`ilebas, aseve misi nebit` bnelet`idan nat`elshi gaiqvans da scori gzisken daakvalianebs.

cheshmaritad, urcmunoeba gamoavlines mat`, romlebmac` t`k`ves, rom g'mert`i aris - mesia, z'e mariamisa. ut`xari: t`uki ineba allahma, rom dag'upos mesia, z'e mariamisa, misi deda da qvelap`eri, rac`aa dedamicaze, - vis sheuz'lia amat`gan romelimes dabrkoleba? allahs ekut`vnis xelmcip`eba c`at`a da dedamicisa da rac`aa mat` shoris, da ach`ens imas, rac` surs. allahi qovlisshemz'lea.

iudevelebma da k`ristianebma t`k`ves, rom ch`ven vart` allahis z'eni da misi moqvarenio. ut`xari: mash ratomg'a gsjit` t`k`venive c`odvebis gamo? pirik`it`, t`k`ven ch`veulebrivi adamianebi xart` imat`gan, vinc` man gaach`ina. is patiobs mas, visac` inebebs da sjis mas, visac` inebebs. allahs ekut`vnis xelmcip`eba c`at`a da dedamicisa da rac`aa mat` shoris, da mast`anaa saboloo misak`c`ieli.

ei, cignboz'ebulno! cheshmaritad, ushuamavlobis zhamis shemdeg t`k`vent`an movida ch`veni shuamavali, romelic` gangimartavt`, rat`a ar get`k`vat`, rom ch`ven ar mogvsvlia maxarobeli da shemgonebelio. cheshmaritad, - mogividat` t`k`ven maxarobelic` da shemgonebelic`. allahi qovlisshemz'lea.

aki musam t`avis xalxs mimart`a: ei, xalxo ch`emo! gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba t`k`vendami, roc`a t`k`venive ciag'idan daadgina mac`neebi, xelmcip`eebad gak`c`iat` da giboz'at` is, rac` samqaroshi aravist`vis uboz'ebia.
ei, xalxo ch`emo! shedit` cminda micaze (ierusalimshi), romelic` allahma t`k`ven dagidginat` da ar mobrundet` ukan, t`orem cagebulebad ik`c`evit`.
ut`xres: o, musa! uechvelad, ik` aris goliat`i xalxi da ch`ven ar shegviz'lia shevidet`, vidre isini ar gamovlen ik`idan, xolo t`u ik`idan gamovlen, mashin ch`venc` shevalt` auc`ileblado.

mat`gan orma g'vt`ismoshishma kac`ma, romlebzec` allahma cqaloba moig'o, t`k`ves: karibchidan sheutiet` mat` da roc`a ik` shexvalt`, ut`uod, t`k`ven ik`nebit` gamarjvebulni. mash, allahs miendet`, t`uki t`k`ven xart` morcmuneni.
ut`xres: o, musa! ch`ven ik` arasodes shevalt`, vidre isini ik` ik`nebian. cadit` da shen da shenma g'mert`ma sheebrz'olet`, ch`ven ki ak` visxdebit`o.
t`k`va: g'mert`o ch`emo! me mxolod ch`ems t`avsa da ch`ems z'mas vmmart`velob, mash, sishore ch`amoagde ch`vensa da ug'irs xalxs shoris.
brz'ana: cheshmaritad, akrz'alulia is (cminda mica) mat`t`vis ormoc`i celi. ixetialeben isini k`veqanaze da nu damcuxrdebi ug'irsi xalxis gamo.

da caukit`xe mat` cheshmariti ambavi adamis ori z'isa, rodesac` msxverpli shescires da shecqnarebul ik`na ert`isa da ar shecqnarebula meoresi. (am ukanasknelma) t`k`va: namdvilad mogklav me shen! (pirvelma) miugo: cheshmaritad, allahi mxolod g'vt`ismoshishebisgan qabulobs.
vp`ic`av, t`u shen xels ag'mart`av ch`ems mosaklavad, me xels ar ag'vmart`av shens mosaklavad. cheshmaritad, me meshinia allahisa, samqarot`a g'mert`is.
me mirch`evnia, rom ch`emi c`odvac` da sheni c`odvac` shen itvirt`o da c`ec`xlis mkvidrt`agan iqo. aset`ia usamart`lot`a sasjeli.
sulma misma daiqolia z'mis mkvlelobaze da mokla igi, - ik`c`a umalve cagebult`agani.
