shemdeg allahma qvavi cargzavna, romelic` micas ch`ich`k`nida, rat`a ech`evenebina, t`u rogor daemarxa t`avisi z'mis c`xedari. (mashin) t`k`va: vai, ch`ems t`avs! isic` ar shemiz'lia, rom am qvavis msgavsi mainc` viqo da ch`emi z'mis c`xedari davmarxo? da ik`c`a monanult`agani.

- amis gamo israelis modgmas davuceset`, rom vinc` mokla suli ara sulis cil an uket`urebis gamo k`veqnierebaze, man t`it`k`os mt`eli kac`obrioba moakvdina; xolo vinc` ac`oc`xla igi, man t`it`k`os mt`eli kac`obrioba ac`oc`xla. cheshmaritad, ch`veni shuamavlebi c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit` mividnen mat`t`an, magram amis miuxedavad mat`i umravlesoba mainc` arazomieria.

cheshmaritad, sasjeli mat`i, - romelnic` allahsa da mis shuamavals eomebian da k`veqnad uket`urebas escrap`vian, - sikvdilit` dasja an z'elze gakvra, an xelebisa da p`exebis urt`iert`sapirispirod mokvet`a, an k`veqnidan gaz'eveba! mat`t`vis amk`veqnad amgvari damc`irebaa, xolo imk`veqnad - didi sasjeli.

garda imat`i, romlebmac` manamde moinanies, vidre mat`i pasuxisgebis shesaz'leblobas moipovebdit` (vidre t`k`ven mat` sheipqrobdit`). mash, ic`odet`, rom allahi mart`lac` usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` icmunet`! ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da mast`an daaxloebis sashualeba ez'iet`; mis gzaze ibrz'olet`, rom ik`neb gadarch`et`.

cheshmaritad, isini, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, - qvelap`ersac` rom p`lobdnen, rac` dedamicaze arsebobs da kidev ert` imdens, - auc`ileblad gaig'ebdnen gankit`xvis dg'is sasjelidan t`avis gamosaxsnelad, t`umc`a ar miig'eba igi mat`gan da mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli.
c`ec`xlidan gamosvlas natroben, t`umc`a verap`rit` gamovlen ik`idan da mat`t`visaa sasjeli maradiuli.
momparav kac`sa da momparav k`als, - imis sazg'aurad, rac` moixveches, da samagalit`o sasjelad allahisgan, - xelebi mohkvet`et`. allahi z'levamosilia; brz'enia.
xolo vinc` moinania t`avisi usamart`lobis shemdeg da gamoscorda, cheshmaritad, miutevebs mas allahi. uechvelad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
gana ar ic`i, rom mart`lac` allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da dedamicis xelmcip`eba? dasjis mas, visac` inebebs da apatiebs mas, visac` inebebs. allahi qovlisshemz'lea.

ei, shuamavalo! nu damcuxrdebi imat` gamo, romelt`a gulebsac` ar urcmunia, - pirit` amboben vircmunet`o da urcmunoebisken miiscrap`vian. arc` im iudevelebis gamo damcuxrde, romelnic` sic`rues ugdeben qurs da kidev sxva xalxs usmenen, romlebic` shent`an arc` ki mosulan. isini (cminda cerilshi) sitqvebs adgilebs uc`vlian da amboben: t`uki mogec`emat`, es mashin aig'et`, xolo t`u ar mogec`at`, mashin moeridet`. vis gansac`delsac` inebebs allahi, shen mis sashvelad verap`ers hpoveb allahis cinashe. egeni arian, visi gulebis gacmendac` ar ineba allahma. mat`t`visaa damc`ireba amk`veqnad, da mat`t`visaa didi sasjeli imk`veqnad.

gamudmebit` usmenen isini sic`rues da xshirad chamen nebadaurt`vels. t`u shent`an movlen, gansaje shen mat` shoris an piri ibrune mat`gan, da t`u pirs ibruneb, verap`ers gavneben. xolo t`u gansji, mashin samart`lianad gansaje mat` shoris. cheshmaritad, uqvars allahs samart`lianni.
(sakvirvelia) rogor girch`even shen msajulad, roc`a t`evrat`i mat`t`anaa da ik` allahis ganach`enia. mere ki zurgs ik`c`even amis shemdeg, da ar arian egeni morcmuneni.

cheshmaritad, ch`ven t`evrat`i ch`amovavlinet`, masshia scori gza da sinat`le; morch`ili shuamavlebi misit` gansjidnen iudevelt`at`vis, aseve rabinebi da scavlulebic`, radganac` isini allahis cignis dac`vit` iqvnen davalebulni da mocmeni am qvelap`erze. mash, nu sheushindebit` xalxs, ch`emi geshinodet`, da nurc` ch`ems aiat`ebs gaqidit` mc`ire p`asis sanac`vlod. xolo vinc` ar gansjis imit`, rac` allahma ch`amoavlina, scored isini arian urcmunoni.

da masshi ch`ven davukanonet`: suli sulis cil, t`vali t`valis cil, c`xviri c`xviris cil, quri quris cil, kbili kbilis cil, aseve qisasi davuceset` chrilobebis shesaxebac`. xolo vinc` apatiebs mocqalebis nishnad, igi ik`neba misi c`odvebis gamosasqidi, da vinc` ar gansjian imit`, rac` allahma ch`amoavliana, scored isini arian usamart`loni.

da kvaldakval mivaqolet` mat` 'isa - z'e mariamisa, damamocmeblad imisa, rac` iqo t`evrat`shi - masze adre; da mas vuboz'et` injili, masshia scori gza da sinat`le; igia damamocmebeli imisa, rac` iqo t`evrat`shi masze adre - scori gzis mach`venebelad da shesagoneblad g'vt`ismoshit`at`vis.
mash, injilis xalxma imit` gansajon, rac` allahma masshi ch`amoavlina, xolo vinc` ar gansjis imit`, rac` allahma ch`amoavliana, scored egeni arian ug'irsni.

da ch`ven cigni ch`amogivlinet` cheshmaritebit`urt`, masze adre mqop`i cignis dasturad da mocmed, mash, imsajule mat` shoris imit`, rac` allahma ch`amoavlina da mat` gemovnebaze aqolit` ar gadauxvio im cheshmaritebas, rac` ukve migig'ia. ch`ven qvela t`k`vengans davudginet` t`avisi shariat`i (kanonebi) da gza. allahs rom eneba, qvelas ert` t`emad gak`c`evdat`, magram man t`k`veni gamoc`da ineba - imis mixedvit`, rac` giboz'at`. amitom siket`eshi sheejibret` ert`manet`s. bolos allaht`anaa qvela t`k`venganis misak`c`ieli da is gamc`nobt` imis shesaxeb, razec` t`k`ven c`ilobdit`.

mash, imsajule mat` shoris imit`, rac` allahma ch`amoavlina da nu ahqvebi mat` gemovnebas, sip`rt`xile gamoich`ine mat` mimart`, rat`a ar agac`dinon imis nacils, rac` allahma ch`amogivlina. xolo t`u piri ibrunes, ic`ode, rom allahs mat`i dasja scadia - nacili mat`i c`odvebis gamo. uechvelad, bevri adamiani mart`lac` ug'irsia.
gana umec`rebis droindel msajulebas ez'eben? mash, vinaa allahze uket`esi msajuli - g'rmadmorcmune xalxist`vis?

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar aiqvanot` megobrebad iudevelni da nazarevelni, isini ert`manet`is megobrebi arian. xolo romeli t`k`venganic` daumegobrdeba mat`, cheshmaritad, isic` (ert`-ert`i) mat`gania. cheshmaritad, allahi usamart`lo xalxs ar daakvalianebs cheshmarit gzaze.

ai, visac` sneuleba ak`vt` gulebshi, xedav, t`u rogor miiscrap`vian mat`ken da amboben: vshishobt`, raime ubedureba ar dagvatqdes t`avs. shesaz'loa, allahma gamarjveba an raime carmateba moavlinos t`avisi ciag'idan da monanulebad gadaik`c`nen imis gamo, rasac` malavdnen t`aviant` gulebshi.

da morcmuneebi (gakvirvebit`) amboben: nut`u egeni arian, vinc` allahs ip`ic`ebodnen mt`eli t`avgamodebit`, rom isini ut`uod t`k`vent`an ert`ad ik`nebodnen? uk`mad ik`c`a mat`i namok`medari da cagebulebad gadaik`c`nen.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! romeli t`k`venganic` t`avis rcmenas ganudgeba (daig'upeba), (mis adgilze) shemdeg allahi sxva xalxs moiqvans, romlebic` eqvareba mas, da mat`ac` eqvarebat` igi, t`avmdabalni ik`nebian morcmunet`a mimart` da mtkic`eni - urcmunot`a cinashe, allahis gzaze ibrz'oleben da ar sheeshindebat` mkic`xvelis gakic`xvisa. es allahis cqalobaa, romelsac` uboz'ebs mas, vist`visac` inebebs. allahi uxvmcqalobia, qovlismc`odne.
cheshmaritad, t`k`veni megobaria - allahi, misi shuamavali da isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes, namazs ag'asruleben, zek`at`s gasc`emen da k`edmoxrilni arian.
- da vinc` allahs, mis shuamavalsa da morcmuneebs daimegobrebs, cheshmaritad, - mz'leni arian allahis momxreni.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar aiqvanot` megobrebad t`k`venamde cignboz'ebulni an urcmunoni, romlebmac` t`k`veni rjuli gasart`obad da masxrad aigdes. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, t`uki xart` t`k`ven morcmuneni.
roc`a (ezanit`) namazisken moucodet`, gasart`obad da masxrad aigdes igi, es imitom rom egeni namdvilad sheugnebeli xalxia.

ut`xari: ei, cignboz'ebulno! nut`u mxolod imist`vis gejavrebit`, rom vircmunet` allahi da is, rac` ch`amogvevlina, aseve isic` vircmunet`, rac` ch`venze adre ch`amovlenila... - da bevri t`k`vengani ug'irsia?

ut`xari: xom ar giambot` allahis cinashe sasjelis mxriv amaze up`ro c`udis shesaxeb? vinc` allahma dascqevla, - sherisxa, mat`gan maimunebi da g'orebi daadgina da tag'ut`s et`aqvanebodnen; ai, egeni arian qvelaze c`udi adgilis mk`oneni da scori gzidan qvelaze amc`darni.
rodesac` t`k`vent`an movlen, itqvian, vircmunet`o. uechvelad, egeni urcmunoebit` shemovidnen da, rat`k`maunda, amit`ve gavidnen. allahma uket` ic`is, rasac` egeni malaven.
mat`gan z'alian bevrs dainaxav, t`u rogor miiscrap`vian c`odvashi, mtrobashi da nebadaurt`velis chamashi. raoden c`udia, rasac` egeni sch`adian!
netav rabinebsa da scavlulebs mainc` aekrz'alat` mat`t`vis c`udi sitqva da nebadaurt`velis chama. raoden c`udia, rasac` egeni sch`adian.

iudevelebma t`k`ves:,,allahis xeli shekrulia". t`vit`on sheekrat` xelebi da daicqevlon imis gamo, rac` t`k`ves. pirik`it`, misi orive xeli p`art`odaa gashlili, cqalobas gasc`ems, rogorc` t`vit`on inebebs. rac` sheni g'mert`isgan ch`amogevlina, is bevr mat`gans ut`uod shehmatebs zg'vargadasulobasa da urcmunoebas. gankit`xvis dg'emde mat` shoris mtroba da siz'ulvili ch`avagdet`. qovelt`vis, roc`a omist`vis c`ec`xls ant`eben, - allahi ak`robs mas, da uket`urebis t`esvas miescrap`vian dedamicaze, da allahs ar uqvars uket`urebis mok`medni.
cignboz'ebulebs rom ercmunat` da g'vt`ismoshishni qop`iliqvnen, ut`uod mivutevebdit` t`aviant` c`odvebs da, rat`k`maunda, cqalobit` savse bag'ebshi sheviqvadit`.

isini rom mtkic`ed mdgariqvnen t`evrat`sa da injilze, da imaze, rac` ch`amoevlinat` t`aviant`i g'mert`isgan, mashin ut`uod miirt`mevdnen - zemodan da p`ext`a k`veshidan. mat`shi zomieri t`emic`aa, t`umc`a c`udia, rasac` mat`i umravlesoba aket`ebs.

o, shuamavalo! (xalxs) miucvdine igi, rac` ch`amogevlina sheni g'mert`isgan; da t`u ar izam, mashin ar migicvdenia misi cerili. xolo xalxisgan allahi dagic`avs. uechvelad, allahi urcmuno xalxs ar daakvalianebs cheshmarit gzaze.

ut`xari: ei, cignboz'ebulno! ar gagach`ndebat` aranairi sap`uz'veli, rom ar ag'asrulot` t`evrat`i, injili da is, rac` t`k`veni g'mert`isgan ch`amogevlinat`; mart`lac` bevr mat`gans siurch`esa da urcmunoebas shehmatebs igi, rac` sheni g'mert`isgan ch`amogevlina, amitom ar damcuxrde shen urcmuno xalxis gamo.
cheshmaritad, vinc` morcmunea, da iudevelni, sabielni da nazarevelni - vinc` ircmuna allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli, da ket`ilis mk`nelia, - mat`ze arc` shishia mosalodneli da arc` damcuxrdebian egeni.

diax, ch`ven ag't`k`ma davudet` israelis modgmas da carvugzavnet` shuamavlebi. qovelt`vis, roc`a mat`t`an midioda shuamavali imit`, rac` mat` ar moscondat`, nacils c`rud rac`xavdnen da nacils xoc`avdnen.

egonat`, rom gansac`deli ar eceodat`, amitomac` caubrmaves da cauqrues, shemdeg allahma mat`i sinanuli sheismina. shemdeg mat`ma umravlesobam isev caubrmava da cauqrua. qvelap`ers xedavs allahi, rasac` isini aket`eben.

mart`lac` urcmunod ik`c`nen isini, vinc` t`k`ves, rom cheshmaritad, allahia - mesia, z'e mariamisao. da mesia ambobda: ei, israelis modgmav! t`aqvani ec`it` allahs, ch`ems g'mert`s da t`k`vens g'mert`so. uechvelad, vinc` ut`anaziarebs allahs, - akrz'ala allahma mist`vis samot`xe da c`ec`xlia misi t`avshesap`ari... da aravinaa damxmare - usamart`lot`a.

mart`lac` urcmunod ik`c`nen isini, vinc` t`k`ves, rom cheshmaritad, allahia samt`agan mesame. arada ert`adert`i g'mert`is garda sxva g'vt`aeba ar arsebobs, xolo t`uki ar moishlian imas, rasac` amboben, mashin urcmunoebs auc`ileblad sheexebat` mcare sasjeli.
nut`u ar moinanieben allahis cinashe da ar shest`xoven patiebas? allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mcqalobelia.

mesia - z'e mariamisa, mxolod shuamavalia. uechvelad, masze adrec` ganvles shuamavlebma, misi deda umart`lesi k`alia, orive mat`gani ki sachmels miirt`mevda. shexede, t`u rogor ganvmartavt` mat`t`vis aiat`ebs; shemdeg kvlav shexede, t`u rogor ik`c`even pirs.
ut`xari: nut`u allahis nac`vlad et`aqvanebit` imas, rasac` t`k`vent`vis arc` vneba z'aluz's da arc` rgeba? arada allahi qovlis msmeni da mxedvelia.

ut`xari: ei, cignboz'ebulno! zg'vars nu gadaxvalt` cheshmaritebis mig'ma, t`k`venive sarcmunoebashi, da nu gahqvebit` im xalxis gemovnebas, romlebic` adre ukve asc`dnen cheshmaritebas, sxvac` bevri ac`dunes, da scori gzidan gadavidnen.
davudisa da 'isa mariamis z'is enit` daicqevlnen isini, vinc` urcmuno iqo israelis z'et`a shoris. scored t`aviant`i urch`obisa da zg'vargadasulobis gamo icvnies igi.
ar ukrz'alavdnen ert`manet`s uket`urebas, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen, da ra c`udia, rasac` aket`ebdnen.

xedav, bevri mat`gani rogor megobroben imat`t`an, vinc` ar ircmunes. mart`lac` raoden c`udia, rasac` t`aviant`i sulebi samomavlod umzadeben imat`, rat`a ganurisxdet` allahi da maradiul satanjvelshi ag'moch`ndnen.
mat` rom rcmena hk`onodat` allahis, mac`nis da masze ch`amovlenilis mimart`, mashin imat` ar daimegobrebdnen, t`umc`a ug'irsia bevri mat`gani.

ut`uod hpoveb, rom kac`t`agan morcmunet`a mimart` qvelaze mkac`ri siz'ulvilit` iudevelebi da carmart`ebi gamoirch`evian; aseve hpoveb, rom mat`shi morcmunet`a mimart` siqvarulit` isini gamoirch`evan, romlebmac` t`k`ves, ch`ven nazarevelni vart`o; es imitom, rom mat`gan arian mg'vdlebi da berebi, romlebic` ar ampartavnoben.

xolo rodesac` ismenen imas, rac` ch`amoevlina shuamavalt`an, naxav,rom c`remlit` aevsebat` t`valebi imis gamo, rac` sheic`nes cheshmaritebidan; isini amboben: g'mert`o ch`veno! ch`ven ukve vircmunet`, mash, ch`agvcere dammocmebelt`a rigebshi!
ratomac` ar unda vircmunot` allahi da is, rac` cheshmaritebidan movida ch`vent`an? - ch`ven xom molodini gvak`vs, rom ch`veni g'mert`i sat`no xalxt`an ert`ad shegviqvans (samot`xeshi).
shemdeg mihmadla mat` allahma t`aviant`i (gulcrp`eli) sitqvebist`vis samot`xeebi, romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedineba, masshi ik`nebian maradzhams da esaa ket`ilmorcmunet`a sazg'auri.
- xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes da c`rud miich`nies ch`veni aiat`ebi, ai, isini arian jojoxet`is mkvidrni.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar aikrz'alot` is siket`eni, rac` halalhqo t`k`vent`vis allahma da arc` zg'vars gadaxvidet`; uechvlad, allahs ar uqvars zg'vargadasulni.
mash, miirt`vit` ik`idan, rac` halal da sup`t`a sazrdod gicqalobat` allahma. da ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, romlis morcmunenic` xart`.

allahi ar gakisrebt` pasuxismgeblobas (im) dap`ic`ebulze, romelic` camogc`dat` (gauc`nobiereblad), t`umc`a pasuxismgeblobas gakisrebt` imaze, rac` shegnebulad daip`ic`et`. da amis gamosasqidia: at`i g'atakis gamokveba - sashualod imit`, rasac` miart`mevt` xolme t`k`vens ojaxs; an mat`i shemosva; an ert`i monis gat`avisup`leba. xolo visac` (es) ar moepoveba, maszea (dakisrebuli) sami dg'is marxva. esaa gamosasqidi t`k`veni p`ic`isa, t`uki gatexavt`. mash, daic`avit` t`k`veni p`ic`i! ase gangimartavt` allahi t`avis aiat`ebs, - ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit`.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! uechvelad, g'vino, qumari, kerpebi da (samkit`xao) isrebi satanis saz'agel sak`met`aganaa da ganeridet` mas - ik`neb gadarch`et`.
satanas mxolod is unda, rom mtroba da siz'ulvili ch`aagdos t`k`ven shoris g'vinit`a da qumarit`; dagashorot` allahis didebas/xsenebas da namazs. mash, xom ik`nebit` amis damt`mobni?
mash, daemorch`ilet` allahs, daemorch`ilet` shuamavals da sip`rt`xile gamoich`inet`, xolo t`uki gadaixrebit`, mashin ic`odet`, rom ch`vens shuamavals mxolod c`xadi gzavnilis micvdena akisria.

romelt`ac` ircmunes da siket`e aket`es, mat` ar daedebat` c`odva imashi, rac` (adre) ugemiat`, t`u (axla) g'vt`ismoshishebas ich`enen, scamt` da siket`es aket`eben; shemdeg isev g'vt`ismoshishebas ich`enen da scamt`; shemdeg isev g'vt`ismoshishebas ich`enen da siket`es aket`eben. allahs uqvars ket`ilismk`mnelni.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! allahi auc`ileblad gamogc`dit` nadirit`, romelsac` scvdeba t`k`veni xelebi da shubebi, rat`a gamoamzhg'avnos, t`u vis ak`vs misi shishi - roc`a veravin xedavs mas, garda allahisa. xolo vinc` shemdgom zg'vars gadava, scored mist`visaa mcare sasjeli.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar moklat` nadiri mashin, roc`a ihramit` xart` shemosilni. da vinc` moklavs gaazrebulad, misi sasjeli: k`aabashi shesacirad gagzavnaa shinauri c`xovelisa, mis mier moklulis msgavsis, rasac` t`k`ven shoris ori samart`liani kac`i gansazg'vravs; an gamosasqidad g'aribebis dapureba; an sanac`vlod marxvaa, rat`a pasuxismgebloba igrz'nos t`avisi sak`c`ielis. allahma sheundo, rac` ukve moxda, xolo t`u kvlav daubrundeba, allahi shurs iz'iebs masze. allahi uz'levelia, shurismgebia.

neba mogec`at` zg'vis nadirobaze (t`evzaoba) da amit` danaqrebaze, mgzavrt`a da t`k`venda sasargeblod, xolo agekrz'alat` saxmelet`o nadiroba, manam, vidre ihramit` ik`nebit` shemosilni. ridi gk`ondet` allahis, romlis cinashec` ik`nebit` ag'dgenilni.

allahma adamiant`a sasiket`od k`aaba, anu nakrz'ali saxli, nakrz'ali mt`vare, shesaciri da girlandashebmuli samsxverploebi daadgina, rat`a gc`odnodat`, rom allahi ucqis, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da is (gc`odnodat`), rom allahi qovlismc`odnea.
ic`odet`, rom uechvelad, allahi mkac`rsasjeliania da cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobelia.
shuamavals mxolod micvdena akisria (xalxze - am moz'g'vrebis), allahma ki ic`is, rasac` t`k`ven amxelt` da malavt`.
ut`xari: ucminduri da sup`t`a araa t`anascori, t`undac` ucmindurobis simravlem t`avi mogaconos! mash, gonierno, geshinodet` allahis, ik`neb gadarch`et`.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar ikit`xot` iset`i rameebi, romlebic` dagamcuxrebt`, t`u gagemartebat`; da t`u ikit`xavt` quranis ch`amovlinebisas, - gagemartebat`. (rac` ukve ikit`xet`) allahma shegarch`inat`. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, lmobieri.
t`k`venamdec` ikit`xa xalxma mis shesaxeb, shemdeg - mis gamo urcmunoebad gadaik`c`nen.

ar daudgenia allahs arc` bahira, arc` saibe, arc` vasila da arc` hami, t`umc`a isini, vinc` ar ircmunes, c`ils scameben allahs da sic`rues t`xzaven mis shesaxeb, t`anac` mat`i umravlesoba verc` ki azrovnebs.

da roc`a ut`xres: modit` imaze, rac` allahma ch`amoavlinao, da (modit`) shuamavalt`ano, mat` t`k`ves: ch`vent`vis isic` sakmarisia, razedac` vpovet` ch`veni mama-papani... - t`undac` mat` mamebs arap`eri gagebodat` da arc` scor gzaze mdgariqvnen?!

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`k`ven gakisriat` t`k`veni t`avis pasuxismgebloba. veras gavnebt` is, vinc` gzaac`denilia, t`u t`k`ven scor gzas daadgebit`. allaht`anaa qvela t`k`venganis saboloo misak`c`ieli da is gamc`nobt` imis shesaxeb, rasac` aket`ebdit`.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a sikvdili geaxlebat`, anderz'is mocme iqos ori samart`liani t`k`ven shoris an ori arat`k`vengant`agani, t`uki mgzavrad imqop`ebit` da sikvdilis ubedureba dagatqdat`. t`u echvi shegeparat` mat`shi, - loc`vis shemdeg sheaqovnet` orive mat`gani da g'mert`ze daip`ic`on:,,t`u ramis sap`asurad gavqidit` mas, t`undac` nat`esavt`a sasargeblod, da davmalavt` allahis cinashe dadebul mocmobas, mashin ch`ven c`odvilt`agan viqot`o''.

xolo t`uki gamoashkaravda rom am orma (c`rumocmobit`) c`odva daimsaxures, mashin sxva orni daikaveben mat` adgils, imat`gan, romlebic` (moanderz'est`an) siaxlovis upiratesobas p`loben da allahze daip`ic`eben, rom ch`veni mocmoba up`ro sandoa mat` mocmobaze da ar gavt`elavt` mas, cinaag'mdeg shemt`xvevashi ch`ven vik`nebit` usamart`lot`aganio.

es umjobesia, rat`a cesisamebr ag'sruldes mocmoba an eshinodet`, rom uarqop`ili ik`neba mat`i p`ic`i, mas shemdeg, rac` daip`ic`es. mash, ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da sheisminet`. cheshmaritad, ug'irs xalxs ar daakvalianebs allahi cheshmarit gzaze.
ert` dg'esac` allahi shekrebs shuamavlebs da kit`xvaze -,,ra pasuxi miig'et`?'' - etqvian: ch`ven aranair c`odnas ar vp`lobt`, cheshmaritad, shen xar uxilavt`a unaklod mc`odne!

roc`a allahi itqvis: ei, 'isa, z'eo meriemisa! gaixsene ch`emi cqaloba shendami da sheni dedis mimart`, - roc`a gangamtkic`e cminda sulit` (jibril angelozit`) da elaparake xalxs akvanshic` da zrdasrul asakshic`; roc`a gascavle cigni da sibrz'ne, t`evrat`i da injili; roc`a ch`emi nebit` t`ixisgan ch`itis p`ormas z'ercavdi, shemdeg masshi suls beravdi da ch`emive nebit` ch`itad ik`c`eoda; ch`emi nebit`ve t`andaqolil brmebsa da ket`rovnebs kurnavdi; roc`a mkvdrebi amogqavda (c`oc`xlad, samaridan); roc`a israelis modgma gangaride mashin, c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit` rom mixvedi mat`t`an da urcmunoebma t`k`ves (mat`gan): uechvelad, es mxolod ashkara jadoa.
aki, sht`avagone shens mocap`eebs, rom gcamdet` ch`emi da ch`emi shuamavlisa, da mat` t`k`ves: vircmunet`, dae daamocme, rom ch`ven vart` muslimni/morch`ilni.
aki t`k`ves mocap`eebma: o, 'isa, z'eo mariamisa! ch`vent`vis shens g'mert`s zec`idan sup`ris ch`amovlineba sheuz'lia? man miugo: ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, t`uki t`k`ven xart` morcmuneni.
t`k`ves: gvinda, rom mivirt`vat` misgan, gulebi davimshvidot`, vic`odet`, rom namdvilad simart`les gveubnebi da viqot` amis mocmeni.

mariamis z'e 'isam t`k`va: o, allah, g'mert`o ch`veno! zec`idan sup`ra ch`amogvivline, romelic` ik`neba dg'esascauli ch`vent`vis, rogorc` pirvelt`a, ise ukanasknelt`at`vis, da sascauli shengan, mash, mogvmadle sazrdo, ramet`u shen xar sauket`eso msazrdoebeli!
allahma upasuxa: cheshmaritad, me ch`amogivlent` mas, magram vinc` amis shemdegac` ar ircmunebs, mas ut`uod iset`i sasjelit` davsji, romlis msgavsit`ac` aravin damisjia samqaroshi.

roc`a etqvis allahi: ei, 'isa, z'eo meriemisa! shen ut`xari xalxs, rom me da dedach`emi allahis garda kidev or g'vt`aebad agvirch`iet`o? miugo: shen qovlad unaklo xar! ar shemep`ereboda imis t`k`ma, risi up`lebac` ar mak`vs. eg romc` met`k`va, ut`uod gec`odineboda. shen ucqi, rac`aa ch`emshi, xolo me ar vic`i, rac`aa shenshi. cheshmaritad, shena xar uxilavt`a unaklod mc`odne!

arap`eri mit`k`vams mat`t`vis, garda imisa, rac` mibrz'ane, rom t`aqvani ec`it` allahsa, ch`ems g'mert`sa da t`k`vens g'mert`so. mat`i mocme viqavi, vidre mat` shoris viqavi. xolo roc`a mimibare, shen iqavi mat`i met`valqure. da shen xar mocme qovelivesi.
t`uki mat` dasji, uechvelad, sheni msaxurni arian; xolo t`u miuteveb, cheshmaritad, shen xar z'levamosili, brz'eni.

allahi brz'anebs: esaa dg'e, roc`a mart`alni sargebels hpoveben t`aviant`i simart`lisas: mat`t`visaa samot`xeebi, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi miedineba; ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. kmaqop`ilia mat`gan allahi da t`vit`onac` kmaqop`ili arian misit`. ai, esaa mig'ceva - udidesi (didi gamarjveba).
allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da dedamicis ganmgebloba da (imis,) rac`aa mat`shi. igia qovlisshemz'le.
dideba allahs, romelmac` gaach`ina c`ani da dedamica, daadgina nat`eli da bneli. urcmunoebi, amis miuxedavad, t`aviant` g'mert`s sxvebs ut`anabreben.
igia, vinc` t`ixisgan gagach`inat`, shemdeg daadgina ajali da mis cinashea ajali gansazg'vruli. am qvelap`ris shemdeg t`k`ven mainc` echvi geparebat`.
igia allahi c`at`a shina da k`veqanaze, ic`is t`k`veni p`arulic` da c`xadic`, aseve ic`is, rasac` t`k`ven moixvecht`.
mat` t`aviant`i g'mert`is aiat`t`agan/sascault`agan, ra aiat`ic`/sascaulic` miuvidat`, qvelasgan piri ik`c`ies.
mart`lac` c`rud sherac`xes cheshmariteba, rodesac` mat` miuvidat`, t`umc`a shemdeg miuvat` ambavi imisa, rasac` abuch`ad igdebdnen.

nut`u ver xedaven, t`u ramdeni t`aoba gagvinadgurebia mat`ze adre, romlebsac` amk`veqnad iset`i sashualebebi vuboz'et`, rac` t`k`vent`vis ar gviboz'ebia; zec`idan uxvi nalek`i ch`amovuvlinet` da mdinareebi davadginet` mat` k`vemot` mdeni, shemdeg t`aviant`i c`odvebis gamo gavanadguret` da mat` shemdeg sxva t`aoba gavach`inet`.
t`undac` p`urc`elze dacerili cigni ch`amogvevlina shent`vis da t`aviant`i xelebit` shexebuliqvnen, mainc` itqodnen isini, - vinc` ar ircmunes, - rom es mxolod ashkara jadoao.
mat` t`k`ves: nut`u angelozi ar unda ch`amovleniliqo mast`an? mast`an rom angelozi ch`amogvevlina, mashin ut`uod gadacqdeboda mat`i sak`me da shemdeg ag'arc` edrovebodat`.
t`undac` angelozad dagvedgina igi, ut`uod kac`ad davadgendit` da mainc` igive mdgomareobashi ag'movach`endit`, ra mdgomareobashic` axla imqop`ebian.
uechvelad, shenze adrec` aigdes masxrad shuamavlebi, shemdeg vinc` mat` dasc`inodnen, - imit`ve ik`mnen shepqrobili, rist`visac` dasc`inodnen.
ut`xari: ch`amoiaret` dedamicaze da dainaxet`, t`u ra bedi eciat` c`rud shemrac`xvelebs.

ut`xari: visia is, rac`aa c`at`a shina da dedamicaze? upasuxe: allahisaa, man mocqaleoba t`avis valad sc`no. vp`ic`av, rom is mart`lac` shegkrebt` gankit`xvis dg'es, romelshic` echvi ar aris. xolo romelt`ac` sakut`ar sulebs avnes (urcmunoebit`), isini mainc` ar ircmuneben.
misia qoveli, rac` mkvidrobs g'amit` da dg'isit`; da isaa qovlismsmeneli, qovlismc`odne.

ut`xari: gana allahis garda sxvas avirch`ev mp`arvelad - gamch`enisa c`at`a da dedamicis? da igia dampurebeli, xolo t`vit`on ar sachiroebs dapurebas. ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me mebrz'ana, rom pirveli viqo, vinc` daemorch`ila da ar iqo carmart`t`aganio.
ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me vshishob, rom t`u veurch`ebi ch`ems g'mert`s, t`avs damatqdeba udidesi dg'is sasjeli.
im dg'es, vinc` ik`neba misgan ganridebuli, mas (allahi) mart`lac` sheicqalebs da es ik`neba c`xadi carmateba.
t`uki allahma uket`ureba shegamt`xvia, mis garda veravin agaridebs; xolo t`uki siket`e shegamt`xvia, igia qovlis shemz'le.
is aris z'levamosili, t`avis msaxurebze qovlad amag'lebuli da igia brz'eni, qovlismc`odne.

ut`xari: romelia qvelaze didi mocmoba? aseve, ut`xari, rom ch`em da t`k`ven shoris allahia mocme, da es qurani zesht`amegona, rat`a misit` gagap`rt`xilot` t`k`ven da isini, vist`anac` miag'cevs. t`k`ven mart`lac` amocmebt`, rom allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aebebic` arsebobs? ut`xari: me ar vamocmeb! ut`xari: cheshmaritad, is ert`adert`i g'mert`ia da uechvelad, me shors var imisgan, rasac` ut`anaziarebt`!
visac` cigni vuboz'et`, ise ic`noben mas (muhammeds), rogorc` ic`noben sakut`ar shvilebs. romelt`ac` t`aviant`i sulebi caricqmides, isini ar ircmuneben.
mash, vinaa imaze usamart`lo, vinc` sic`rues t`xzavs allahze an c`rud miich`nevs mis aiat`ebs? uechvelad, ver gadarch`ebian usamart`loni.
im dg'es mat` qvelas ert`ad shevqrit` da vetqvit` mat`, romlebic` ut`anaziarebdnen: sad arian ch`emi t`anaziarni, romlebic` t`k`ven momich`inet`?
shemdeg sxva verap`ers moimizezeben, garda imisa, rom itqvian: ch`vens g'mert`s, allahs vp`ic`avt`, rom ch`ven ar viqavit` carmart`ebi!
naxe, rogor c`ruoben sakut`ar sult`a cinaag'mdeg da ganudgnen mat`, rasac` t`xzavdnen (g'mert`ebad rac`xavdnen).

da mat`gan arian iset`ebic`, romlebic` gismenen, magram mat` gulebs saburveli gadavap`aret`, rat`a ver gaigon, qurebshic` simz'ime davugubet`: t`undac` qvela aiat`i/sascauli ixilon, mainc` rom ar ircmunon; up`ro metic`, shent`an t`u movlen isini, vinc` ar ircmunes, kamat`s dagicqeben da itqvian: uechvelad, es mxolod cinapart`a zg'aprebiao.
amgvarad, isini misgan sxvebs abrkoleben da t`vit`onac` shordebian mas; ase mxolod sakut`ar sulebs anadgureben da verc` ki xvdebian.
netav genaxa, rodesac` c`ec`xlis cinashe daaqeneben da itqvian:,,oh, netav ukan davbrundebodet` da c`rud ag'ar shevrac`xavdet` ch`veni g'mert`is aiat`ebs da vik`nebodet` morcmunet`agani''.
ara! mat` ukve gaec`xadat` igi, rasac` manamde malavdnen; romc` daabrunon, egeni mainc` imas daubrundebian, rac` ekrz'alebodat`. uechvelad, egeni matquarebi arian.
da t`k`ves: ch`veni sic`oc`xle mxolod amk`veqniuria da arc` mkvdret`it` ag'vdgebit` ch`ven.

netav genaxa, rodesac` t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe daaqeneben da etqvis: gana es ar aris cheshmariteba? isini etqvian: diax, ch`vens g'mert`s vp`ic`avt`. isic` etqvis: mash, igemet` sasjeli imis, rasac` uarqop`dit`.

mart`lac` cacqmedilan isini, romelnic` c`rud t`vlidnen allaht`an shexvedras, vidre ar mouscrebdat` zhami uec`rad da ar itqodnen:,,vai, ch`venda, im daudevrobis gamo, rac` ik` ch`avidinet`!" - t`anac` zurgit` ezidebian t`aviant` c`odvebs. raoden c`udia igi, rac` mat` utvirt`avt`!
t`amashisa da gart`obis garda sxva arap`eria cut`isop`eli; xolo isk`veqana umjobesia mat`t`vis, vinc` g'vt`ismoshishia. nut`u gonebas ar mouxmobt`?

rat`k`maunda vic`it`, rom didad gamcuxrebs, rasac` isini (shen shesaxeb) amboben. magram, cheshmaritebaa, rom (sinamdvileshi) shen ki ar grac`xaven c`rud, aramed allahis aiat`ebs uarqop`en usamart`loni

uechvelad, shenamdec` c`rud sherac`xulan shuamavalni, mat` ki mot`mineba gamouch`eniat` c`rud sherac`xvisa da shevicroebis cinashe, vidre ch`veni shecevna ar miuvidat`. ar arsebobs shemc`vleli allahis sitqvebisa. cheshmaritad, shen mogivida ambavi shuamavalt`a.

t`u gimz'ims mat`gan shen mimart` zurgis shek`c`eva, mashin ec`ade, t`u gz'aluz's, xvreli ipovo micis sig'rmeebisken an kibe - zec`it` ag'mart`uli, rat`a mat` sascauli miutano. allahs rom eneba, auc`ileblad shekrebda mat` cheshmarit gzaze. ase rom, nu ik`nebi umec`art`agani!
(shens mocodebas) qurad ig'eben mxolod isini, romelnic` ismenen; xolo mkvdrebs allahi ag'adgens mkvdret`it` da shemdeg mast`an ik`nebian mibrunebulni.
da t`k`ves: gana ert`i sascaulic` ar unda ch`amovleniliqo masze misive g'mert`isgan? ut`xari: cheshmaritad, allahs z'aluz's, rom sascauli ch`amoavlinos, t`umc`a mat`ma umravlesobam ar ic`is.

ar arsebobs dedamicaze iset`i c`xoveli; an p`rinveli, romelic` t`avisi p`rt`ebit` dap`rinavs, - rom t`k`ven msgavsad t`emebad ar iqvnen (daqop`ili). ch`ven cignshi arap`eri gamogvrch`enia, shemdeg t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe ik`nen shekrebilni.
xolo romelt`ac` c`rud miich`nies ch`vei aiat`ebi, - qruni da munjni arian bnelet`shi. allahi, visac` inebebs, mas aac`dens (scori) gzidan da visac` inebebs, mas daaqenebs scor gzaze.
ut`xari: aba mit`xarit`, t`uki allahis sasjeli geciat` an (k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis) zhami dagidgat`, mainc` sxvas daucqebt` vedrebas, nac`vlad allahisa, - t`u xart` namdvilad gulcrp`elni?
ara, - mxolod mas sheevedrebit`, da t`u inebebs, gixsnit` im mdgomareobidan, rist`visac` mas evedrebit` da daivicqebt` imat`, rasac` ut`anaziarebdit`.
cheshmaritad, shenamde ch`ven sxvadasxva xalxt`an carvgzavet` shuamavlebi da shevipqarit` isini sirt`uleebit`a da ubedurebebit`, - rom ik`neb t`avdamc`irebit` shevedrebuliqvnen.
mashin xom mainc` unda shemvedrebodnen t`avdamc`irebit`, - rodesac` ch`vengan sirt`ule ecviat`? t`umc`a gulebi gauk`vavdat` da satanam moukazma igi, rasac` sch`adiodnen.
rodesac` daivicqes igi, rit`ac` iqvnen shegonebuli, mashin gavuxsenit` qvelap`ris karebi; da roc`a gaixares imit`, rac` mat` miec`at`, - moulodnelad shevipqarit` da mashinve gaxdnen imedgac`ruebuli.
ase amoiz'irkva im xalxis modgma, vinc` usamart`lobas eceoda; k`eba-dideba allahs, - g'mert`s samqarot`a.

ut`xari: rogor p`ik`robt`, allahma rom smena da mxedveloba cagart`vat` da bechedi dagasvat` gulebze, - romeli g'vt`aeba dagibrunebt` mas, garda allahisa? shexede ra nair-nairad vmartavt` aiat`ebs, shemdeg ki mainc` pirs ibruneben egeni.
ut`xari: rogor p`ik`robt`, uec`rad an ashkarad rom allahis sasjeli gecviot`, gana usamart`lo xalxis garda vinme sxva daig'upeba?!
ar carvgzavnit` ch`ven shuamavlebs, t`u ara maxarobleblad da gamp`rt`xilebleblad, xolo vinc` ircmuna da gamoascora (z'veli urcmunoeba), - mat`t`vis arc` shishi ik`neba da arc` damcuxreba.
xolo mat`, romelt`ac` c`rud miich`nies ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, scored mat` sheexebat` sasjeli imisa, rasac` zg'vargadasulobdnen.

ut`xari: me t`k`ven ar geubnebit`, rom ch`emt`anaa allahis saunjeni, arc` uxilavis shesaxeb vic`i da arc` imas geubnebit`, rom me var angelozi. me mxolod imas mivqvebi, rac` zemevlineba. ut`xari: gana t`anascoria brma da mxedveli? nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebit`?
da misit` gaap`rt`xile isini, romelt`ac` eshiniat`, rom shekreba moucevt` t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe da mis garda arc` damxmare eqolebat` da arc` k`omagi, - ik`neb ridi hk`ondet` mat`.

da ar gandevno isini, romlebic` dila-sag'am t`aviant` g'mert`s evedrebian da misi (kmaqop`ili) saxe surt`. mat`i angarishidan shen arap`eri dagekisreba da arc` mat` daekisrebat` sheni angarishidan rame. t`uki gandevni mat`, mashin shen ik`nebi usamart`lot`agani.
amgvarad, gamovc`adet` zogiert`i mat`gani zogiert`it`, rom et`k`vat`: nut`u ch`ven shoris allahma mxolod amat` mihmadla siket`e? gana allahi uket` ar ucqis madliert`?

da roc`a movlen shent`an isini, romelt`ac` scamt` ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, ut`xari: mshvidoba t`k`venda! t`k`venma g'mert`ma sakut`ar t`avs mocqaleba daucera. amgvarad, vinc` uket`urebas ik`ms uvic`obit`, mere ki moinaniebs da shemdeg gamoscordeba, - cheshmaritad, igi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mocqalea!
ase dacvrilebit` ganvmartavt` aiat`ebs, - c`odvilt`a gza rom gamoashkaravdes.

ut`xari: uechvelad, amekrz'ala me, t`aqvani vc`e imat`, rasac` t`k`ven evedrebit`, nac`vlad allahisa. ut`xari: ar avuqvebi t`k`vens gemovnebas, radgan namdvilad avc`debi cheshmarit gzas da me ar vik`nebi scor gzaze mdgomt`agani.

ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me ch`emi g'mert`isgan movlenil c`xad mtkic`ebulebebs veqrdnobi, t`k`ven ki mas uarqop`t`; me ar vp`lob imas, rasac` t`k`ven ch`k`arobt`. gadacqvetileba mxolod allahs ekut`vnis, is mogit`xrobt` cheshmaritebis shesaxeb da igia kargi ganmc`alkevebeli.
ut`xari: me rom vp`lobde imas, rasac` t`k`ven ch`k`arobt`, mashin ut`uod gadacqdeboda sak`me ch`emsa da t`k`vens shoris, xolo allahma uket` ic`is usamart`loni.

da mast`anaa uxilavis gasag'ebni, mis garda igi aravin ic`is, man ic`is, rac`aa xmelet`ze da zg'vashi, ert`i p`ot`olic` ar ch`amovardeba ise, rom man ar ic`odes. ert`i marc`valic` ki ar arsebobs dedamicis jurg'mulebshi, - arc` nedli da arc` xmeli, - rom c`xad cignshi ar iqos gac`xadebuli.

da igia, romelic` gakvdinebt` g'amit` da ic`is, rasac` moixvecht` dg'isit`, shemdeg ag'gadgent` masshi, rat`a ag'sruldes ajali gansazg'vruli, shemdeg - mast`anaa t`k`veni misak`c`ieli, mere ki gaucqebt`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebdit`.

igi zeag'matebulia t`avis msaxurebze da mc`velebs (angelozebs) agzavnis t`k`vent`an; xolo visac` sikvdili ecveva, - mas moakvdineben ch`veni cargzavnilebi da isini (t`aviant` sak`meshi) nakls ar daushveben.
shemdeg allahs daubrundebian - t`aviant` namdvil baton-patrons. gaxsovdet` rom, mas ekut`vnis msjavri da isaa uscrap`esi ganmkit`xveli.
ut`xari: vin gixsnit` xmelet`isa da zg'vis sibneleebidan, roc`a gulis sig'rmeshi, t`avdamc`irebit` sheevedrebit`: vp`ic`avt`, t`uki gvixsni ak`edan, usat`uod vik`nebit` madliert`agani.
- ut`xari: allahi gixsnit` imisgan da qvela sxva sadardeblisgan, shemdeg ki t`k`ven mas mainc` ut`anaziarebt`.

ut`xari: igi z'levamosilia, sasjeli mogivlinot` zemodan an t`k`vens p`ext`a k`vemodan, an kidev mxareebad gak`c`iot` da t`k`venma ert`ma nacilma igemos meoris z'aladoba. shexede, ra dacvrilebit` vmartavt` aiat`ebs, ik`neb (ase mainc`) gaigon.
shenma xalxma c`rud miich`nia igi, arada is aris cheshmariteba. ut`xari: me ar var t`k`veni met`valqure.
qvela ambavs gansazg'vruli dro ak`vs (ag'srulebisa) da amas shemdgomshi sheitqobt`.

roc`a dainaxav, rom damc`inavad saubroben ch`veni aiat`ebis shesaxeb (romlebic` ch`amogevlina ), mashinve gaec`ale mat`, - vidre sxva sitqvit` ar dakavebulan. xolo t`uki satanam dagavicqa, mashin gaxsenebist`anave gaeride am usamart`lo xalxt`an dajdomas.
xolo mat`, romelnic` g'vt`ismoshishoben, arap`eri moekit`xebat` imat`i angarishidan; mat`ze mxolod shegonebaa - ik`neb g'vt`ismoshishoba gamoich`inon.

moshordi mat`, romlebic` xumrobit` da gart`obit` ekidebian t`aviant` sarcmunoebas da vinc` amk`veqniur c`xovrebas uc`dunebia! da misit` sheagone, rom ar dag'upos suli t`avisi monapovrit`; rom ar gaach`nia mas arc` damxmare da arc` k`omagi, garda allahisa. qvelanairi gamosasqidic` rom gaig'os, - ar miig'eba is misgan. scored egeni arian, vinc` t`aviant`i monapovrit` daig'upnen, mat`t`visaa mdug'are sasmeli da mcare sasjeli - imis gamo, rasac` uarqop`dnen.

ut`xari: gana allahis garda sxvas vevedrot`, romelic` veras gvargebs da verc` gvavnebs, da ukan mivbrundet`, ch`venive k`uslebis mimart`ulebit`, mas shemdeg, rac` allahma cheshmarit gzaze dagvakvaliana? imis msgavsad, vinc` gaabriqves satanebma da datoves k`veqnad t`avgzaabneuli, t`anac` mat` hqavt` megobrebi, romlebic` cheshmariti gzisken uxmoben: modit` ch`vent`ano. ut`xari:,,cheshmaritad, allahis mier mit`it`ebuli gzaa - gza cheshmariti da ch`ven gvebrz'ana, rom samqarot`a g'mert`s vmorch`ilebdet`".
aseve (gvebrz'ana), shevasrulot` namazi da mis (allahis ) mimart` ridi vik`oniot`. igia, romlis cinashec` ik`nebit` ag'dgenili.

da igia, romelmac` c`ani da dedamica gaach`ina cheshmaritebit` da im dg'es itqvis:,,iqav", da isic` umalve ik`mneba, - cheshmaritebaa misi sitqva. misia meup`eba im dg'isa, roc`a bukshi ch`aibereba, mc`odnea xilulisa da uxilavisa, da igia brz'eni, qovlismc`odne.
aki ibrahimma t`avis mamas, azars ut`xra: nut`u kerpebs ag'iareb g'mert`ebad!? uechvelad, vxedav, rom shen da sheni xalxi xart` ashkara gzaac`denilobashi.
amgvarad vach`venet` ibrahims c`at`a da k`veqnierebis meup`eba, rat`a qop`iliqo guldajerebul morcmunet`agani.
- g'amit`, rodesac` igi bindma garemoic`va da varskvlavi dainaxa, t`k`va:,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i"; xolo rodesac` gak`ra, dasz'ina: me ar miqvars is, rac` k`reba.

da roc`a amomavali mt`vare dainaxa, t`k`va:,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i", xolo rogorc` ki ch`avida, man t`k`va: t`uki ch`emma g'mert`ma ar damakvaliana cheshmariti gzisken, usat`uod me vik`nebi gzasac`denil xalxt`agani.

xolo roc`a amomavali mze dainaxa, t`k`va:,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i, es up`ro didia"; xolo rogorc` ki ch`avida, man t`k`va: o, ch`emo xalxo! cheshmaritad, me shors var imisgan, rasac` t`k`ven ut`anaziarebt`!
cheshmaritad, me saxe vibrune hanip`ad imisken, romelmac` shek`mna c`ani da dedamica, da me ar var carmart`t`agani.

da sheedava misi xalxi, man ki ut`xra: nut`u allahis shesaxeb mec`ilebit`, roc`a man damakvalina cheshmarit gzaze? me ar meshinia imis, rasac` t`k`ven ut`anaziarebt` mas, garda imisa, t`uki ch`emma g'mert`ma ineba rame. ch`emi g'mert`i qovelives c`odnit` garemoic`avs, nut`u ar gaiazrebt`?

da rogor unda meshinodes imis, rasac` t`k`ven ut`anaziarebt` (allahs ), mashin, roc`a t`k`ven ar geshiniat`, rom allahs ut`anaziarebdet` imas, ris shesaxebac` t`k`vent`vis aranairi mtkic`ebuleba ar ch`amouvlenia? da am ori mxridan romeli up`ro imsaxurebs usap`rt`xoebas, t`u ic`it`?
mat`t`vis, vinc` ircmunes da ar sheuries t`aviant` rcmenas usamart`loba, scored mat`t`visaa usap`rt`xoeba da egeni arian cheshmarit gzaze mdgomni.
ai, esaa ch`veni mtkic`ebuleba, romelic` ibrahims vuboz'et` t`avisi xalxis sacinag'mdegod. xarisxobrivad vamag'lebt` mas, visac` vinebebt`. cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i brz'enia, qovlis mc`odne.

da vucqalobet` mas ishaqi da ia'qubi, orive cheshmarit gzaze davakvalianet`, aseve, up`ro adre nuhic` davakvalianet` da misi sht`amomavlobidan - davudi, suleimani, aiubi, iusup`i, musa da haruni. amgvarad vajildovebt` ket`ilismk`nelebs.
zek`eria, iahia, 'isa da iliasi, - qvelani iqvnen sat`not`aganni.
aseve, isma'ili, iese'i, iunusi da luti, - qvela mat`gani gamovarch`iet` samqarot`a cinashe.
aseve amovarch`iet` mat` mamat`agan, sht`amomavalt`agan da z'mat`agan, da scor gzaze davakvalianet`.
esaa allahis gza - cheshmariti: masze t`avis msaxurt`agan akvalianebs mat`, visac` inebebs; xolo t`u mainc` ut`anaziareben, mashin usat`uod gac`amtverdeba, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen.
egeni arian, visac` vuboz'et` cigni, sibrz'ne da mac`neoba. t`uki isini uarqop`en mas, usat`uod, mas iset` xalxs gadavabarebt`, romlebic` ar uarqop`en.

ai, egeni arian, vinc` allahma cheshmarit gzaze daakvaliana da shenc` mat` cheshmarit gzas sheudek`i. ut`xari: imis sanac`vlod ar vit`xov t`k`vengan gasamrjelos, aramed is mxolod shegonebaa samqarot`at`vis.

da mat` ver sheic`nes allahi qadrianad, rogorc` mas sheep`ereba, rodesac` t`k`ves: allahs adamianist`vis arap`eri ch`amouvlenia. (shenc`) ut`xari: mash, vin ch`amoavlina cigni, - sinat`leda da cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad adamiant`at`vis, - romlit`ac` musa movida da romelsac` p`urc`lebze cert`, nacili - gamogak`vt` saashkaraoze, umetess ki malavt`? da gescavlat` is, rac` ar ic`odit` - arc` t`k`ven da arc` t`k`vnma cinaprebma. upasuxe - allahmao (ch`amoavlinao), shemdeg ki miatove mat`i amao saubrit` gart`ulni.

da es daloc`vili cigni ch`amovavlinet` damamocmeblad imisa, rac` iqo masze cinat`, aseve k`alak`t`a dedis da mis garshemo mqop`t`a gasap`rt`xileblad. xolo visac` scamt` saik`io, mat` esec` (quranic`) scamt` da isini t`aviant` namazsac` gulmodgined ic`aven.

da vin aris imaze didi usamart`lo, romelmac` sic`rue shet`xza allahis shesaxeb an t`k`va, rom vahi (g'vt`iuri shetqobineba) mivig'eo; arada mas arap`eri miug'ia; aseve, vinc` t`k`va: mec` ch`amovavlen imis msgavss, rac` allahma ch`amoavlinao. netav genaxa sult`mobrz'avi usamart`loni, rodesac` angelozebi xelebgacvdilni eubnebian: ganutevet` sulebi! dg'es mogezg'vebat` sasjeli damamc`irebeli, im usamart`lobist`vis, rasac` allahis shesaxeb ambobdit` da misi aiat`ebis mimart` medidurobdit`!

da vp`ic`av, ch`ven cinashe ise eulad moxvedit`, rogorc` pirvelad gagach`inet`. da zurgsukan migitovebiat`, rac` t`k`vent`vis gviboz'ebia, veg'arc` t`k`vens k`omagebs vxedavt` t`k`vent`an ert`ad, romlebic`, gjerodat`, rom iqvnen (allahis) t`anaziarni. ukve gacqda kavshiri t`k`ven shoris da gandegila is t`k`vengan, rasac` amtkic`ebdit` (usap`uz'vlod).
cheshmaritad, allahia marc`vlisa da kurkis gampob-gamg'ivebeli, c`oc`xali mkvdrisgan gamohqavs da c`oc`xlisganac` - mkvdari. ai, es aris allahi da t`k`ven rogor ganeridebit`?
- gamg'vivebeli alionisa, romelmac` daadgina g'ame mosasveneblad, mze da mt`vare ki (drot`a) gamosat`vlelad. aset`ia gangeba z'levamosilis, qovlis mc`odnisa.

da igia, vinc` t`k`vent`vis dasxa varskvlavebi, rat`a mat`it` gza gagekvliat` xmelet`isa da zg'vis cqvdiadebshi. uechvelad, ch`ven dacvrilebit` ganvmartet` aiat`ebi - im xalxist`vis, romlebmac` ic`ian.
da igia, romelmac` shegk`mnat` ert`i sulisgan; shemdgom (dagidginat`) mosakalat`ebeli da misabarebeli. uechvelad, ch`ven detalurad ganvmartet` aiat`ebi - im xalxist`vis, romlebic` gamgebia.

igia, romelmac` zec`idan cqali ch`amoavlina; da ag'movac`enet` misit` qvelanairi mc`enare, amovzardet` misgan mcvanobi, imisgan ki marc`vlebi - ert`manet`ze asxmuli, xolo p`inikis kokrisgan - ch`amokidebuli mtevnebi, aseve qurz'nis bag'ebi, zet`isxili da broceuli - ert`manet`is msgavsic` da gansxvavebulic`. shexedet` mis naqop`s, romelic` isxams da mcip`deba. cheshmaritad, am qvelap`ershi mart`lac` sascaulebia morcmune xalxist`vis.
da allahs jinebi ut`anaziares, arada man gaach`ina isini; aseve, uvic`ad dascames z'eebi da asulebi. igi qovlad unaklo da uzenaesia imisgan, rogoradac` axasiat`eben.
- igi c`at`a da dedamicis arap`risgan shemk`mnelia da shvili saidan eqoleba, rodesac` c`oli ar hqolia? da man gaach`ina qvelap`eri, igia qovlis mc`odne.
igia allahi - g'mert`i t`k`veni, ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda misi, qovlis gamch`enisa. mash, t`aqvani ec`it` mas, - igia qovlis met`valqure.
- ver shescvdebian imas mzerani, t`vit`on ki mcvdomia mzerat`a, da isaa lmobieri, qovlismc`odne.

cheshmaritad, t`k`veni g'mert`isgan mogividat` t`valsach`ino mtkic`ebulebani; ase rom, vinc` t`vals gaaxels - misive sulis sargod, xolo vinc` caubrmavebs - misda sazianod. da ar var me t`k`veni met`valqure.
amgvarad vmartavt` aiat`ebs qovelmxriv, isini ki mainc` itqvian:,,giscavlia", rat`a c`xadgveqo xalxist`vis, romlebmac` ic`ian.
mihqevi imas, rac` zemogevlina sheni g'mert`isgan; ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda misi, da zurgi ak`c`ie carmart`ebs.
allahs rom eneba, ar ut`anaziarebdnen, da shen arc` mc`velad dagvidgenixar da arc` vek`ili xar mat`i.

da ar galanz'g'ot` isini, visac` allahis nac`vlad evedrebian, radgan isinic` allahs daucqeben lanz'g'vas - mtrobit`, c`odnis gareshe. ase movukazmet` qvela t`ems t`aviant`i sak`meni, shemdeg t`aviant` g'mert`t`anaa mat`i misabrunebeli da is (allahi) ac`nobebt` mat` imis shesaxeb, rasac` aket`ebdnen.

allahs ip`ic`ebian mt`eli t`avgamodebit`, rom t`uki ert`i sascauli mievlinebat`, mashin auc`ileblad ircmuneben mas. ut`xari: cheshmaritad, sascaulebi allahis gankargulebashia, t`k`ven (morcmuneno) ki ar ic`it`, rom sascaulebi romc` movides, egeni mainc` ar ircmuneben!
da shevak`c`evt` mat` gulebsa da xedvebs, rogorc` ar ircmunes t`avdapirvelad, da mivatovebt` t`aviant` zg'vargadasulobashi, t`avgzaabneulebs.
